corpus_topic: Personal photography portfolio with EXIF metadata display
query_text: Need a web app for my personal photography portfolio that shows each photo in a clean, immersive layout and also surfaces the camera settings right there on the page, things like shutter speed, aperture, ISO, and the lens I used, so people can appreciate both the image and the craft behind it, with a sidebar that lets you filter by camera body or shooting location.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个个人摄影作品集网页应用，用干净沉浸式的布局展示每张照片，并在页面上直接显示相机参数，比如快门速度、光圈、ISO和使用的镜头，让人们既能欣赏图像本身，也能看到背后的摄影技巧，还要有一个侧边栏让你能按相机型号或拍摄地点筛选作品。

corpus_topic: Developer open-source contribution showcase and stats page
query_text: Create a visual showcase site for my open-source work that lives in the browser and feels like a beautifully curated gallery, where each project gets its own card with contribution counts and activity shown as something organic and artistic rather than dry numbers, and a summary section at the top that captures the overall story of my involvement across repos over time.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个展示开源作品的视觉化网站，在浏览器中运行，感觉就像一个精心策划的美术馆，每个项目都有自己的卡片，贡献次数和活动数据以有机艺术的方式呈现，而不是干巴巴的数字，并在顶部有个总结板块，讲述我在各个仓库长期参与的故事。

corpus_topic: Personal travel map with visited-countries photo log
query_text: Make a travel tracker web app with a world map at its heart where every country I have visited glows or changes color, and clicking any country opens a warm, moodboard-style photo log from that trip, with a few lines of memory attached to each image, so the whole thing feels like a living scrapbook you browse from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个旅行追踪网页应用，以世界地图为核心，每个我去过的国家都会发光或改变颜色，点击任何国家就能打开一个温暖的情绪板风格的照片日志，每张图片旁边有几行回忆备注，整个应用就像一本活的剪贴簿，你可以在桌面浏览器中翻阅。

corpus_topic: Artist illustration gallery with work-in-progress panels
query_text: An illustration gallery web app with a beautifully editorial feel, where finished pieces are shown large and full-bleed across the desktop layout, and each one has a behind-the-scenes panel that walks through the process stages with rough sketches alongside the polished final, giving the whole thing the texture of a printed art book you flip through online.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个插画作品集网页应用，具有精美的编辑风格，成品横跨整个桌面布局并铺满屏幕，每件作品都有一个幕后制作板块，展示从粗略草稿到精美完成稿的全过程，让整个网站有印刷艺术书的质感，就像在线翻阅一本真实的艺术书。

corpus_topic: Personal bookshelf and reading history visual archive
query_text: Need a personal bookshelf web app that looks like a real, curated collection rather than a list, where book covers are displayed in a warm, gallery-style arrangement and each title opens to show my reading notes, the date I finished it, and a little visual timeline of my reading history so I can see how my tastes have shifted across the years.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个个人书架网页应用，看起来像真实的精心挑选的收藏，而不是一个列表，书籍封面用温暖的美术馆式排列展示，每本书打开后能看到我的阅读笔记、完成日期，还有一个小小的阅读历史时间线，让我能看到多年来我的品味是如何变化的。

corpus_topic: Wedding story and countdown announcement microsite
query_text: Build a wedding announcement website that feels genuinely romantic and carefully composed, with a countdown timer that has a soft, elegant aesthetic, a section that tells our story in a flowing timeline of photos and little written moments, and the whole thing should feel like something you would actually want to save and revisit in a desktop browser before the big day.
query_text_zh: 我想建一个婚礼宣布网站，感觉真挚浪漫且精心构思，有一个美学柔和优雅的倒计时计时器，一个板块用流畅的照片和点点滴滴的文字时间线讲述我们的故事，整个网站应该让人觉得值得保存和在婚礼前的日子里反复访问。

corpus_topic: Personal music listening stats and top-tracks visualization
query_text: Build a web app that turns my personal music listening history into something that actually looks gorgeous, with my top tracks and artists shown through rich, moody visuals rather than plain tables, a color palette pulled from album art, and a timeline of my listening habits over the past year so the whole thing feels like an annual report for my taste in music.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用，把我个人的音乐听歌历史变成真正好看的东西，用丰富有意思的视觉效果展示我的热门歌曲和艺术家，而不是枯燥的表格，色调从专辑封面提取，加上过去一年的听歌习惯时间线，让整个应用感觉像是我的音乐品味年度总结报告。

corpus_topic: Freelancer service portfolio with client testimonial wall
query_text: Need a freelancer portfolio website that feels warm and personal rather than corporate, where my services are laid out in a clear but beautifully styled way across the desktop layout, and client testimonials get their own dedicated space that reads like a curated wall of appreciation, each quote given room to breathe with the client name and a little context about the project.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个自由职业者作品集网站，感觉温暖亲切而不是冷冰冰的公司风，我的服务在桌面布局上清晰地展示，但设计精美，客户推荐和证言有自己的专属区域，读起来就像一面精心策划的感谢墙，每个引用都有足够的呼吸空间，附带客户名字和一点项目背景。

corpus_topic: Academic researcher publication and citation showcase page
query_text: Make a personal academic showcase site for desktop browsers where my publications are presented with a refined, typographic elegance rather than a plain list, with each paper getting a well-styled entry that includes the abstract, the journal name, and a citation count displayed in a way that feels considered and tasteful, along with a visual summary of my research themes.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器做一个个人学术展示网站，我的出版物以精致的排版优雅展示，而不是素朴的列表，每篇论文都有一个设计用心的条目，包括摘要、期刊名称，以及以克制品味的方式展示的引用次数，还有一个关于我研究主题的视觉总结。

corpus_topic: Personal recipe archive with styled food photography
query_text: Need a recipe archive web app that feels like a beautifully designed food magazine, where each recipe page is anchored by a large, carefully styled food photo and the ingredients and steps are laid out with generous spacing and a warm color palette, so browsing through my collection on a desktop feels as enjoyable as flipping through an actual cookbook.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个食谱档案网页应用，感觉像一本精心设计的美食杂志，每个食谱页面都锚定在一张大的精心拍摄的食物照片上，食材和步骤用宽敞的间距和温暖的色调布置，所以在桌面上浏览我的收藏就像翻阅真正的烹饪书一样享受。

corpus_topic: Marathon runner race history and personal-records timeline
query_text: Need a marathon history web app that captures all my races in a timeline that feels cinematic rather than spreadsheet-like, where each event shows the course, my finishing time, and a photo from the day, and a dedicated personal records section highlights my bests with a sense of visual drama, so looking back at years of running actually feels inspiring in a browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个马拉松历史网页应用，用电影般的时间线捕捉我所有的比赛，而不是电子表格的感觉，每场赛事都显示路线、我的完成时间和那天的照片，还有一个专门的个人记录板块用视觉戏剧效果突出我的最佳成绩，所以在浏览器中回顾多年的跑步实际上感觉很鼓舞人心。

corpus_topic: Film buff watch history and decade-by-decade ratings wall
query_text: Create a film watching tracker for desktop browsers that groups my entire watch history by decade in a visually rich layout, with movie posters as the primary visual currency and my personal star ratings shown in a style that feels like a curated wall rather than a database, and a side area that surfaces my favorite genres and directors based on what I have actually watched.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器创建一个电影观看跟踪应用，按十年对我整个观影历史进行分组，用视觉丰富的布局展示，电影海报作为主要视觉元素，我的个人星级评分以精心挑选的墙壁风格呈现，而不是数据库风格，还有一个侧边区域显示我最喜欢的类型和导演，这些都是根据我真实观看的内容统计的。

corpus_topic: Personal vinyl record collection visual catalog site
query_text: Build a vinyl record collection site that looks and feels like browsing through a well-loved record shop, where album covers are the star of the show in a warm desktop layout, each record opens to display its genre, year, and a short note I can write about why I love it, and the overall mood of the site should feel as tactile and curated as the collection itself.
query_text_zh: 我想建一个黑胶唱片收藏网站，看起来和感觉就像在逛一个深受欢迎的唱片店，专辑封面是核心视觉亮点，在温暖的桌面布局中展示，每张唱片打开后可以显示其类型、出版年份和我写的一些简短评价，整个网站的氛围应该像收藏本身一样有质感和精心策划。

corpus_topic: Baby milestone photo journal for extended family
query_text: Build a baby milestone journal website that the whole extended family can visit in a browser, with a soft and elegant visual style where photos are arranged chronologically along a gentle timeline, each milestone moment labeled with an age and a little caption, so grandparents and relatives can follow along and the whole thing feels like a beautifully kept family keepsake.
query_text_zh: 我想建一个婴儿成长日志网站，整个大家庭都可以在浏览器中访问，有柔和优雅的视觉风格，照片沿着温和的时间线按时间顺序排列，每个里程碑时刻标注年龄和小标题，这样祖父母和亲戚能跟进成长，整个网站感觉就像一本精心保存的家庭纪念品。

corpus_topic: Personal recipe collection and seasonal food journal
query_text: Make a recipe journal web app that feels like a personal food magazine I actually want to browse, where recipes are organized by season with a visual warmth that changes as you move through the year, each entry can hold a photo I took of the dish along with my notes on how it turned out, and the whole thing is something I can open in a desktop browser and actually feel good looking at.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个食谱日志网页应用，感觉像是一本我真的想浏览的个人美食杂志，食谱按季节组织，用会随着你浏览一年四季而变化的视觉温暖感，每条食谱可以附上我拍的这道菜的照片，以及我关于它成品如何的笔记，整个应用是我可以在桌面浏览器中打开的，而且实际上看着很舒服。

corpus_topic: Travel memoir site with destination photo journals
query_text: A travel memoir site where each destination gets its own richly illustrated journal entry, the kind of web app you would happily sit with at a desktop for an hour, where photo journals from each place are laid out with an editorial quality and the writing has room to breathe alongside the images, so the whole thing reads like a personal travel book you can revisit and add to over time.
query_text_zh: 一个旅行回忆录网站，每个目的地都有自己丰富插图的日志条目，这种网页应用你会乐意坐在桌面前看一个小时，每个地方的照片日志用编辑质感布置，文字在图像旁边有足够的呼吸空间，整个内容读起来就像一本个人旅行书，你可以随时查看和添加内容。

corpus_topic: Personal book review blog and reading progress log
query_text: Need a personal book review web app where each entry looks genuinely considered, with the cover art displayed prominently, my review written out in a clean and readable style, and a reading progress log that gives a sense of the journey through the year in a visually pleasing way, the kind of thing that feels like a literary journal rather than a checklist when you open it in a browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个个人图书评论网页应用，每条评论看起来都认真考虑过，书籍封面突出显示，我的评论清晰易读地写出来，阅读进度日志用视觉上令人愉快的方式记录全年的阅读之旅，这种东西打开时感觉像是一本文学期刊，而不是一个检查清单。

corpus_topic: Movie watching diary with personal ratings and reflections
query_text: Build a movie diary web app for desktop browsers where I can log every film I watch and give it a personal rating alongside a few sentences of reflection, with the collection displayed in a cinematic, poster-led layout grouped by year, and a sense that browsing through old entries feels like wandering through a beautifully organized personal archive rather than scrolling a plain list.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器建一个电影日记网页应用，可以记录我看过的每部电影并给出个人评分，加上几句思考的话，整个收藏以电影感十足、海报为主的布局展示，按年份分组，浏览旧条目的感觉就像在逛一个精心组织的个人档案库，而不是滚动一个乏味的列表。

corpus_topic: Personal music listening history and album annotation site
query_text: Need a music listening history site that lets me annotate albums with my own thoughts and memories, displayed in a warm, atmospheric layout in a desktop browser where album covers carry the visual weight and each annotation feels like a personal liner note, with a timeline view that shows how my listening has changed across months so the whole thing reads like a musical autobiography.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个音乐听歌历史网站，让我可以用自己的想法和回忆标注专辑，在桌面浏览器中用温暖有意思的布局展示，专辑封面承载视觉重量，每条标注感觉像是个人的唱片内页评论，一个时间线视图显示我听歌如何在几个月间变化，让整个东西读起来像一本音乐自传。

corpus_topic: Original poetry and creative prose self-publishing site
query_text: A poetry and creative writing site for desktop browsers where each piece is given the visual respect it deserves, with thoughtful typography and generous white space so the words feel like they are on a printed page, a simple archive that groups work by theme or mood rather than just date, and a reading experience that feels unhurried and beautiful rather than like a generic blog.
query_text_zh: 一个为桌面浏览器设计的诗歌和创意写作网站，每件作品都获得应有的视觉尊重，考虑周到的排版和宽敞的留白让文字感觉像印在纸页上，简单的档案库按主题或情绪而不仅按日期分组，阅读体验感觉从容优美，而不是像一个普通博客。

corpus_topic: Personal art portfolio with sketchbook process galleries
query_text: Need a personal art portfolio web app where each finished piece is shown at a scale that does it justice in a desktop browser, with a dedicated area for sketchbook process galleries that let viewers see the early rough stages alongside the final work, and the overall design should feel like a considered artist monograph rather than a generic portfolio grid.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个个人艺术作品集网页应用，每件成品在桌面浏览器中以做得到它公正的尺寸展示，有一个专门的素描簿过程作品集区域，让观众看到早期粗略草稿和最终完成稿，整体设计应该感觉像是一本考虑周到的艺术家专著，而不是一个普通的作品集网格。

corpus_topic: Garden journal with seasonal plant growth photo log
query_text: Need a garden journal web app that tracks how my plants grow across the seasons with a visual warmth that mirrors the feel of being outside, where I can attach photos at different stages of growth for each plant, the layout in a desktop browser should feel lush and organic rather than clinical, and looking back through the log should feel like leafing through a beautifully kept nature diary.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个园艺日志网页应用，跟踪我的植物如何随季节生长，用镜像户外感觉的视觉温暖，我可以在植物的不同生长阶段为每株植物附加照片，桌面浏览器中的布局应该感觉青葱有机，而不是冷冰冰的，回顾这些日志应该像翻阅一本精心保存的自然日记。

corpus_topic: Personal fitness transformation journal with milestone photos
query_text: A fitness transformation journal web app where the visual heart of it is a personal photo log that shows how my body has changed over months and years, laid out with tasteful before-and-after comparisons in a desktop browser, with milestone moments highlighted in a way that feels motivating and human rather than like a fitness app, alongside brief personal notes attached to the big turning points.
query_text_zh: 一个健身转变日志网页应用，视觉核心是一个个人照片日志，显示我的身体在几个月和几年间的变化，在桌面浏览器中用品味的前后对比布置，里程碑时刻以激励人且人性化的方式突出，感觉不像健身应用，旁边还有附加在重要转折点的短篇个人笔记。

corpus_topic: Language learning diary with vocabulary and study notes
query_text: Make a language learning diary web app that feels beautiful to use in a desktop browser, where I can log new vocabulary with example sentences written in my own hand so to speak, study notes organized by theme or grammar topic, and a visual sense of progress over time that feels warm and encouraging rather than like a drill, so opening it each day actually feels like a pleasure.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个语言学习日记网页应用，在桌面浏览器中使用时感觉很漂亮，可以用例句记录新词汇，像用自己的手写一样，学习笔记按主题或语法话题组织，以及随时间的进度感，感觉温暖鼓励而不是像一个练习程序，所以每天打开它实际上感觉像是一种乐趣。

corpus_topic: Personal podcast companion site with episode show notes
query_text: Build a companion website for my podcast that has the aesthetic of a carefully designed independent publication in a desktop browser, where each episode gets its own page with show notes laid out in an inviting and readable style, a running archive of all episodes presented with a consistent visual identity, and a tone that feels personal and crafted rather than auto-generated.
query_text_zh: 我想为我的播客建一个配套网站，有精心设计的独立出版物的美感，在桌面浏览器中，每一集都有自己的页面，节目注释用邀请式和易读的风格布置，所有剧集的完整档案以一致的视觉认同展示，语气感觉个人且精心制作，而不是自动生成的。

corpus_topic: Personal newsletter archive with public subscriber-facing web presence
query_text: A personal newsletter archive that feels like a beautiful literary magazine online, where each issue has its own cover feel and the whole thing lives as a public website readers can browse and subscribe to, with a clean reading layout that makes the writing the star, maybe a soft serif font and generous white space, and a simple way for visitors to sign up so they never miss a new issue.
query_text_zh: 一个个人新闻通讯档案库，感觉像一本漂亮的文学杂志在线，每期都有自己的封面感，整个东西作为一个公众网站存在，读者可以浏览和订阅，干净的阅读布局让写作成为主角，也许用柔和的衬线字体和宽敞的留白，还有简单的方式让访客注册，这样他们就不会错过新问题。

corpus_topic: Video essay channel companion site with transcripts
query_text: A companion website for a video essay channel where each essay gets its own page with the full transcript laid out beautifully beside the embedded video, the kind of reading experience that feels considered and slow rather than rushed, with a warm typographic palette and a browsable archive of all past essays so visitors can explore by theme or mood, all working in the browser on a desktop screen.
query_text_zh: 一个视频随笔频道的配套网站，每篇随笔有自己的页面，完整的字幕漂亮地排在嵌入视频旁，这种阅读体验感觉经过思考且缓慢，而不是仓促的，用温暖的排版调色板，还有一个可浏览的所有往期随笔档案库，可以按主题或情绪探索，全部在桌面屏幕浏览器中工作。

corpus_topic: Photography portfolio with per-image story and EXIF annotations
query_text: Create a photography portfolio web app that feels like a curated gallery book, where each photo opens into its own full story, the kind where the image breathes at the top and then the writing flows beneath it alongside the camera details like lens and settings shown in a quiet, understated way, and the overall site has a consistent dark or neutral tone that lets the colors in the photos do all the talking.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个摄影作品集网页应用，感觉像一本精心策划的美术馆书，每张照片都打开到自己完整的故事中，这种应用图像在顶部呼吸，然后文字在下面流动，摄影细节如镜头和设置以安静低调的方式显示，整个网站有一致的深色或中性色调，让照片中的颜色说话。

corpus_topic: daily reading log and book annotation tracker
query_text: Build a daily reading log tracker as a web app where I can add a book, mark how many pages I read each day, and write short notes or quotes I want to remember from that session, with a list on the side showing all my books sorted by the ones I'm currently reading first, and a way to see all my annotations for a given book in one place so I can find things later.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个日常读书日志追踪器网页应用，可以添加一本书，标记我每天读了多少页，并写下我想记住的短笔记或引用，侧边的列表显示我所有的书，当前阅读的优先显示，并且有个方法可以一次看到某本书的所有标注，这样我以后能找到东西。

corpus_topic: language learning progress dashboard for self-studiers
query_text: Create a language learning progress tracker for self-studiers as a browser-based tool where I can log how many minutes I studied each day, track words I've learned and mark ones I'm still shaky on, and see a simple chart showing my study streaks over the past few weeks so I can tell if I'm keeping up a good pace or falling behind.
query_text_zh: 我想为自学者创建一个语言学习进度追踪工具，在浏览器中运行，可以记录我每天学习了多少分钟，跟踪学过的单词并标记还不太确定的，看一个简单的图表显示过去几周我的学习连续天数，这样我能看出自己是否保持良好进度或落后了。

corpus_topic: coding practice journal for self-taught developers
query_text: A coding practice journal app for self-taught learners that runs in the browser, where I can log each practice session with the topic I worked on, the problems I tried, and a quick note about what clicked or what I'm still confused about, with a running list of all past sessions I can scroll through and filter by topic so I can see my progress over time.
query_text_zh: 一个在浏览器中为自学编程者运行的编程练习日志应用，可以记录每次练习课程的主题、尝试的问题，以及我哪里有所领悟或还感到困惑的简短笔记，有一个运行的所有往期课程列表可以滚动和按主题筛选，这样我能看到自己的进度。

corpus_topic: personal linked knowledge base and note wiki
query_text: Create a personal wiki app for the browser where I can write notes on any topic and link them to each other by name so that clicking a linked word in one note takes me straight to that other note, with a simple sidebar listing all my notes alphabetically so I can jump around easily, and a way to search all my notes by keyword when I can't remember where I wrote something.
query_text_zh: 我想为浏览器创建一个个人维基应用，可以写任何主题的笔记并通过名字链接到彼此，这样点击一个笔记中的链接词就能直接跳转到另一个笔记，侧边有一个简单的列表按字母顺序列出我所有的笔记，这样我能轻松跳来跳去，还有个方法按关键字搜索所有笔记，当我记不清在哪写了某东西时。

corpus_topic: math problem-solving streak and error analysis tracker
query_text: Create a math practice tracker as a web app where I can log each problem I attempt, mark it as correct or wrong, and leave a note about which step tripped me up when I got it wrong, with a running count of my daily streak and a breakdown showing which types of problems I get wrong most often so I know what to focus on next.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个数学练习追踪器网页应用，可以记录我尝试的每个问题，标记为对或错，并在我做错时留一张关于哪一步卡住我的笔记，有一个运行的日连续天数计数和一个分解，显示我在哪类问题上最容易出错，这样我知道接下来应该集中注意什么。

corpus_topic: self-paced online course completion progress tracker
query_text: Create a course progress tracker as a browser-based app where I can add all the online courses I'm taking, break each one down into lessons or chapters, and check them off as I finish them, with a simple progress bar showing how far along I am in each course and a log showing which lessons I completed on which dates so I can look back and see how consistent I've been.
query_text_zh: 我想为浏览器创建一个课程进度追踪应用，可以添加我正在参加的所有在线课程，把每个课程分解为课程或章节，完成后打勾，有一个简单的进度条显示我在每个课程中走了多远，一个日志显示我在哪些日期完成了哪些课程，这样我能回头看看自己有多坚持。

corpus_topic: learning podcast episode notes and highlights collector
query_text: Make a podcast notes collector as a web app where I can add an episode by title and show name, write down the key ideas I want to remember, and highlight the lines that stood out most, with all my episodes listed in a sidebar I can browse in the browser on my desktop, and a search bar so I can find a specific note or idea across all the episodes I've saved.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个播客笔记收集器网页应用，可以按标题和节目名称添加一集，写下我想记住的关键想法，突出显示最让我印象深刻的句子，所有我的剧集在侧边栏中列出，我可以在浏览器中在桌面上浏览，还有一个搜索栏，这样我能跨所有保存的剧集找到特定笔记或想法。

corpus_topic: foreign language media consumption and vocabulary log
query_text: Need a vocabulary logger for the browser where I can track all the foreign language movies, shows, and books I consume, add new words I picked up from each one with a quick meaning note, and see a running list of all my saved words that I can filter by the source I learned it from so I can review words from a specific show or book in one go.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个浏览器的外语词汇记录器，可以跟踪我看过的所有外语电影、电视节目和书籍，从每个内容中添加我学到的新单词和一张快速意思笔记，看一个运行的所有保存单词列表，可以按我学它的来源筛选，这样我能一次复习某个电视节目或书籍中的单词。

corpus_topic: typing speed improvement trainer with lesson history
query_text: A typing trainer app that works in the browser on a desktop, where I can do timed typing exercises and see my words per minute and accuracy score at the end of each one, with a history log that saves every session so I can track whether my speed is improving over time, and a simple chart showing my average score by week so the progress is easy to see at a glance.
query_text_zh: 一个在桌面浏览器中工作的打字练习应用，可以做定时打字练习并在每个练习结束时看我的每分钟字数和准确率分数，有一个历史日志保存每次课程，这样我能追踪我的速度是否在改进，一个简单的图表按周显示我的平均分数，这样进度一眼就能看清。

corpus_topic: TED talk annotation and personal takeaways notebook
query_text: Make a TED talk notebook app for desktop browsers where I can save any talk by title and link, write my own notes and reactions while or after watching, and mark the specific lines or ideas I want to come back to, with all my saved talks in a list I can sort by date saved or by topic, so I can actually find and use those takeaways instead of forgetting them the next day.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器做一个TED演讲笔记本应用，可以通过标题和链接保存任何演讲，在观看时或之后写下我自己的笔记和反应，标记我想回到的特定句子或想法，所有保存的演讲在一个列表中，我可以按日期保存或按主题排序，这样我能真的找到并使用那些收获，而不是第二天就忘了。

corpus_topic: skill tree visualizer for self-directed learners
query_text: Make a skill map tool for the browser where I can lay out all the things I want to learn in a branching chart, connect related skills to each other, and mark each one as not started, in progress, or done, with the ability to click any skill and add a few notes about what I've been doing to learn it, so I can see the whole picture of my learning plan at once on a desktop screen.
query_text_zh: 我想为浏览器做一个技能地图工具，可以在分支图中列出我想学的所有东西，连接相关技能到彼此，标记每个为未开始、进行中或完成，可以点击任何技能并添加几张笔记关于我在学什么，这样我能在一个桌面屏幕上看到我整个学习计划的全貌。

corpus_topic: academic paper reading list and highlights tool
query_text: A reading list manager for academic papers that works as a web app, where I can add a paper by title and author, paste in the key quotes or findings I want to save, and tag each paper with a topic so I can filter by subject later, with a clear list view in the browser showing all my papers, which ones I've finished reading, and which ones still have highlights waiting for me to review.
query_text_zh: 一个学术论文读书单管理器，作为网页应用运行，可以通过标题和作者添加一篇论文，粘贴我想保存的关键引用或发现，用主题标签每篇论文，这样我以后可以按主题筛选，在浏览器中有一个清晰的列表视图显示我所有论文，哪些我已经读完，哪些还有我需要复习的亮点。

corpus_topic: certification exam study roadmap and countdown planner
query_text: Make a study planner for certification exams as a browser-based app where I can enter my exam date and see a countdown showing exactly how many days I have left, then break the whole syllabus into topics I need to cover and set a target date for each one, with a checklist I can tick off as I go so I always know at a glance whether I'm on track or need to speed up.
query_text_zh: 我想为基础考试做一个学习计划工具，作为浏览器应用，可以输入我的考试日期并看一个倒计时显示我确切还剩多少天，然后把整个教学大纲分解为我需要覆盖的主题，为每个主题设置目标日期，有一个检查清单可以打勾，这样我始终知道一眼之间我是否走在轨道上或需要加快速度。

corpus_topic: memory technique trainer with recall test scoring
query_text: Create a memory training app for the browser where I can practice different techniques like creating stories or visual associations to memorize lists, then test myself and get a score based on how much I recalled correctly, with a history log showing all my past test scores by technique and date so I can see which methods are actually working best for me over time.
query_text_zh: 我想为浏览器创建一个记忆训练应用，可以练习不同的技巧，比如创建故事或视觉关联来记忆列表，然后测试自己并根据我能正确回忆多少得分，有一个历史日志显示按技巧和日期排列的所有往期测试分数，这样我能看到哪些方法对我来说实际上最有效。

corpus_topic: Online resume builder with ATS keyword suggestions
query_text: Need a resume builder tool that runs in the browser where I can fill in my work history, skills, and education and immediately see a clean formatted resume take shape on the right side of the screen, plus it should suggest keywords I might be missing based on the job type so my resume has a better chance of getting through automated screening, and I can download the final version when I'm done.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个在浏览器中运行的简历生成器工具，可以填入我的工作经历、技能和教育，立即看到一份格式整洁的简历在屏幕右侧成形，再加上它应该根据职位类型建议我可能遗漏的关键字，这样我的简历更有可能通过自动筛选，完成后我可以下载最终版本。

corpus_topic: Personal knowledge base with bidirectional linked notes
query_text: Build a personal notes manager as a web app where I can write notes on anything and link one note to another just by typing the note title in brackets, so clicking that link jumps me straight to the connected note, with a sidebar listing all my notes so I can navigate quickly, and a simple search that finds notes by keyword so I stop losing track of things I already wrote down somewhere.
query_text_zh: 我想为网页应用建一个个人笔记管理器，可以对任何事物写笔记并通过在方括号中输入笔记标题来将一个笔记链接到另一个笔记，这样点击链接就能直接跳转到关联笔记，侧边栏列出我所有的笔记，这样我能快速导航，一个简单的搜索按关键字查找笔记，这样我就不会丢失已经写过的东西。

corpus_topic: Web Pomodoro timer with daily session history log
query_text: Create a Pomodoro timer as a web app in the browser where I can set my focus and break lengths, start a session, and get a sound alert when each interval ends, with a log underneath that records every session I complete with the date, how many pomodoros I did, and what task I tagged the session to, so at the end of the week I can actually see where my time went.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个番茄工作法计时器网页应用，在浏览器中，可以设置我的专注和休息时长，开始一个课程，每个间隔结束时得到声音提醒，下面有个日志记录我完成的每个课程的日期、我做了多少个番茄、我标签标记的任务，这样到周末我能实际看清我的时间都去哪了。

corpus_topic: Subscription cost tracker and renewal alert calendar
query_text: Create a subscription tracker as a browser-based tool where I can add all my recurring charges with the name, cost, billing cycle, and next renewal date, see the total I'm spending each month in one clear number at the top, and get a visual calendar showing when each one is coming up so I stop getting surprised by charges I forgot about.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个订阅追踪器，作为浏览器工具，可以添加我所有的经常性费用，名字、费用、计费周期和下次续费日期，在顶部看一个清晰数字显示我每个月花多少，一个视觉化日历显示每个什么时候要来，这样我就不会被忘记的费用吓到。

corpus_topic: Personal reading list and book progress dashboard
query_text: A book tracker app for the browser where I can keep a list of everything I want to read, everything I'm currently reading, and everything I've finished, with a simple way to mark my current page so I always know where I left off, and a spot to leave a short rating and a note when I finish a book so I can look back later and remember what I thought of it.
query_text_zh: 一个浏览器的图书追踪应用，可以记录我想读的一切、正在读的一切和读完的一切，有简单方法标记我的当前页数，这样我总是知道我在哪里停的，以及一个地方让我在完成一本书时留下简短评分和笔记，这样我以后能回头看看我当时怎么想的。

corpus_topic: Daily journal with mood tagging and trend charts
query_text: A daily journal app that runs in the browser where I can write an entry each day and pick a mood from a small set of options like good, okay, rough, or great, with a chart somewhere on the app that shows how my mood has shifted over the past few weeks so I can notice if there are patterns, like always feeling low on certain days or after certain kinds of weeks.
query_text_zh: 一个在浏览器中运行的日常日记应用，可以每天写一篇条目并从好、还好、糟糕或很棒这样的小选项集中选择一个心情，应用某处有个图表显示过去几周我的心情如何变化，这样我能注意到是否有规律，比如总是在某些日子感到低落或在某些周的类型之后。

corpus_topic: Meal planner with grocery list auto-generator
query_text: Create a meal planner as a web app where I can fill in what I want to eat for each day of the week across breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and then the app pulls together a combined grocery list from all those meals so I only have to go through it once at the store, with a way to save meals I make often so I can quickly add them to future weeks.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个膳食计划工具网页应用，可以填入我想在一周中的每一天早午晚吃什么，然后应用会从所有这些膳食中汇总一份合并的购物清单，这样我在商店只用过一次，还有个方法保存我经常做的膳食，这样我能快速把它们加到未来的几周。

corpus_topic: Personal contact relationship manager for individuals
query_text: Create a personal contacts manager as a web app in the browser where I can add the people in my life with their details, a note about how I know them, and the last time I reached out, so I can actually keep track of relationships that tend to drift, with a way to flag people I want to check in with soon and see them at the top of the list as a reminder.
query_text_zh: 我想在浏览器中做一个个人通讯录管理器网页应用，可以添加我生活中的人以及他们的详情、一张关于我如何认识他们的笔记和我最后一次联系他们的时间，这样我能实际追踪那些容易淡去的关系，有个方法标记我想很快检查的人，并在列表顶部看到他们作为提醒。

corpus_topic: Password strength auditor and data breach checker
query_text: Make a web tool that checks all my saved passwords and tells me which ones are embarrassingly weak or already showing up in known hacks, because I keep reusing the same few passwords everywhere and I know that is a disaster waiting to happen. I just want to paste them in, see a clear list of which ones are dangerous, and know which accounts I need to fix first without having to understand any technical stuff.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页工具，可以检查我保存的所有密码，告诉我哪些密码特别弱或者已经出现在已知的数据泄露事件中，因为我一直在到处重复使用相同的几个密码，我知道这是个大问题。我就想把密码粘贴进去，看到哪些密码是危险的，然后知道需要优先修复哪些账户，不用理解任何技术细节。

corpus_topic: Home inventory cataloger with photo upload and search
query_text: Need a web app where I can finally catalog everything I own at home by taking photos and typing a quick description, so when something breaks or I need to find that one thing I bought two years ago I am not hunting through boxes or trying to remember where I put it. It should let me search by name or room and show me the photo so I actually know what I am looking at.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，可以最后把家里所有的东西都列出来，通过拍照和输入简短的描述，这样当东西坏掉了或者我要找那个两年前买的东西时，我就不用在各个箱子里翻找或者尽力回忆我把它放在哪里了。它应该让我按名字或房间搜索，并显示照片，这样我就真的能知道我在看什么。

corpus_topic: Personal OKR goal tracker with weekly check-ins
query_text: A simple web app where I set a few big goals for myself and then check in every week to say what I actually got done toward each one, because right now I write goals in January and never look at them again until December when I feel bad about myself. Something that keeps track of whether I am making progress week by week so I stop kidding myself about how productive I am.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个简单的网页应用，让我给自己设定几个大目标，然后每周签到一次说说我实际朝每个目标取得了什么进展，因为现在我在一月份写下目标，然后再也不看它们，直到十二月份才觉得自己特别失败。这个应用应该能追踪我每周是否在取得进展，这样我就不会再骗自己我有多高效了。

corpus_topic: Flashcard deck builder with spaced-repetition scheduler
query_text: Create a web app where I can build sets of study cards for whatever I am trying to memorize, and it automatically decides which ones to show me again sooner because I keep getting them wrong, instead of me having to flip through everything equally when some stuff I already know cold. I want to add cards, practice on my laptop browser, and not have to relearn things I already nailed last week.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网页应用，让我为任何我要记忆的东西制作学习卡集合，它会自动判断哪些我经常答错的卡片应该更快地再次显示，而不用我在我全都知道的东西和我答错的东西之间平均地翻转。我想添加卡片，在笔记本电脑浏览器上练习，并且不用重新学习我上周已经掌握的东西。

corpus_topic: Travel itinerary planner with per-day budget breakdown
query_text: Create a web app where I plan out a trip day by day and also track what everything costs so I actually know if I am going over budget before I am already on the plane, because every time I travel I just guess at prices and then panic when my card gets charged more than expected. I want to see each day laid out with activities and a running total so nothing surprises me.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网页应用，让我逐天规划一次旅行，同时追踪所有东西的成本，这样我在上飞机之前就能真的知道我是否会超出预算，因为每次我旅行时就是猜测价格，然后当我的卡被刷超出预期金额时就开始恐慌。我想看到每天都排列出来的活动和一个运行的总计，这样就没有什么会让我惊讶。

corpus_topic: Personal time-audit log and weekly productivity report
query_text: Need a web tool that lets me log what I spend my time on each day in my browser, then at the end of the week shows me a report of where all those hours actually went, because I always feel busy but have no idea if I am busy on things that matter or just wasting hours on stuff that does not move anything forward. Just simple logging and a weekly summary I can actually use.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页工具，可以让我在浏览器中每天记录我在做什么，然后周末时给我一个报告，显示那些小时到底去了哪里，因为我总是感觉很忙，但不知道我是在忙着重要的事情还是在浪费时间做些不能推动任何事情前进的东西。只需要简单的日志记录和一个我真的能用的周总结。

corpus_topic: 摄影师作品站
query_text: A photography portfolio website where the photos themselves do all the talking and nothing else gets in the way, with a clean full-width layout that feels like walking through a calm gallery rather than scrolling a busy feed. The whole thing should feel quiet and spacious in a browser, like the white space matters as much as the images, with a simple way to organize work into different series or projects.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个摄影作品集网站，让照片本身做所有的说话，其他任何东西都不会挡道，有一个清洁的全宽布局，感觉像走过一个平静的画廊而不是滚动繁忙的信息流。整个东西在浏览器中应该感觉安静和宽敞，就像白色空间和图像一样重要，有一个简单的方式来将作品组织成不同的系列或项目。

corpus_topic: Illustrator showcase site with animated artwork reveals
query_text: Make a website for an illustrator where the artwork kind of comes alive as you scroll through it in a browser, with each piece revealing itself in a way that feels intentional and a little magical rather than just appearing all at once. The overall mood should feel like flipping through a beautiful art book, with enough breathing room between pieces that each one gets its own moment to land.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个插画师制作一个网站，当你在浏览器中滚动浏览时，艺术品有点像活过来一样，每个作品以一种感觉意图明确和有点魔幻的方式展现自己，而不是所有的全部一下子出现。整体的感觉应该像翻阅一本美丽的艺术书，在作品之间有足够的呼吸空间，这样每件作品都能有自己的时刻来落地。

corpus_topic: Motion designer reel site with video loop previews
query_text: Create a personal site for a motion designer where short video clips loop quietly in the background of each project, giving visitors a feel for the work before they even click anything, and the whole site in a desktop browser feels kinetic and alive rather than static like a resume. The navigation should feel like it has its own subtle sense of motion, matching the energy of the work being shown.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个运动设计师创建一个个人网站，短视频剪辑在每个项目的背景中安静地循环，让访客在点击任何东西之前就能感受到工作，整个网站在桌面浏览器中感觉是动感且活跃的，而不是像简历那样的静态。导航应该感觉有自己微妙的运动感，与正在展示的工作的能量相匹配。

corpus_topic: 3D character artist portfolio with WebGL model viewer
query_text: Build a portfolio site for a 3D character artist where visitors can actually spin and look at character models right in their browser without needing to download anything, because seeing a 3D figure from only one angle is like reviewing a sculpture from a photo. The rest of the site should feel dark and atmospheric, like a game title screen, giving the characters room to feel dramatic and alive.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个三维角色艺术家建立一个作品集网站，访客可以在浏览器中直接旋转和查看角色模型，不需要下载任何东西，因为只从一个角度看三维人物就像是从照片中评审雕塑一样。网站的其余部分应该感觉黑暗且富有气氛，像游戏标题屏幕，给角色空间来感觉戏剧化和生动。

corpus_topic: Typeface designer specimen site showcasing original fonts
query_text: Build a site where a typeface designer can show off the fonts they have made by displaying them at big beautiful sizes in a browser so visitors actually feel what each typeface is like to read, with the ability to type something and watch it render live in each font. The site itself should feel typographically considered, like someone who genuinely cares about letters designed every detail.
query_text_zh: 我想建立一个网站，让一个字体设计师可以通过在浏览器中大尺寸显示他们制作的字体来展示，这样访客真的能感受到每种字体阅读起来的样子，并且有能力输入内容然后实时看到它在每种字体中的呈现。网站本身应该感觉在排版上是经过深思熟虑的，就像真正关心字母的人设计了每个细节。

corpus_topic: Author book showcase with chapter excerpt previews
query_text: Need a website for an author where each book gets its own visual personality and visitors can read a few paragraphs of each one right there in the browser to get a taste of the writing before deciding to buy, rather than just seeing a cover and a blurb. The whole site should feel literary and warm, like a cozy independent bookshop, not like an online storefront.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个作者的网站，其中每本书都有自己的视觉个性，访客可以在浏览器中直接读到每本书的几个段落来品尝写作风格再决定是否购买，而不仅仅是看到封面和简介。整个网站应该感觉文学且温暖，像一个舒适的独立书店，而不是像一个在线商店。

corpus_topic: Indie filmmaker project archive with embedded trailers
query_text: Create a site for an indie filmmaker where each project has its own page with the trailer playing right there in the browser and some notes about how it was made, because the story behind a film is often as interesting as the film itself. The archive of projects should feel like a collection worth exploring rather than a filmography list, with each title having its own visual mood.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个独立电影制作人创建一个网站，每个项目都有自己的页面，预告片直接在浏览器中播放，并且有关于它如何制作的一些笔记，因为电影背后的故事往往和电影本身一样有趣。项目的档案应该感觉像一个值得探索的收藏，而不是一个电影学列表，每个标题都有自己的视觉氛围。

corpus_topic: Musician discography showcase with album artwork gallery
query_text: Create a site where a musician can lay out their whole catalog album by album in the browser with the cover artwork front and center, because album art is part of the music and deserves to be seen big rather than tiny. Each album should feel like its own world when you open it, with a way to hear a clip and see the track listing, and the overall site should feel like it was made by someone who takes music seriously.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网站，让一个音乐家可以在浏览器中逐个专辑地展示他们的整个音乐目录，专辑封面是重点，因为专辑艺术是音乐的一部分，应该大尺寸地看到而不是很小。每个专辑打开时应该感觉像自己的一个世界，有一个方式可以听到片段并看到曲目列表，整个网站应该感觉像是由某个重视音乐的人制作的。

corpus_topic: Architecture studio project gallery with floor plan viewer
query_text: Create a portfolio site for an architecture studio where each project has a gallery of photos alongside a floor plan you can actually look at properly in the browser, because architecture lives in the relationship between how something looks and how it is laid out spatially. The site should feel precise and considered, with generous white space and a calm confidence that matches the kind of work being shown.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个建筑工作室创建一个作品集网站，每个项目都有一个照片库以及一个在浏览器中可以恰当查看的平面图，因为建筑存在于东西看起来如何以及它在空间上如何布局之间的关系中。网站应该感觉精确且经过深思熟虑，有充足的白色空间和与所展示的工作类型相匹配的平静信心。

corpus_topic: Fashion designer digital lookbook with editorial photography
query_text: Need a digital lookbook site for a fashion designer that lets the editorial photography really breathe in a browser, with big full-screen images that feel like they belong in a magazine rather than a shopping site, and a way to move through collections that feels as considered as the clothes themselves. The whole experience should feel like taste, not commerce, even though there might be some way to get in touch at the end.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个时尚设计师的数字参考书网站，让编辑摄影在浏览器中真的能呼吸，有大的全屏图像感觉像属于杂志而不是购物网站，并且一个浏览系列的方式感觉和服装本身一样经过深思熟虑。整个体验应该感觉像品味，而不是商业，尽管最后可能有某种方式来联系。

corpus_topic: Interior designer project showcase with before-and-after sliders
query_text: An interior design portfolio site where each project has a before-and-after comparison you can drag back and forth in a browser to see the transformation, because before-and-after photos side by side never quite capture how dramatic the change actually was. The site should feel warm and residential, like the designer has a strong point of view, not clinical like a home improvement catalog.
query_text_zh: 我想建立一个室内设计作品集网站，其中每个项目都有一个前后对比，你可以在浏览器中拖来拖去看到改造，因为前后照片并排从来都不能恰好捕捉改变到底有多戏剧化。网站应该感觉温暖且住宅化，像设计师有强烈的观点，不像房屋改善目录那样的临床。

corpus_topic: Indie game developer showcase with embedded playable demos
query_text: A showcase site for an indie game developer where little playable demos are actually embedded right in the browser so visitors can try a few minutes of each game without downloading anything, because nothing sells a game like touching it. Each game should get its own section with a bit of story about how it was made, and the overall site should feel like it was built by someone who genuinely loves games rather than trying to look professional.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个独立游戏开发者创建一个展示网站，小的可玩演示直接嵌入在浏览器中，这样访客可以尝试几分钟的每个游戏而不用下载任何东西，因为没有什么比接触游戏更能卖游戏。每个游戏应该有自己的部分，有关于它如何制作的一点故事，整个网站应该感觉像是由真正热爱游戏的人建造的，而不是试图看起来专业。

corpus_topic: Product designer case study portfolio with process documentation
query_text: Create a portfolio site for a product designer where each case study walks through the whole process from messy early sketches to the final thing, because showing only the polished result never explains what made the design actually hard or interesting. The site in a desktop browser should feel organized but not sterile, like someone laid out a really well-edited sketchbook rather than a slide deck.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个产品设计师创建一个作品集网站，其中每个案例研究都介绍了从凌乱的早期草图到最终产品的整个过程，因为只显示抛光的结果永远不能解释是什么让设计真的困难或有趣。桌面浏览器中的网站应该感觉有组织但不是无菌的，就像某人布局了一本真的编辑得很好的素描本，而不是幻灯片放映。

corpus_topic: UX designer portfolio with interactive prototype embeds
query_text: Make a portfolio site for a UX designer where each project has interactive prototypes actually embedded so visitors can click around and feel the thing rather than just look at screenshots in a browser, because the whole point of UX is how something behaves and static images cannot convey that. The site should feel clean and thoughtful with just enough personality to show there is a real designer behind it.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个用户体验设计师制作一个作品集网站，其中每个项目都有实际嵌入的交互原型，这样访客可以点击并感受这个东西，而不仅仅是在浏览器中查看截图，因为用户体验的整个点是东西如何表现，静态图像不能传达这一点。网站应该感觉干净且周到，有足够的个性来显示背后有一个真实的设计师。

corpus_topic: 灵感笔记本
query_text: Need a web app that works like a beautiful notebook for saving ideas, images, quotes, and half-formed thoughts in a browser, something that feels genuinely lovely to open rather than utilitarian, because the aesthetic of the place where I keep my ideas actually affects whether I want to add to it or avoid it. It should feel like a private creative space with a visual quality that makes browsing through old entries feel like a small pleasure.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，有点像一个美丽的笔记本，可以在浏览器中保存想法、图像、引语和未成形的思想，一些真的很好打开而不是功利性的东西，因为我保存想法的地方的美学实际上会影响我是否想添加到它或避免它。它应该感觉像一个有视觉品质的私人创意空间，使得浏览旧条目感觉像一个小愉快。

corpus_topic: Personal essay publishing platform for independent writers
query_text: A personal publishing site where an independent writer can put their essays up in a browser reading experience that actually respects the writing, with generous line spacing and a typeface that makes you want to settle in rather than skim, because most free publishing platforms feel like they were designed for content quantity rather than reading quality. Each piece should feel considered and worth sitting with.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个个人出版网站，其中一个独立作家可以在浏览器中出版他们的文章到一个真的尊重写作的阅读体验，有慷慨的行间距和一种字体，让你想要安定下来而不是快速浏览，因为大多数免费出版平台感觉像是为了内容数量而设计的，而不是阅读质量。每篇文章应该感觉经过深思熟虑且值得坐下来阅读。

corpus_topic: Long-form article portfolio site for freelance journalists
query_text: Make a portfolio site for a freelance journalist where long articles are presented with a reading experience that feels like a good magazine in a browser, with a clean layout that honors the length and seriousness of the work rather than treating it like a blog post. There should be a way to filter by topic or publication so the breadth of the work is apparent without everything feeling jumbled together.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个自由记者制作一个作品集网站，其中长文章以感觉像浏览器中好杂志的阅读体验来呈现，有一个干净的布局，尊重工作的长度和严肃性，而不是将其视为博客帖子。应该有一种方式按主题或出版物过滤，这样工作的广度是显而易见的，而不会让一切都感觉混乱在一起。

corpus_topic: Weekly digest curation site for niche topic communities
query_text: Make a weekly digest site for a niche community where one person curates the most interesting links and thoughts from that week and presents them in a browser as something worth reading slowly rather than scanning, because the best curation has a voice and a point of view rather than just being a list of links. Each edition should feel like a letter to people who care about the same things.
query_text_zh: 我想为一个利基社区制作一个周摘要网站，其中一个人策划那一周最有趣的链接和想法，然后在浏览器中将其呈现为值得慢慢阅读而不是扫描的东西，因为最好的策划有一个声音和观点，而不仅仅是一个链接列表。每一期应该感觉像一封给关心同样事情的人的信。

corpus_topic: Serialized fiction publishing site for independent novelists
query_text: Make a site where an independent novelist can publish their story chapter by chapter in a browser reading experience that feels immersive and unhurried, with a way for readers to follow along as new chapters come out and easily pick up where they left off, because serialized fiction deserves a home that feels like reading rather than browsing. The design should get out of the way of the story and let the writing do its work.
query_text_zh: 我想建立一个网站，其中一个独立小说家可以在浏览器中逐章发布他们的故事到一个感觉沉浸和不急促的阅读体验，有一种方式让读者跟随新章节的出现并轻松地从他们停止的地方继续，因为序列化小说值得一个感觉像阅读而不是浏览的家。设计应该让开路给故事，让写作做它的工作。

corpus_topic: Illustrated webcomic hosting and subscription platform
query_text: Create a webcomic hosting and subscription app for desktop browsers where the whole thing feels like flipping through a beautifully bound indie zine, with a warm illustrated cover for each series and a reading view that lets the panels breathe with generous white space around them, and subscribers can browse an artist's full archive from a side panel that feels curated rather than cluttered.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器创建一个网络漫画托管和订阅应用，整个东西感觉像翻阅一个精美装订的独立杂志，每个系列有一个温暖的插图封面，阅读视图让面板有白色空间的呼吸，订户可以从一个感觉策划而不是混乱的侧面板浏览艺术家的完整档案。

corpus_topic: Food writing and recipe essay portfolio site
query_text: Create a food writing and recipe essay portfolio site that feels like a beloved cookbook crossed with a personal journal, where each essay gets a full-width hero image that sets the mood and the recipe itself lives below the prose in a clean, readable layout, with a quiet sidebar listing past pieces organized loosely by season so the whole web app has an unhurried, editorial feel.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个美食写作和食谱散文作品集网站，感觉像一本深爱的食谱书与一个个人日记的交叉，其中每篇散文都有一个全宽英雄图像来设定氛围，食谱本身在散文下方的一个干净、可读的布局中，有一个安静的侧栏列出了按季节大致组织的过去作品，所以整个网页应用有一个不急促、编辑的感觉。

corpus_topic: Travel narrative and photo essay publishing site
query_text: A travel narrative and photo essay publishing app for desktop browsers where each story opens with a full-bleed atmospheric photo that bleeds edge to edge, then flows into the writing in a wide, typographically rich column that feels like a long-read magazine piece, with a soft map thumbnail somewhere on the right that anchors the place without overpowering the mood of the whole thing.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器制作一个旅行叙述和照片散文出版应用，其中每个故事都以一个从边到边流血的全出血大气照片开始，然后流入到一个宽、排版丰富的列中的写作，感觉像一个长读杂志文章，有一个柔软的地图缩略图在右边某处，锚定地方而不压倒整个事物的氛围。

corpus_topic: Digital garden site for personal knowledge and notes
query_text: Build a digital garden app for desktop browsers that feels like wandering through someone's beautifully annotated library rather than scrolling a feed, where notes connect to each other through underlined words that reveal related ideas when you hover, and the whole website has an aged-paper warmth to it with a sidebar that shows recently tended notes so the garden always feels alive.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器建立一个数字花园应用，感觉像漫步穿过某人精美注释的图书馆，而不是滚动信息流，其中笔记通过带下划线的单词相互连接，当你悬停时展现相关想法，整个网站有一个老纸的温暖到它，有一个侧栏显示最近整理的笔记，所以花园总是感觉活跃。

corpus_topic: Public reading list with annotations and commentary site
query_text: Need a public reading list and annotations website that looks and feels like a hand-curated shelf, where each book entry shows a small cover image alongside a short personal note about why it mattered, and readers can browse by mood or theme using a soft filter row at the top, all of it for desktop browsers in a layout that feels unhurried and genuinely like a person made it.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个公共阅读清单和注释网站，看起来和感觉像一个手工策划的书架，其中每个书籍条目显示一个小封面图像以及一个关于为什么它重要的简短个人笔记，读者可以通过顶部的柔软过滤行按心情或主题浏览，所有的为桌面浏览器在一个感觉不急促和真的像一个人制作的布局。

corpus_topic: Podcast show notes and transcript publishing hub
query_text: Build a podcast show notes and transcript publishing app for desktop browsers where each episode page feels like a beautifully typeset article, with the full transcript in a clean two-column layout that pairs episode chapters on the left with the flowing text on the right, and a row of past episodes at the bottom styled like record sleeves so the whole site has a warm, editorial personality.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器建立一个播客节目笔记和抄本出版应用，其中每个情节页面感觉像一个精美排版的文章，整个抄本在一个干净的两列布局中，在左边配对情节章节，在右边流动文本，底部有一行过去的情节，像唱片套一样的风格，所以整个网站有一个温暖、编辑的个性。

corpus_topic: Video essay script and research notes publishing site
query_text: Make a video essay script and research notes publishing site for desktop browsers that has the feel of a thoughtful writer sharing their process, where each essay lives in a clean long-read layout with the main text on one side and highlighted research snippets in a softer column beside it, and the home screen of the app shows a gallery of essay covers styled like film stills with the title and a one-line description.
query_text_zh: 我想为桌面浏览器制作一个视频散文脚本和研究笔记出版网站，有一个有思想的作家分享他们过程的感觉，其中每篇散文在一个干净的长读布局中生活，主要文本在一边，突出研究片段在它旁边的柔软列中，应用的主屏幕显示一个散文封面的画廊，样式像电影剧照，带有标题和一行描述。

corpus_topic: Photography portfolio with behind-the-scenes writing blog
query_text: Need a photography portfolio and behind-the-scenes writing website for desktop browsers that feels like an artist's studio rather than a commercial showcase, where each photo series has its own richly atmospheric page with full-width images that you scroll through slowly, and a blog section tucked below each series tells the story of how the shoot came together in the photographer's own honest, unpolished voice.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个摄影作品集和幕后写作网站，为桌面浏览器，感觉像一个艺术家的工作室而不是一个商业展示，其中每个照片系列都有自己的丰富大气页面，有全宽图像，你缓慢地滚动浏览，博客部分在每个系列下方讲述拍摄如何在摄影师自己的诚实、未抛光的声音中汇聚的故事。

corpus_topic: Build-in-public project documentation and update site
query_text: Build a build-in-public project documentation site that feels like a well-loved field journal, where each update entry has a date and a short title and the writing itself has an honest, scrappy energy that suits the genre, and visitors browsing the web app can follow the whole arc of the project through a timeline on the left side that shows every milestone as a small illustrated marker.
query_text_zh: 我想建立一个公开建造项目文档网站，感觉像一本被深爱的田野日志，其中每个更新条目都有一个日期和一个简短的标题，写作本身有一个诚实、邋遢的能量，适合这个类型，访客浏览网页应用可以通过左边的时间线跟踪项目的整个弧，显示每个里程碑为一个小插图标记。

corpus_topic: creator affiliate link hub and tracking page
query_text: Create a creator affiliate link hub and tracking tool that is mine in a way that feels intentional, not like a generic link tree clone, so the website has my color palette and a short line of text above each link that tells visitors why I actually recommend the thing, and I can see at a glance in the same place which links are getting clicks so I stop guessing.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个创造者联属链接中心和追踪工具，这是我的，以一个感觉有意的方式，而不是像一个通用的链接树克隆，所以网站有我的调色板和每个链接上方的一短行文本，告诉访客我为什么真的推荐这个东西，我可以在同一个地方一眼看到哪些链接正在获得点击，所以我停止猜测。

corpus_topic: independent artist merch storefront site
query_text: Make a merch storefront website for independent artists that carries the identity of the work itself rather than looking like a generic shop, where each product page shows the piece it came from alongside the item so people understand what they are buying into, and the whole web app has a personality that fits my aesthetic so visitors feel they are inside the world of my art, not just browsing a catalogue.
query_text_zh: 我想为独立艺术家制作一个商品店面网站，承载工作本身的身份，而不是看起来像一个通用的商店，其中每个产品页面显示它来自的作品以及项目，这样人们理解他们买进去的是什么，整个网页应用有一个符合我美学的个性，这样访客感觉他们在我艺术的世界内部，而不仅仅是浏览目录。

corpus_topic: limited-edition digital download sales page
query_text: Build a limited-edition digital download sales app that has the right kind of scarcity energy, where the website clearly shows how many copies remain and a countdown if there is a closing date, and each product has its own full-page moment with a preview of the actual file so buyers know exactly what they are getting, all in a design that feels considered rather than rushed.
query_text_zh: 我想建立一个限量版数字下载销售应用，有正确的稀缺能量，其中网站清楚地显示还剩多少份，如果有一个截止日期就有一个倒计时，每个产品都有自己的整页时刻，有实际文件的预览，这样买家知道他们确切地得到什么，全部在一个感觉经过深思熟虑而不是匆匆忙忙的设计中。

corpus_topic: creator media kit and press page
query_text: Create a creator media kit and press page that actually represents who I am rather than reading like a corporate one-sheet, with a website that shows my audience numbers alongside real quotes from collaborations I have done, and a clear section where brands can understand my content style and rates without me having to write the same email thirty times.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个创造者媒体工具和新闻页面，真的代表我是谁，而不是读起来像一个公司的单页，有一个网站显示我的观众数字以及我做过的合作的真实引语，一个清晰的部分，品牌可以理解我的内容风格和费率，不用我写相同的电子邮件三十次。

corpus_topic: online course launch waitlist landing page
query_text: Need a course launch waitlist website that earns the sign-up rather than just demanding an email address, so there is a real explanation of what the course covers and a spot where people can say what they are hoping to learn, and the whole web app has a tone that matches mine so it feels like a conversation rather than a funnel.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个课程发布等待列表网站，赚取注册而不仅仅是要求电子邮件地址，所以有一个关于课程覆盖内容的真实解释，一个地方人们可以说他们希望学到什么，整个网页应用有一个与我的音调相匹配的音调，所以它感觉像一个对话，而不是一个漏斗。

corpus_topic: brand sponsorship pitch deck site for creators
query_text: Build a brand sponsorship pitch site for creators that does the talking for me when I send it to potential partners, where the web app covers my niche, my audience, and what a collaboration actually looks like with past examples that feel genuine rather than self-congratulatory, and the whole thing has a clean structure so a brand person can find the numbers they need without me on a call explaining.
query_text_zh: 我想为创造者建立一个品牌赞助投球网站，当我将其发送给潜在的合作伙伴时代表我说话，其中网页应用涵盖我的利基、我的观众和合作看起来实际上像什么，有过去的例子感觉真实而不是自鸣得意，整个东西有一个干净的结构，这样品牌人员可以找到他们需要的数字，而不用我在电话上解释。

corpus_topic: newsletter sign-up with lead magnet landing page
query_text: Build a newsletter sign-up and lead magnet site that feels like the actual newsletter rather than some separate marketing machine, where the web app explains exactly what subscribers get and lets them download the free thing right away after signing up, and the design has the same voice and visual personality as the rest of what I make so nothing feels off or borrowed.
query_text_zh: 我想建立一个通讯注册和引导磁铁网站，感觉像实际的通讯而不是某个单独的营销机器，其中网页应用精确地解释订户得到什么，并让他们在注册后立即下载免费的东西，设计有与我制作的其余部分相同的声音和视觉个性，所以没有什么感觉错误或借来的。

corpus_topic: podcast season premiere announcement page
query_text: Make a podcast season premiere announcement website that builds real anticipation rather than just listing an episode date, where the web app sets the mood with the season artwork front and center and includes a trailer that plays right there in the browser, and visitors can sign up to be notified on release day so I have something concrete to point people toward in the weeks leading up to it.

corpus_topic: community-run creative writing prompt archive and leaderboard
query_text: Build a web archive for creative writing prompts where the community can submit new prompts, others can upvote their favorites so the best ones rise to the top, writers can post their responses to a prompt right on the page, and there is a leaderboard showing who has responded to the most prompts or gotten the most upvotes, so it feels like a fun ongoing thing you can dip into whenever you need a spark to get writing.
query_text_zh: 建立一个创意写作提示的网络档案库，社区可以提交新提示，其他人可以赞成他们的最爱这样最好的提示升到顶部，作家可以直接在页面上发布他们对提示的回应，有一个排行榜显示谁对最多提示做了回应或获得最多赞成，这样感觉像一个有趣的持续进行的事情，你可以随时用它来激发写作。

corpus_topic: fan translation community for indie manga and webcomics
query_text: Need a web app for a fan translation community focused on indie manga and webcomics, where members can post their translation work for a title, leave line-by-line notes explaining tricky word choices, and vote on which version reads best, with a sidebar listing all active projects so you can hop between them while sitting at your desktop.
query_text_zh: 需要一个为粉丝翻译社区服务的网页应用，专门针对独立漫画和网络漫画，成员可以为某部作品发布他们的翻译版本，留下逐行注解来解释难懂的词汇选择，还能投票选出最好读的版本，侧边栏列出所有活跃项目，这样坐在桌面电脑前就能轻松在不同项目间切换。

corpus_topic: creator mentorship matchmaking platform for emerging artists
query_text: Create a browser-based matchmaking platform for emerging artists who want to find a mentor in their creative field, where artists can fill out a short profile about what they make and what kind of guidance they are looking for, and experienced creators can list the areas they are happy to teach, so the site can suggest good pairings and let both sides send a message to start the conversation.
query_text_zh: 创建一个浏览器平台，帮助新兴艺术家找到自己创意领域的导师，艺术家可以填一份简短的个人资料说明自己做什么和需要什么指导，经验丰富的创作者则可以列出他们愿意教授的领域，网站会推荐合适的配对，让双方都能发消息开启对话。

corpus_topic: collaborative worldbuilding wiki for fiction writer communities
query_text: Make a web app that works like a shared wiki for fiction writer groups who are building a story world together, where anyone in the group can add pages for places, characters, and rules of the world, link those pages to each other, and leave comments when they spot something that conflicts with what someone else already wrote, all laid out so you can browse the whole wiki from a left-side list while editing in the main area.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，像是为一起创作故事世界的小说创作小组专用的共享wiki，组内任何人都能添加地点、人物和世界规则的页面，页面之间可以相互链接，看到冲突的地方时可以留言指出与他人已写内容的不一致，整个布局左侧是导航列表，右侧主区域可以编辑内容。

corpus_topic: video essay community with annotated viewing and debate threads
query_text: Need a website that brings together people who love watching and talking about video essays, where you can open a video and type time-stamped notes right alongside it as it plays, then others can reply to those notes and start a threaded debate about the argument the creator is making, so the whole discussion stays attached to the exact moment in the video it is about.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网站，汇聚热爱观看和讨论视频论文的人，可以打开视频后在旁边打带时间戳的注解，当视频播放时可以立刻记录想法，其他人能回复这些注解并展开讨论作者论点的话题讨论，整个讨论串始终与视频中的具体时刻关联。

corpus_topic: Web-based storyboard creator for video producers
query_text: Make a web-based storyboard creator for video producers where you can add a row of panels, drop a rough sketch or placeholder image into each one, type the shot description and dialogue underneath, then rearrange the panels by dragging them around until the sequence feels right, so the whole board is visible across the screen at once without scrolling sideways.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页分镜脚本创作工具，专门给视频制作人用，可以添加一行行的镜头，每个镜头可以放粗略素描或占位图片，下面写上镜头描述和台词，然后通过拖拽重新排列镜头直到顺序满意为止，整个分镜脚本要在屏幕上一次性显示完，不用横向滚动。

corpus_topic: Online screenplay formatter and collaboration editor
query_text: Create a browser-based screenplay editor that automatically formats your script the way industry scripts look, with scene headings, action lines, and character names all snapping into the right style as you type, and a sidebar where a writing partner can leave notes on specific lines so you two can go back and forth on revisions without sending files back and forth.
query_text_zh: 创建一个浏览器剧本编辑器，自动按行业剧本的格式排版，场景标题、动作描述、人物名字都会自动调整到正确样式，侧边栏让合作编剧可以在特定行留注评论，两个人可以来回讨论修改，不用互相传文件。

corpus_topic: Creative writing prompt randomizer and session tracker
query_text: Need a web app that spits out a random creative writing prompt when you click a button, then lets you write directly in the same page and tracks how many minutes you spent on that session, so over time you can look back at a simple log showing which prompts you tackled, how long each session ran, and any short notes you left yourself about how it went.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网页应用，点击按钮就能生成随机创意写作提示，然后可以在同一个页面直接开始写作，系统会记录这个写作环节花了多少分钟，随着时间推移，可以回顾一份简单的日志，显示你写过哪些提示、每个环节花了多长时间，还有你给自己留下的关于效果如何的简短备注。

corpus_topic: Font pairing preview and download tool for designers
query_text: Make a browser tool where you can browse font combinations and see them previewed together in a sample heading and body text block, so you can quickly compare how different pairs look side by side, and when you find one you like you can grab the download link or copy the name right from the same spot without jumping to another site.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器工具，可以浏览字体组合并在示例标题和正文文本块中预览它们搭配的效果，这样可以快速比较不同字体对在并排显示时的效果，找到喜欢的组合后，可以直接从同一个位置获取下载链接或复制字体名称，无需跳转到其他网站。

corpus_topic: Color palette generator from uploaded reference images
query_text: A color palette tool for desktop browsers where you upload a photo or reference image and the app pulls out the main colors it finds, showing them as a row of swatches with the exact hex codes listed below each one, and you can click any swatch to swap it out or fine-tune the shade until the palette feels just right for whatever project you are working on.
query_text_zh: 做一个桌面浏览器的色彩调色板工具，上传一张照片或参考图片，应用自动提取主要颜色，显示为一行颜色样本，每个下面列出十六进制代码，可以点击任何样本来替换或微调色调直到调色板完全符合项目需求。

corpus_topic: Podcast episode planner and show notes editor
query_text: Need a web app that helps podcast hosts plan episodes and write their show notes in one place, where you can outline the talking points for an episode in a simple list on one side and type up the full show notes in a text area on the other side, then save each episode so you have a tidy archive you can go back to when you need to reference what you covered.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网页应用帮助播客主持人规划剧集和在一个地方写节目说明，一侧可以用简单列表列出某个剧集的讨论要点，另一侧用文本框写完整的节目说明，保存每个剧集后就有一个整洁的存档，需要时可以回顾自己讲过的内容。

corpus_topic: Drag-and-drop mood board builder with image import
query_text: Create a web app mood board builder where you can pull in images from your computer, move them around freely on a big open canvas in the browser, resize them, and stack them however you like, so you end up with a visual collage that captures the feeling or style you are going for before you start a design or creative project.
query_text_zh: 创建一个网页应用情绪板生成工具，可以从电脑上传入图片，在浏览器的大空白画布上自由移动它们，改变大小，随意堆叠，最后得到一个视觉拼贴，捕捉你想要的感觉或风格，为后续的设计或创意项目做准备。

corpus_topic: Lyric writing workspace with rhyme and syllable engine
query_text: Make a lyric writing app for desktop browsers where you type your lyrics in a big clean editor and a panel on the side suggests words that rhyme with whatever word you highlight, plus shows you the syllable count for each line so you can hear in your head whether the rhythm is landing right, and you can save multiple songs and switch between them from a list.
query_text_zh: 做一个桌面浏览器的歌词写作应用，可以在大而整洁的编辑器中打字，侧边的面板会对你高亮的词建议押韵词，同时显示每行的音节数，这样可以在脑子里检验节奏是否顺畅，可以保存多首歌曲并从列表中切换。

corpus_topic: YouTube thumbnail A/B testing and mockup designer
query_text: Build a web app for YouTube creators who want to test different thumbnail ideas before publishing, where you can upload two or three thumbnail images side by side on the desktop screen and see them mocked up as they would look in a real search result row, then leave notes on each version about what you like or want to change before picking the one to go with.
query_text_zh: 构建一个给YouTube创作者测试不同缩略图想法的网页应用，在桌面屏幕上并排上传两三张缩略图，看它们在真实搜索结果行中的效果模拟，为每个版本留下关于你喜欢或想改进的地方的注解，最后选择你满意的那个。

corpus_topic: Brand identity kit generator for independent creators
query_text: A brand kit generator for independent creators, running in the browser, where you answer a handful of questions about your style and vibe and the app assembles a simple starter kit with a suggested color set, a couple of font choices, and a preview showing how they all look together on a sample page, so you have something consistent to use across your work right away.
query_text_zh: 做一个为独立创作者设计的品牌工具包生成器，在浏览器中运行，回答几个关于你风格和气质的问题，应用就会生成一个简单的入门工具包，包括建议的色彩集、几个字体选择，以及在示例页面上展示它们搭配效果的预览，这样你立刻就能在各项工作中保持一致的品牌形象。

corpus_topic: Newsletter template builder for indie writers and journalists
query_text: Make a web app newsletter builder for indie writers and small journalists, where you pick from a handful of clean layouts and then fill in the sections with your own text and images, seeing a live preview of how the finished newsletter will look in an email client, and you can save multiple templates so each publication you run can have its own consistent look.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页新闻通讯生成器，给独立写手和小型记者用，可以从几个整洁的版式模板中选择，然后填入自己的文字和图片内容，实时预览完成后的新闻通讯在邮件客户端中的效果，可以保存多个模板这样你运营的每份出版物都能有自己一致的外观。

corpus_topic: Subtitle and closed caption editor for video content
query_text: Need a browser-based tool for editing subtitles and closed captions for videos, where you can load a video file and see the transcript lines listed alongside the playback with their start and end times, then click any line to fix the text or nudge the timing, and export the finished captions file when you are done, all without installing anything.
query_text_zh: 需要一个浏览器工具用于编辑视频字幕和闭路字幕，可以加载视频文件，在旁边看到带有开始和结束时间的字幕行列表，点击任何一行都能改正文字或调整时间，完成后导出字幕文件，所有这些都不需要安装任何软件。

corpus_topic: AI image prompt library with version history and tags
query_text: Make a web app library for saving the text prompts you use with AI image tools, where each prompt has a version history so you can see how you changed it over time, and you can add your own labels to group prompts by project or style, then search across your whole collection from a bar at the top of the desktop layout to find the right one fast.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用库，用于保存你用AI图像工具创建的文本提示，每个提示都有版本历史可以看到你如何修改过它，可以添加自己的标签按项目或风格对提示分组，然后从桌面布局顶部的搜索栏快速搜索整个收藏找到你需要的提示。

corpus_topic: Character and world-building wiki for fiction authors
query_text: Make a wiki-style web app for fiction authors to keep track of their characters and story world details, where each character or place gets its own page you can fill in with whatever notes matter for your story, pages can link to each other so you can jump from a character to the town they live in, and a left-side list shows all your entries so you never lose track of what you have already written.
query_text_zh: 做一个虚构小说创作者用的wiki式网页应用，用来追踪人物和故事世界的细节，每个人物或地点都有自己的页面，可以填入对你的故事重要的任何笔记，页面之间可以相互链接这样你能从一个人物跳到他们住的城镇，左侧列表显示所有条目这样你永远不会遗忘已经写过什么。

corpus_topic: Freelance photographer portfolio with client testimonials
query_text: Create a portfolio website for a freelance photographer that feels personal and considered, not generic, where the work is displayed in a clean gallery with room for the photos to breathe, each project has a short story behind it, and a separate section holds client words in a way that reads like a genuine recommendation rather than a wall of star ratings, all designed for desktop browsers.
query_text_zh: 为自由摄影师创建作品集网站，要有个人特色和用心设计感，而不是通用模板感，作品在整洁的相册中展示，照片有足够的呼吸空间，每个项目都讲述背后的故事，单独的部分展示客户评价以营造真诚推荐的阅读感，而不是堆砌星级评分，整个网站为桌面浏览器设计。

corpus_topic: Independent web designer work showcase site
query_text: Need a website for an independent web designer to show off their work with real taste and personality, not just a thumbnail grid, where each project gets its own page with the story of how it came together, the site has a strong point of view in how it looks and feels, and visitors on desktop can tell immediately that this person has a specific sensibility, not just a portfolio template anyone could fill in.
query_text_zh: 需要一个为独立网页设计师展示作品的网站，具有真实品味和个人特色而不仅仅是缩略图网格，每个项目都有自己的页面讲述它是如何完成的故事，网站从整体外观和感受上都表现出强烈的观点，桌面访客能立刻看出这个人有独特的品味，而不仅仅是用通用模板填充的作品集。

corpus_topic: Freelance illustrator gallery and case studies page
query_text: Make a portfolio site for a freelance illustrator that gives the gallery some character and warmth so it feels like their work, with a section where each project unfolds into a case study showing the sketches and process alongside the finished pieces, and the whole thing should have a handcrafted feeling that a visitor browsing on a desktop browser would actually enjoy scrolling through.
query_text_zh: 为自由插画师做一个作品集网站，画廊有人物气息和温暖感，让人感觉这就是他们的风格，每个项目都可以展开成案例分析，展示草图和创作过程以及最终作品，整个网站要有手工打造的感觉，让桌面浏览器访客真的享受滚动浏览。

corpus_topic: Independent consultant project case study library
query_text: Create a website for an independent consultant where each past project gets a focused case study write-up explaining the challenge, the approach taken, and what came out of it, organized in a way that lets potential clients browse by industry or type of work, with a tone that feels confident and specific rather than vague and corporate, built for desktop browsers first.
query_text_zh: 为独立顾问创建网站，每个过往项目都有专注的案例研究说明挑战、采用的方法和最终结果，组织方式让潜在客户可以按行业或工作类型浏览，语气要自信而具体而不是模糊的企业口气，优先为桌面浏览器设计。

corpus_topic: Freelance copywriter writing samples and clips site
query_text: Make a website for a freelance copywriter that shows their writing samples and published clips in a way that actually reflects their voice and style, where each piece links out or previews inline, the site has a clear identity that matches the kind of writing they do best, and someone landing on it from a desktop browser gets a strong sense of who this writer is within the first scroll.
query_text_zh: 为自由文案撰写人做网站，展示写作样本和已发表剪报，真实反映他们的声音和文风，每个作品都有链接或内联预览，网站要有清晰的身份认同与他们最擅长的写作类型相匹配，桌面浏览器访客在第一次滚动中就能深刻感受到这位作家是谁。

corpus_topic: Independent architect project portfolio and awards page
query_text: Build a portfolio site for an independent architect that presents built projects with the weight and seriousness the work deserves, showing photos alongside drawings and a brief write-up for each project, with an awards section that reads like a quiet credential rather than a trophy shelf, all laid out for desktop browsers in a way that feels architectural in itself, considered and precise.
query_text_zh: 为独立建筑师构建作品集网站，用建筑作品应得的份量和严肃性来呈现已完成项目，并排展示照片和图纸，每个项目附带简短说明，有获奖部分但读起来像静默的资历而不是战利品陈列室，整体为桌面浏览器设计，外观本身就带有建筑感——考虑周全且精确。

corpus_topic: Freelance UX researcher process and deliverables showcase
query_text: Make a portfolio site for a freelance UX researcher that shows the actual process behind each project, with a place to walk through the research steps, share the key deliverables like maps or reports, and explain what decisions the work ended up informing, so someone browsing it on a desktop browser understands how this researcher thinks and not just what pretty outputs they produced.
query_text_zh: 为自由用户体验研究者做作品集网站，展示每个项目背后的真实过程，有地方讲述研究步骤、分享关键可交付成果如地图或报告、解释工作如何影响最终决策，桌面浏览器访客能理解这位研究者怎样思考而不仅仅是他们产出了什么漂亮的成果。

corpus_topic: Independent financial advisor credentials and expertise site
query_text: Need a personal credentials site for my independent financial advisory practice that feels like it actually belongs to me and not some generic template, built as a web app for desktop browsers, with a clean space to list my certifications and licenses, a short biography that shows my philosophy not just my resume, and a few highlighted client success stories that speak for themselves without feeling like a sales pitch.
query_text_zh: 需要为我的独立财务咨询业务建立个人凭证网站，要真正属于我而不是通用模板感，做成桌面浏览器网页应用，有整洁的空间列出我的证书和执照，简短的个人传记展示我的理念而不仅是简历，几个突出的客户成功故事自己诉说故事而不显得像销售宣传。

corpus_topic: Freelance videographer showreel and project gallery
query_text: Create a showreel and project gallery website for a freelance videographer that has real taste baked into it, the kind of site that opens with a full-width video reel right in the browser, then lets visitors scroll through individual projects organized by category, with each project having a title, a short description of the story behind it, and a place to embed or link the actual footage, all presented with the quiet confidence of someone who takes their craft seriously.
query_text_zh: 为自由摄像师创建演示卷和项目相册网站，具有真实品味的设计，打开网站就能在浏览器中看到全宽视频演示卷，然后访客可以按类别滚动浏览各个项目，每个项目都有标题、背后故事的简短描述、嵌入或链接实际视频的地方，整体呈现了一个认真对待自己工作的人的沉静自信。

corpus_topic: Independent brand strategist campaign results showcase
query_text: Build a campaign results showcase for an independent brand strategist that carries real credibility, a web app that opens with a strong personal statement about approach and philosophy, then walks visitors through past campaigns with before-and-after context, actual numbers where available, and a brief reflection on what made each one work, the kind of site that feels authored and deliberate rather than assembled from parts.
query_text_zh: 为独立品牌策略师构建活动成果展示，做成网页应用在浏览器打开，展现真实的可信度，开场有强有力的个人声明阐述方法和理念，然后为访客呈现过往活动的前后对比、可获得的真实数字、以及对每个活动成功原因的简短思考，这种网站感觉经过精心创作和深思熟虑而不是拼凑而成。

corpus_topic: Freelance motion designer animation reel and clients site
query_text: Need a personal site for a freelance motion designer that doubles as an animation reel and client showcase, the kind of web app that loads in a desktop browser and immediately makes the work feel like it has a home, with an intro reel at the top, a project list that shows client names and project types, and a short statement about the creative voice behind the work so visitors understand who they are hiring and not just what they can do.
query_text_zh: 需要为自由动态设计师做个人网站，既是动画演示卷又是客户作品集，网页应用在桌面浏览器加载后立刻让作品有了家的感觉，上面有简介演示卷，项目列表显示客户名和项目类型，还有关于作品背后创意声音的简短声明这样访客了解他们雇的是谁而不仅仅是能做什么。

corpus_topic: Independent data analyst projects and insights showcase
query_text: Build a personal showcase site for an independent data analyst where the projects feel like they have real weight, a web app designed for desktop browsers that lets visitors browse past work by topic area, read a short summary of each project's question and what the analysis revealed, and get a genuine sense of the analytical sensibility and judgment behind the numbers rather than just a list of tools and techniques.
query_text_zh: 为独立数据分析师构建个人展示网站，项目要有真实的份量感，网页应用为桌面浏览器设计让访客可以按专题领域浏览过往工作，读每个项目的简短摘要说明其问题和分析揭示的内容，真实感受分析师背后的分析思维和判断而不仅仅是工具和技术清单。

corpus_topic: Freelance content strategist published work archive
query_text: Need a published work archive for a freelance content strategist that actually captures the thinking behind the pieces, a browser-based site where each entry shows the title and outlet alongside a short note about the strategic intent of the work, organized by theme or client type so visitors can navigate by what they care about, with an overall tone that reflects a consistent editorial voice and point of view.
