query_text_zh: 一个自由用户体验研究者的作品展示网站，研究方法要用实际决策者能理解的方式解释。这是一个为桌面浏览器设计的网络应用，项目区域展示每个工作的方法和达成的结果，有一个简短的部分说明如何参与新项目，整个网站充满足够的个性，让访客明确感受到他们会和谁合作。

corpus_topic: Freelance photographer session booking platform
query_text: Need a web app that lets clients book photography sessions without me having to manage it by hand, where they can see my available time slots on a calendar, pick the session type and length they want, and confirm the booking right there in the browser so I stop losing track of requests that come in through messages and emails at all hours.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用让客户能自己预订摄影课程，不用我手动管理。客户可以在日历上看到我的可用时段，选择想要的课程类型和时长，直接在浏览器里确认预订，这样我就不会丢失那些通过消息和邮件一整天涌进来的预订请求了。

corpus_topic: Independent financial advisor appointment scheduler
query_text: Need a scheduling web app for my independent financial advisory practice so clients can book their own appointments, see a live calendar of when I am free, choose between an initial consultation or a follow-up session, and get a confirmation right away, because managing all of this over email is eating up time I should be spending on actual work.
query_text_zh: 需要一个为独立财务顾问设计的预约网络应用，让客户可以自己预约。客户能看到一个实时日历，选择初次咨询还是复诊，立即收到确认。因为现在用邮件管理这一切太耗时了，我应该把时间花在实际的顾问工作上。

corpus_topic: Personal fitness trainer online booking site
query_text: Build a booking site for a personal fitness trainer that lives in the browser so clients can see available training slots, pick a session type like one-on-one or small group, and lock in their spot without texting or calling, because right now scheduling back and forth is a hassle that gets in the way of actually training people.
query_text_zh: 为私人健身教练制作一个预订网站，在浏览器里运行，客户可以看到可用的训练时段，选择一对一或小组课程，直接锁定位置，不用发短信或打电话。现在来回协调时间真的很麻烦，占用了我实际训练人的时间。

corpus_topic: Private music teacher lesson scheduling platform
query_text: A scheduling tool for a private music teacher that runs in the browser so students (or their parents) can see which lesson times are open, pick a slot that works, and confirm it without needing to call or message, the whole app should show the weekly calendar clearly so nobody has to ask what is available, and bookings should be visible in one list so nothing falls through the cracks.
query_text_zh: 为私人音乐教师制作一个网络预约工具，在浏览器里运行，学生或家长可以看到开放的课程时间，选择合适的时段，不需要打电话或发信息确认。整个应用要清楚地显示周日历，这样没人需要问什么时间有空，所有预订也能在一个列表里看到，确保不会有遗漏。

corpus_topic: Career coach one-on-one session booking
query_text: Build a web app for career coach one-on-one session booking that takes the scheduling burden off entirely, where clients can open it in their browser, see a real-time calendar of available times, pick the type of session they want, fill in a short note about what they want to cover, and confirm without needing me to be involved until the session actually happens.
query_text_zh: 为职业教练制作一个一对一课程预约网络应用，完全卸下预约的负担。客户在浏览器里打开应用，看到实时的可用时间日历，选择想要的课程类型，填一个简短的备注说想讨论什么，然后确认，整个过程都不用我参与，直到课程真正开始。

corpus_topic: Freelance UX designer portfolio review scheduler
query_text: Need a web app that lets potential clients book a portfolio review session with me as a freelance UX designer, where they can pick a time that works from my actual availability, leave a quick note about what kind of feedback they are looking for, and get a confirmation automatically, because right now coordinating times takes more back-and-forth than the review itself.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，让潜在客户可以和我（自由用户体验设计师）预约作品集评审课程。他们可以从我真实的可用时间里选择，留一个快速备注说想要什么类型的反馈，然后自动获得确认。现在协调时间的来回讨论比评审本身花的时间还多。

corpus_topic: Certified nutritionist consultation booking site
query_text: Build a booking site for a certified nutritionist where clients can open it in a desktop browser, see available consultation times for the week, pick a slot that fits their schedule, and confirm the appointment right away without anyone needing to exchange messages, the app should also let them note any specific concerns ahead of time so the session can start with useful context.
query_text_zh: 为持证营养师制作一个预订网站，客户可以在桌面浏览器里打开，看到这周可用的咨询时间，选择合适的时段，立即确认预约，不需要互相发信息。应用还应该让客户提前备注任何特殊关注的问题，这样课程可以在有用的背景下开始。

corpus_topic: Independent accountant tax appointment platform
query_text: A tax appointment booking site for an independent accountant that runs in the browser and lets clients pick from available time slots, choose whether they need an individual or business appointment, and confirm their booking in a couple of clicks, so the whole scheduling process stops eating into the actual work of preparing returns and giving advice.
query_text_zh: 为独立会计师制作一个报税预约预订网站，在浏览器里运行，让客户从可用的时间槽里选择，选择是需要个人还是企业报税，几次点击就能确认预订。这样整个预约流程就不会占用我实际准备报表和提供建议的时间了。

corpus_topic: Licensed therapist session booking site
query_text: Create a session booking web app for a licensed therapist where new and returning clients can see available appointment times in a browser, choose a session length, and confirm their slot without any back-and-forth, the app should also include a short intake form so basic information is collected before the first meeting and the therapist is not starting from scratch every time.
query_text_zh: 为有执业资格的治疗师制作一个课程预订网络应用，新患者和回诊患者都可以在浏览器里看到可用的预约时间，选择课程时长，不需要任何来回沟通就能确认时段。应用还应该包含一个简短的初诊表单，这样基本信息能在首次见面前收集，治疗师不用每次都从零开始。

corpus_topic: Private language tutor lesson scheduler
query_text: Build a web app for a private language tutor that lets students pick lesson times from a live schedule in the browser, choose the language and level they are working on, and book a slot that gets added to the tutor's calendar automatically, because manually coordinating lesson times through messages every week is a pointless hassle that could easily be handled by a simple tool.
query_text_zh: 为私人语言教师制作一个网络应用，让学生可以从浏览器里的实时日程中选择课程时间，选择学习的语言和级别，预订的课程会自动添加到教师的日历里。现在每周通过信息手动协调课程时间是完全没必要的麻烦，本来可以用一个简单工具就解决。

corpus_topic: Freelance copywriter discovery call booking page
query_text: A discovery call booking tool for a freelance copywriter that sits in a browser and lets potential clients pick an available time, answer a couple of quick questions about their project, and confirm the call without any ping-pong scheduling, the whole point is that a client should be able to go from interested to booked in under two minutes so no lead goes cold just because scheduling was annoying.
query_text_zh: 为自由文案顾问制作一个免费咨询电话预约工具，在浏览器里运行，让潜在客户可以选择可用时间，回答几个快速的项目问题，不需要来回协调就能确认通话。关键是客户应该能从感兴趣到预约成功在两分钟内完成，这样就不会因为预约太麻烦而让潜在客户流失。

corpus_topic: Independent real estate agent showing appointment site
query_text: A property showing scheduler for an independent real estate agent that runs in the browser so buyers can see which showing times are available for a listing, pick the one that works, and confirm it on the spot, the agent should be able to add listings and manage their open times from the same web app so all the scheduling for multiple properties is in one place.
query_text_zh: 为独立房地产经纪人制作一个看房时间安排工具，在浏览器里运行，买家可以看到某个房产的可用看房时间，选择合适的，立即确认。经纪人可以在同一个网络应用里添加房产和管理开放时间，这样所有房产的预约都集中在一个地方。

corpus_topic: Personal stylist wardrobe consultation booking platform
query_text: Create a web app for a personal stylist where clients can book a wardrobe consultation right in their browser, see a weekly calendar of available time slots, choose between an in-person or online session, and fill in a short note about what they want help with, so the stylist can prepare and clients stop bouncing around trying to figure out how to actually get on the calendar.
query_text_zh: 为个人衣着顾问制作一个网络应用，客户可以在浏览器里直接预订衣橱咨询，看到一周的可用时间槽，选择线下或线上课程，留一个简短的备注说想要什么帮助。这样衣着顾问能提前准备，客户也不用费力找如何进入日程安排。

corpus_topic: Life coach goal-setting session scheduler
query_text: Create a life coach goal-setting session scheduler as a web app where clients can open it in their browser, pick from available times on a calendar, choose a session focus like a first meeting or a check-in, and confirm without any extra steps, plus a short intake question so the coach knows what the client is working toward before the session even starts.
query_text_zh: 为生活教练制作一个目标设定课程预约网络应用，客户可以在浏览器里打开，从日历里选择可用时间，选择课程重点比如首次咨询或定期回顾，然后不需要额外步骤就能确认。加上一个简短的初诊问题，这样教练在课程开始前就知道客户在努力实现什么。

corpus_topic: Freelance skill certification and digital badge platform
query_text: Need a web app for freelancers to track skill certifications and earn digital badges, where I can log each certification with the issuing body and the date I earned it, see a clean list of all my badges in the browser, and mark which ones I want to display publicly on a profile so potential clients can see my credentials at a glance, with a reminder for anything that needs renewal.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用来追踪自由职业者的技能认证和数字徽章。我可以记录每个认证的颁发机构和获得时间，在浏览器里看到清晰的所有徽章列表，并选择哪些要在公开档案上显示，这样潜在客户一眼就能看到我的资质，还要有提醒功能提示哪些需要更新。

corpus_topic: Peer mentorship matching site for independent consultants
query_text: A peer mentorship matching tool for independent consultants, available in the browser on desktop, where you can fill in your specialty area, the kind of help you want, and what you can offer in return, then get matched with someone at a similar level. The main list should show each potential match with their focus area and a short note about what they bring, and you can reach out directly from there.
query_text_zh: 为独立顾问制作一个同行导师配对工具，在桌面浏览器上可用。你可以填入自己的专业领域，你想要的帮助类型，以及你能提供什么。主列表应该显示每个潜在配对对象的专业方向和他们能带来什么的简短说明，你可以直接从那里开始联系。

corpus_topic: Portfolio-linked learning path progress tracker for freelancers
query_text: Create a learning progress tracker for freelancers that lives in the browser and ties each course or skill you are working on directly to your portfolio pieces. I want to keep a running list of what I am learning, mark each thing as in progress or done, and have the finished ones link out to actual work samples that show off what I picked up. A sidebar listing all skills with their status would be really helpful.
query_text_zh: 为自由职业者制作一个学习进度追踪器，在浏览器里运行，把每个你在学的课程或技能直接和你的作品集关联起来。我想保留一个不断更新的学习清单，标记每个为进行中或完成，完成的那些应该链接到真实的作品样本，展示我学到了什么。一个侧边栏列出所有技能和它们的状态会很有帮助。

corpus_topic: Business and finance literacy hub for self-employed professionals
query_text: Need a web app that works as a business and money learning hub for people who are self-employed, with topics like invoicing, saving for taxes, setting rates, and basic budgeting all organized into short lessons you can go through at your own pace. I want to be able to tick off each lesson as I finish it and keep a simple checklist of which topics I still need to cover.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用作为自由职业者的商业和财务学习中心，涵盖开发票、存税款、设定费率和基础预算等主题，都整理成你可以自己进度的短课程。我想在完成每个课程时打勾，保留一个简单的清单，追踪还有哪些主题需要学习。

corpus_topic: Contract and legal literacy e-learning site for freelancers
query_text: Build a website for freelancers who want to understand contracts and legal basics, laid out as a series of short lessons you can work through on your desktop browser, covering things like payment terms, scope creep clauses, and what to watch out for when signing. I want each lesson to have a quick recap at the end and a checkbox I can tick when I feel like I actually understand it.
query_text_zh: 为自由职业者制作一个网站来理解合同和法律基础知识，展现为一系列短课程，可以在桌面浏览器上学习，涵盖支付条款、范围蔓延条款，以及签署时要注意什么。我想每个课程在末尾有一个快速总结和一个勾选框，让我标记我什么时候真正理解了它。

corpus_topic: Niche industry knowledge base with expert-curated articles
query_text: Create a knowledge base web app full of expert-written articles organized by niche industry topics, where the left side has a list of all the topic categories and clicking one opens the articles in that group on the right. I want each article to show who wrote it, when it was last updated, and a short summary at the top so I can decide whether it is worth reading before I dive in.
query_text_zh: 制作一个充满专家撰写文章的知识库网络应用，按利基行业主题分类。左边有所有主题分类的列表，点击一个分类后右边打开该分类的文章。我想看到每篇文章的作者、最后更新时间，以及顶部的简短摘要，这样在深入阅读前我可以决定是否值得读。

corpus_topic: Live code challenge arena for freelance developers
query_text: A browser-based coding challenge arena for freelance developers, where you can browse a list of timed practice problems sorted by topic and pick one to work on, then submit your solution and see how it compares to others. I want to track which challenges I have completed, mark the ones I want to revisit, and see a simple running score for each topic area I have practiced.
query_text_zh: 一个基于浏览器的自由开发者编码挑战竞技场，你可以浏览按主题排序的计时练习题列表，选一个开始做，然后提交方案看它和其他人的比较。我想追踪我完成过哪些挑战，标记我想重新做的，看到每个我练习过的主题领域的简单记分。

corpus_topic: Design critique community with structured peer feedback loops
query_text: Need a web app for designers to share their work and get structured feedback from other designers in the community, where you post a piece, answer a short set of questions about what you were going for, and then reviewers respond to those same questions one by one. I want to see all the feedback for my submission in one place and be able to reply to each comment as a follow-up.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用让设计师分享作品并从社区里的其他设计师那里获得结构化的反馈。你发布一个作品，回答一套关于你想表达什么的简短问题，然后评审者逐一回答这些相同的问题。我想在一个地方看到我提交的所有反馈，并能逐条回复评论。

corpus_topic: Freelance writer craft improvement and editing workshop site
query_text: Make a web app for freelance writers who want to get better at their craft, with a place to submit a piece of writing and get it looked at by others in the community, as well as short exercises focused on things like sentence flow, cutting filler, and tightening up openings. The main area should show a list of open submissions waiting for feedback alongside a separate list of exercises I can work through on my own.
query_text_zh: 为自由文案作者制作一个网络应用，帮助他们提高写作技能。有一个地方可以提交文章让社区的其他人查看，还有针对句子流畅度、删除废话、加强开头等方面的短练习。主要区域应该显示一个等待反馈的开放提交列表，旁边是我可以自己完成的练习列表。

corpus_topic: Tax planning and accounting course portal for solopreneurs
query_text: Create a course portal web app for solopreneurs who need to learn about taxes and basic accounting, with lessons broken into small chunks covering things like quarterly estimates, writing off expenses, and reading a profit and loss summary. I want to see a clear list of all lessons with a progress indicator next to each one, and be able to bookmark lessons to come back to later.
query_text_zh: 为小企业创意人制作一个课程门户网络应用，帮助他们学习税务和基础会计。课程分成小块，涵盖季度预估、费用扣除和损益摘要的阅读。我想看到所有课程的清晰列表，旁边有进度指示器，并能书签课程以便稍后回顾。

corpus_topic: Micro-credential stacking platform for independent consultants
query_text: Need a web app where independent consultants can collect and display short certificates or credentials they have earned from different courses and platforms, stacking them together into a kind of running record of their expertise. I want to be able to add each credential with the name, the issuer, and the date, then arrange them by skill area so my profile shows a clear picture of what I have built up over time.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，让独立顾问可以收集和展示他们从不同课程和平台获得的短期证书或资质，把它们堆在一起形成一种专业知识的持续记录。我想能添加每个资质的名称、颁发方和日期，然后按技能领域排列，这样我的档案可以清楚地展示我随着时间推移积累的东西。

corpus_topic: Conference talk archive and timestamped annotation platform
query_text: Need a web app for desktop browsers where I can save conference talks I have watched, write notes tied to specific points in the recording, and keep everything organized by topic or event. The main view should show all my saved talks in a list with a note count next to each, and when I open one I want to see my notes lined up alongside the talk so I can find the right moment quickly.
query_text_zh: 需要一个桌面浏览器网络应用，让我可以保存看过的会议演讲，写下和录像中特定点相关的笔记，按主题或活动整理一切。主视图应该在一个列表里显示所有我保存的演讲，旁边有笔记数，打开一个时我想在演讲旁边看到我的笔记排列，这样我能快速找到正确的时刻。

corpus_topic: Case study library with discussion boards for freelance strategists
query_text: Create a case study library and discussion tool for freelance strategists, available as a web app in the browser, where each case study has its own page with a summary, the key decisions made, and a thread underneath for people to comment and share their own takes. I want to be able to browse all case studies by industry or topic from a sidebar list on the left and save the ones I find most useful to a personal reading list.
query_text_zh: 为自由策略师制作一个案例研究库和讨论工具，作为浏览器里的网络应用。每个案例研究有自己的页面，包括摘要、做出的关键决策，以及下面的讨论线程让人们评论和分享看法。我想从左边的侧边栏列表按行业或主题浏览所有案例研究，并保存我发现最有用的到个人阅读列表。

corpus_topic: Client negotiation and communication skills training site
query_text: A client negotiation and communication skills trainer for freelancers, running as a web app in the browser on desktop, organized as a series of short lessons covering topics like how to push back on scope changes, what to say when a client goes quiet, and how to handle a rate conversation. Each lesson should include a worked example and a short practice prompt, with a checklist on the side tracking which topics I have gone through.
query_text_zh: 为自由职业者制作一个客户协商和沟通技能训练工具，作为桌面浏览器里的网络应用，分为一系列短课程，涵盖如何反驳范围变化、客户没有响应时说什么、如何处理费率对话等主题。每个课程应该包含一个实例和短练习提示，侧边有一个清单追踪我学过哪些主题。

corpus_topic: Independent consultant mastermind group platform
query_text: Make a web app for independent consultants who want to run a small mastermind group together, where a handful of people can join a shared space, post weekly updates about what they are working on, and leave comments for each other. It would be cool to have a simple way to schedule a group check-in call and a shared list of goals that everyone can see and tick off as the weeks go by.
query_text_zh: 为独立顾问制作一个网络应用来运行小的头脑风暴小组，少数人可以加入共享空间，发布他们在做的周更新，彼此留评论。可以有一个简单的方式来安排小组定期检查通话，以及一个所有人都能看到并随着周数推进而打勾的共享目标列表就太好了。

corpus_topic: Remote designer accountability partner matching site
query_text: Build a website where remote designers can find an accountability partner to check in with regularly, so you fill out a short profile about your working style and what kind of projects you are doing, then get matched with someone who fits well. I want the app to give each matched pair a little shared space in the browser where they can post weekly goals and mark them done, so both people can see how the other is getting on.
query_text_zh: 建一个网站，远程设计师可以在上面找到一个问责伙伴定期核实。你填入一个关于你的工作风格和你在做什么类型项目的简短档案，然后和一个很搭的人配对。我想应用给每对配对一个在浏览器里的小共享空间，他们可以发布周目标并标记完成，这样两个人都能看到对方的进展。

corpus_topic: Freelancer rate transparency and pay sharing community
query_text: Make a web app where freelancers can anonymously share what they charge for their work and see what others in similar fields are getting paid, so everyone has a better sense of what rates are actually out there. I want people to be able to post their rate with some context like their specialty and years of experience, browse the shared entries filtered by type of work, and leave short comments with advice or reactions.
query_text_zh: 制作一个网络应用让自由职业者可以匿名分享他们的收费标准，看到同领域其他人赚多少，这样每个人对市场上真实存在的费率都有更好的理解。我想人们能够发布带有背景的费率，比如专业和经验年数，浏览按工作类型筛选的共享条目，留短评论给出建议或反应。

corpus_topic: Open-source contributor recognition and discussion board
query_text: A community site for open-source contributors where people can post about the projects they have been working on and get recognized by others in the group, with a feed in the browser showing recent contributions and a discussion thread under each one. I want contributors to be able to add a short note about what they built or fixed, and other people can give a thumbs up or leave a comment to show appreciation.
query_text_zh: 为开源贡献者制作一个社区网站，人们可以发布他们一直在做的项目并从小组里的其他人那里获得认可，浏览器里有一个显示最近贡献的信息流和每个下面的讨论线程。我想贡献者可以添加一个关于他们建立或修复了什么的简短说明，其他人可以点赞或留评论来表示感谢。

corpus_topic: Solopreneur daily co-working accountability group site
query_text: Create a web app for solopreneurs who want a daily co-working group to stay on track, where everyone can log in to the browser in the morning, post what they are working on that day, and check back in at the end to say how it went. I want a live list showing who is working on what right now, and a simple way to cheer on someone or leave a quick encouraging note when they finish something.
query_text_zh: 为小企业创意人制作一个网络应用加入每日的共同工作小组来保持进度。每个人都可以在早上登入浏览器，发布他们那天在做什么，在结束时回来说进展如何。我想一个实时列表显示谁现在在做什么，以及一个简单的方式在别人完成什么时给他们加油或留个快速鼓励的话。

corpus_topic: UX designer portfolio review and critique community
query_text: Make a web app for UX designers who want honest feedback on their portfolio from other designers in the community, where you can post your portfolio link and a couple of questions you want answered, and others leave structured replies covering things like clarity, storytelling, and overall impression. The home feed should show all the portfolios currently open for review, and I want to be able to track which ones I have already given feedback on.
query_text_zh: 为用户体验设计师制作一个网络应用，他们想从社区里的其他设计师那里获得对作品集的诚实反馈。你可以发布你的作品集链接和几个你想回答的问题，其他人留结构化的回复，涵盖清晰度、故事叙述和总体印象等内容。首页信息流应该显示所有目前开放评论的作品集，我想能追踪我已经给过反馈的。

corpus_topic: Freelance developer side project showcase and feedback hub
query_text: Need a web app where freelance developers can show off the side projects they are building and get real reactions from other developers in the community, with each project getting its own spot to post a description, a screenshot, and a link to try it out. I want visitors to be able to leave short pieces of feedback organized by what is working well and what could be better, and I want to see all the feedback for my projects collected in one place.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用让自由开发者可以展示他们在做的副项目并从社区里的其他开发者那里获得真实的反应。每个项目有自己的地方发布描述、截图和可以试用的链接。我想访客可以留短反馈分为什么在有效和什么可以更好，我想看到我的项目的所有反馈收集在一个地方。

corpus_topic: Independent photographer location scouting community
query_text: A community site for independent photographers where people can share and discover shooting locations, posting photos they took along with notes about the spot like the best time of day and how to get there, all browsable on a desktop browser. I want to be able to search locations by city or type of shot, save my favorite spots to a personal list, and leave a short comment on any location entry to share my own experience.
query_text_zh: 为独立摄影师制作一个社区网站，人们可以分享和发现拍摄地点，发布他们拍摄的照片以及关于这个地点的笔记，比如最好的时段和如何到达，都可以在桌面浏览器上浏览。我想能按城市或镜头类型搜索地点，把我的最爱地点保存到个人列表，并在任何地点条目上留短评论分享我自己的经验。

corpus_topic: Copywriter swipe file and copy critique sharing network
query_text: Create a web app for copywriters to share examples of writing they have saved for inspiration, organized into a browsable library where others can flip through the collection and leave their thoughts on what makes each piece work. I want members to be able to submit a saved example with a short note explaining why they liked it, and anyone browsing can add their own reaction or critique in a comment thread below each entry.
query_text_zh: 为文案作者制作一个网络应用来分享他们为了灵感而保存的写作范例，组织成一个可浏览的库，其他人可以浏览和留下对是什么让每个部分有效的想法。我想成员能够提交一个保存的范例，附一个简短的说明说他们为什么喜欢它，任何浏览的人可以在每条条目下面的评论线程里添加他们自己的反应或评论。

corpus_topic: Freelance translator glossary and terminology exchange community
query_text: A translator community tool for the browser where freelance translators can build up a shared glossary of tricky terms and specialized vocabulary across different subject areas, and anyone can suggest a new entry or flag an existing one that needs a better translation. I want entries to be searchable by language pair and topic, and each term should have a little comment thread where translators can debate the best option or share context from real projects.
query_text_zh: 为浏览器制作一个翻译社区工具，让自由翻译人员可以建立一个跨不同主题领域的棘手术语和专业词汇的共享词汇表，任何人都可以建议新条目或标记现存的需要更好的翻译。我想条目可以按语言对和主题搜索，每个术语应该有一个小评论线程，翻译者可以在里面辩论最好的选项或从真实项目分享背景。

corpus_topic: Contract negotiation advice and template sharing forum
query_text: Make a web app for freelancers to share contract advice and real template examples with each other, so you can browse what other people use for things like late payment clauses, kill fees, or revision limits and download a template to adapt for yourself. I want the forum side to let people post questions about tricky contract situations and get replies from others who have dealt with the same thing, all in one place on desktop.
query_text_zh: 为自由职业者制作一个网络应用来彼此分享合同建议和真实模板范例。你可以浏览其他人用来处理延迟付款条款、终止费或修订限制等事情的方式，下载一个模板为自己调整。我想论坛部分让人们发布关于复杂合同情况的问题并从处理过同样事情的其他人那里获得回复，所有在桌面的一个地方。

corpus_topic: Indie hacker build-in-public progress tracking community
query_text: Build a web app for indie hackers who want to share their progress in public and follow along with what others are building, where everyone posts regular updates about milestones, setbacks, and what they shipped that week. I want a feed showing the latest updates from everyone in the community, a way to leave a short reaction or comment on each post, and a personal tracker on my own profile that shows how my project has moved forward over time.
query_text_zh: 为独立黑客制作一个网络应用来公开分享他们的进展并跟踪其他人在建立什么，每个人发布关于里程碑、挫折和他们那周发布了什么的定期更新。我想一个信息流显示社区里所有最新的更新，一个方式在每个发布上留短反应或评论，以及我的档案上的个人追踪器显示我的项目如何随着时间推进。

corpus_topic: Niche industry expert Q&A and knowledge exchange platform
query_text: Make a web app where people in really specific trades or niche fields can ask each other questions and swap what they know, like a place for obscure craftspeople or specialists to actually find someone who gets their weird corner of work, with a way to browse questions by topic area and mark the best answers so good stuff rises to the top and doesn't get buried, and experts can build up a little reputation over time so you know whose answers are worth trusting.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，让那些在特别专业领域或冷门行业里的人可以互相提问和分享知识，就像是给那些古怪的手艺人或专家们找到知音的地方，还要能按话题浏览问题和标记最好的回答，这样高质量的内容就不会被淹没，而且专家可以慢慢积累声誉值，让人知道谁的答案最值得信任。

corpus_topic: Freelance accountant and finance professional peer network
query_text: Create a web app that works like a peer hangout spot for freelance accountants and finance folks where they can post questions only other finance people would understand, share tips on tricky client situations, and follow along with what others in the same field are dealing with, with a section to look up who in the community has handled similar problems before and maybe a way to save threads that are actually useful to come back to later.
query_text_zh: 创建一个网络应用，像是自由财务顾问和财务人员的聚集地，他们可以发表只有圈内人才能理解的问题，分享处理棘手客户情况的技巧，跟进其他人遇到的问题，还有一个地方可以查找社区里谁之前处理过类似的问题，可能还能收藏有用的讨论串方便以后再看。

corpus_topic: freelance hourly rate calculator with market benchmarks
query_text: A browser-based tool where I type in my skills and how many years I've been doing this, pick my country or city, and it spits out what I should actually be charging per hour compared to what other freelancers in the same field are getting, so I stop undercharging and feel less like I'm guessing, with a breakdown showing low, middle, and high ranges so I can see where I land and decide where I want to price myself.
query_text_zh: 一个基于浏览器的工具，我可以输入自己的技能和从业年数，选择国家或城市，它就告诉我应该怎么按小时收费，比起同行的费率是多还是少，这样我就不会再胡乱定价和瞎蒙了，还能显示低中高三个价格区间，让我看清自己处在什么位置，然后自己决定怎么报价。

corpus_topic: client onboarding checklist generator for freelance consultants
query_text: A web app where I enter the type of consulting work I'm doing and it builds me a client onboarding checklist I can actually hand off or follow step by step, because I always forget something at the start of a new project and then scramble to catch up later, with space to tick things off as I go and maybe tweak the list for different kinds of clients without having to start over from scratch every time.
query_text_zh: 一个网络应用，我输入自己在做什么咨询项目，它就给我生成一个客户入职清单，我可以直接用或一步步执行，因为我总是在项目开始时忘记什么东西然后后面急忙补救，清单里有复选框可以打勾，还能针对不同类型的客户调整清单内容，而不用每次都从头开始。

corpus_topic: project scope and timeline estimator for developers
query_text: Create a web-based tool where I describe a software project in plain terms and it figures out roughly how long it should take and what the scope actually involves, because I always either way overcommit or leave stuff out of my estimates and then regret it, with a breakdown by phase so I can see where the time goes and adjust things if the client wants to cut something or add something last minute.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络工具，我用简单的话描述一个软件项目，它就能估算大概要花多长时间和项目范围到底包括什么，因为我总是要么承诺太多要么遗漏东西然后后悔，还能按阶段分解，让我看到时间都去了哪里，这样如果客户要删改或临时加需求，我也能快速调整。

corpus_topic: freelance invoice generator with automated tax calculation
query_text: Need a web app that lets me fill in my work details and hours and it generates a proper invoice for me, but the part I actually need is for it to figure out the tax stuff automatically because every time I try to do it manually I either miss something or overthink it, with fields for different tax categories if needed and a way to save client info so I'm not retyping the same address every single time.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，我输入工作细节和工时，它就给我生成正式发票，但我最需要的是它能自动算出税费，因为每次我手动算税都要么漏掉什么要么想太多，可以有不同税务类别的字段，还能保存客户信息，这样我就不用每次都重新打一遍客户地址。

corpus_topic: contract clause builder for independent contractors
query_text: A website where I can pick and build contract clauses for my freelance work without having to write legal-sounding stuff from scratch every time, because I keep reusing the same old doc and it has stuff that doesn't even apply anymore, with a way to choose sections like payment terms, revision limits, and what happens if the project gets cancelled, then put it all together into something I can actually send a client without feeling embarrassed.
query_text_zh: 一个网站，我可以挑选和组合合同条款用在自由职业工作上，不用每次都从头写法律用语，因为我一直在重用同一份老文档，里面有些条款早就不适用了，可以选择像付款条款、修改次数限制和项目取消后怎么办这样的部分，然后全部拼在一起，生成一份可以自信地发给客户的合同。

corpus_topic: billable hours tracker with per-client breakdown dashboard
query_text: Need a web app where I can log the hours I work each day and tag them to specific clients, then see at a glance how much time I've spent per client over the week or month and what that comes out to in money, because I have no idea where my time actually goes and I keep feeling like I'm working a lot but somehow not making what I should, with a simple view per client so I can spot who's eating up my time.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，我可以每天记录工作时数并给不同客户标签，然后一眼看出一周或一个月里给每个客户花了多少时间和赚了多少钱，因为我根本不知道自己的时间都到哪里去了，一直觉得自己在忙碌但最后没赚到应赚的钱，有个简单的按客户分类的视图就能让我看出谁在吃我的时间。

corpus_topic: self-employed quarterly tax estimator and payment planner
query_text: Need a browser-based tool where I put in what I've made so far this quarter and what I expect to make, and it tells me roughly what I owe in quarterly taxes so I'm not caught off guard when the deadline comes, with a spot to see what I should be setting aside each month and maybe a reminder of when payments are due so I stop panicking every three months when I realize I forgot to save enough.
query_text_zh: 需要一个基于浏览器的工具，我输入这个季度到现在赚了多少和预计还能赚多少，它就告诉我大概要交多少季度税，这样截止日期到来时我就不会被吓到，可以看到每月应该存多少钱，还能提醒我什么时候要交税，这样我就不用每三个月都慌张地发现自己没攒够钱。

corpus_topic: portfolio case study builder for creative professionals
query_text: Build a web app where I can put together proper case study write-ups for my creative work by filling in what the project was, what the challenge was, what I did, and what the result was, because I never know how to present past projects in a way that sounds professional, with a way to add images and keep each case study organized so I can link someone to my work without sending them a messy folder of files.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，我可以通过填写项目内容、遇到的挑战、我的做法和最终结果来写专业的案例分析，因为我从来不知道怎么以专业的方式展示过去的项目，能上传图片并把每个案例整理好，这样我就可以直接给别人发一个链接看我的作品，而不用发一个杂乱的文件夹。

corpus_topic: freelance proposal generator with tiered pricing options
query_text: A web-based tool where I describe my freelance service and it helps me put together a proper project proposal with different pricing tiers, because I always write these from scratch and they end up looking inconsistent or I forget to include something important, with a way to label each tier clearly and show what's included at each level so the client actually understands what they're paying for and I don't have to explain it in five follow-up emails.
query_text_zh: 一个网络工具，我描述自己的自由职业服务，它就帮我制作一份正式的项目提案，包含不同的价格档位，因为我总是从零开始写这些东西，最后看起来不一致或漏掉什么重要的，能清楚地标记每个档位，显示每个价格对应的内容，这样客户才能真正理解自己花钱买什么，而不是让我花五封邮件去解释。

corpus_topic: client feedback and content approval workflow tool
query_text: Build a web app where I can send clients a link to review content I've made and they can leave comments or click approve right there in the browser, because right now feedback comes in through emails and texts and I can never find the final approved version when I need it, with a way to track which version was approved and by whom so I have something to point to if there's a dispute later.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，我可以发个链接给客户查看我制作的内容，他们可以直接在浏览器里留评论或点击批准，因为现在反馈零散在各种邮件和短信里，我根本找不到最终批准的版本，能追踪是哪个版本被谁批准的，这样如果以后有纠纷，我有证据可以指向。

corpus_topic: freelance sales pipeline and lead management CRM
query_text: Create a web-based tool where I can keep track of everyone I've pitched or talked to about work, move them through stages like first contact, proposal sent, and waiting on response, because I have leads scattered across my email and a random notes app and I always forget to follow up at the right time, with a place to jot down what we talked about and set a reminder to check back in so things don't just fall through the cracks.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络工具，我可以追踪所有我接触过或谈过工作的人，把他们分阶段推进，比如初次接触、已发提案、等待回复，因为我的潜在客户散落在邮件和便笺软件里，总是忘记在合适的时机跟进，可以记下我们聊过什么，设个提醒检查进展，这样就不会有机会从指尖溜走。

corpus_topic: statement of work generator for business consultants
query_text: Build a web app where I fill in the details of a consulting engagement and it puts together a statement of work document I can actually send to a client, because writing these from scratch every time takes forever and I always miss something or phrase things awkwardly, with sections for deliverables, timeline, and payment terms that I can adjust before I send it so it looks like I know what I'm doing.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，我输入咨询项目的细节，它就给我生成一份可以直接发给客户的工作说明书，因为每次从头写都很费时间，而且总是漏东西或表达尴尬，有可交付成果、时间表和付款条款的部分，我可以发送前调整，这样看起来像是我知道自己在干什么。

corpus_topic: freelance income and expense profit margin tracker
query_text: Need a web app where I log my freelance income and what I've spent on the business each month and it shows me what my actual profit margin looks like, because I feel like I'm making decent money but I never know if I'm actually ahead after expenses, with a simple view that separates what came in from what went out and tells me what's left so I can stop guessing and know whether things are actually working.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，我可以每月记录自由职业收入和业务开支，它显示我实际的利润率是多少，因为我觉得自己赚得还不错但从来不知道扣完成本后是不是真的赚钱了，有个简单的视图分开显示进账和支出，告诉我还剩多少，这样我就能停止瞎猜，真正了解生意是不是在赚钱。

corpus_topic: service package pricing configurator and instant quote sender
query_text: Create a website where I set up my service packages with what's included and the price, and when a potential client picks one it puts together a quote they can see right away, because right now I explain my services differently every time and people always ask follow-up questions that I've already answered, with a way for the client to say yes to a package directly so I spend less time going back and forth before work even starts.
query_text_zh: 创建一个网站，我设置好服务套餐内容和价格，当潜在客户选一个后，它就马上生成一份他们能看到的报价，因为现在我每次解释服务都不一样，人们总是问我已经回答过的问题，能让客户直接说同意某个套餐，这样我就能少花很多时间在工作开始前的反复沟通上。

corpus_topic: 环境/菜单展示
query_text: A website for a small restaurant or cafe where people can browse photos of the actual space and see the full menu without having to call or dig through social media, because right now anyone trying to figure out if they want to visit has no easy way to check, with a section for the menu organized by food and drinks and a few pictures of the place itself so someone can get a feel for the vibe before they show up.
query_text_zh: 一个小餐厅或咖啡馆的网站，人们可以浏览实际空间的照片和完整的菜单，不用打电话或扒社交媒体，因为现在想来光顾的人根本没有简单的方式去了解情况，菜单要分食物和饮品，还有几张地方的照片让人感受一下氛围，这样来之前就能有数。

corpus_topic: 婚礼主题站
query_text: Need a web app that works as a dedicated wedding theme site where couples can show off their event style, share details about the venue, and list what guests need to know all in one place, because managing all of that through group chats and random posts is a mess, with a clean layout for desktop browsers that feels special and personal and lets them update the guest info or add photos without it looking like a generic event form.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，就像是婚礼的专属网站，新人可以展示活动风格，分享场地细节，把客人需要知道的事都列在一个地方，因为用群聊和乱七八糟的帖子管理这些太混乱了，要有清爽的桌面浏览器布局，感觉特别和个性化，让他们能更新客人信息或加照片，看起来不像是填一个通用表格。

corpus_topic: neighborhood bakery showcase with rotating seasonal menu gallery
query_text: Need a web app for a small neighborhood bakery where visitors can see what's currently on the menu with photos, and the seasonal stuff rotates so it always feels fresh and relevant, because right now the only way people know what's available is if they follow a social account that doesn't always get updated, with a simple gallery layout that works well in a desktop browser and makes the baked goods actually look as good as they taste.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用，给一个小社区面包房用，访客可以看菜单上现在有什么，带照片，季节性的东西会轮换，这样总是感觉新鲜，因为现在唯一的办法就是关注他们的社交账户，而且还经常不更新，用简单的图库布局，桌面浏览器显示效果好，让烘焙食品看起来和吃起来一样诱人。

corpus_topic: independent hair salon stylist portfolio and lookbook site
query_text: A website for an independent hair salon where each stylist has their own little profile page with photos of their work and the kinds of looks they specialize in, organized into a lookbook so clients can browse styles before booking, because people often don't know which stylist to pick when they're new and end up just guessing, with a desktop-friendly layout where you can flip through the work easily without it feeling like a mess.
query_text_zh: 一个独立理发沙龙的网站，每个发型师有自己的档案页，展示他们的作品和擅长的风格，组织成一个造型集锦，客户可以在预订前浏览，因为新客户经常不知道选哪个发型师，最后就凭运气，桌面友好的布局，能轻松浏览作品，不会显得乱。

corpus_topic: family-owned florist arrangement gallery and seasonal display
query_text: Need a web app for a small family florist where people can browse arrangement photos organized by occasion or season, because right now there's no easy way for customers to see what's available or get inspired before they reach out, with a seasonal section that highlights what's fresh right now and a desktop browser layout that lets the flower photos look big and beautiful without everything feeling cluttered or hard to navigate.

query_text_zh: 为我的面包房做一个网站，让客户可以预订定制生日蛋糕，同时看到当前的促销价格，因为我经常收到临时订单，最后都得手忙脚乱地赶工，所以我想要一个简单的浏览器工具，让客户能选择蛋糕的大小和口味、看到生日蛋糕的促销价格，然后提交订单并选择取餐日期，这样我就能提前知道有什么订单要准备。

corpus_topic: Auto repair shop new-customer coupon claim page
query_text: Build a web app for my auto repair shop that lets new customers claim a first-visit coupon, because right now I hand out paper coupons and half of them get lost or misused, so I want a simple site where new customers enter their info to grab the discount code, see what the coupon covers like a free inspection or a discount on the first repair, and I can track who claimed it.
query_text_zh: 为我的汽车修理店做一个网站，让新客户能领取初次访问优惠券，因为现在我发放纸质优惠券，但很多都会丢失或被误用，所以我想要一个简单的网站，新客户可以输入他们的信息来获取折扣代码，看到优惠券包含的内容比如免费检测或第一次修理打折，而且我可以跟踪谁领取了优惠券。

corpus_topic: Laundry service bulk drop-off discount landing page
query_text: Make a web app for my laundry pickup service that shows customers the bulk drop-off discount tiers, because I keep explaining the pricing over and over through text messages, so I want a website where they can see that dropping off more than five kilos gets them a certain discount and ten kilos gets them a better rate, and then they can fill out a simple form to schedule a drop-off with the discounted price already applied.
query_text_zh: 为我的洗衣取件服务做一个网站，展示给客户分阶段的批量送衣折扣，因为我一直在通过短信解释价格，每次都要重复同样的内容，所以我想要一个网站，客户能看到送超过五公斤的衣物可以获得某种折扣，送十公斤可以获得更好的价格，然后他们可以填写一个简单的表格来安排送衣时间，折扣价格已经自动应用。

corpus_topic: Flower shop Valentine's Day bundle deal site
query_text: Need a website for my flower shop that shows all the Valentine's Day bundle deals in one place, because every year I get a flood of questions asking what's included and how much things cost and I spend hours just answering the same things, so I want a browser-based site where each bundle shows what flowers are included, the special price, and a way for customers to reserve one before they sell out.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站来展示我花店的所有情人节套餐优惠，因为每年我都会收到大量问题，问套餐里有什么花、价格是多少，我要花好几个小时才能回答同样的问题，所以我想要一个网站，能显示每个套餐包含的花卉、特殊价格，还能让客户预订，在售完前抢到位置。

corpus_topic: Tutoring center back-to-school enrollment promo site
query_text: Need a web app for my tutoring center that shows all the back-to-school enrollment deals so parents don't keep calling me to ask about prices and slots, because it's exhausting to repeat the same information every August, so I want a site where I can list the different subject packages at their promo prices, show how many spots are left, and let parents sign up for a spot directly without me having to follow up manually.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站为我的辅导中心展示返校季的招生优惠，这样家长就不用一直打电话问价格和名额了，因为每年八月都要重复回答相同的问题，真的很累，所以我想要一个网站，能列出不同科目的套餐及其促销价格、还能显示还有多少名额剩余，让家长可以直接报名，不用我一个一个地手动跟进。

corpus_topic: Massage parlor membership upgrade offer page
query_text: Create a web app for my massage place where existing customers can see what they get if they upgrade their membership, because I currently explain the tiers verbally and people forget by the time they get home, so I want a simple site that shows the current member level, the next tier up with its perks and price difference, and a button to confirm the upgrade so I stop losing people who were interested but never followed through.
query_text_zh: 为我的按摩店做一个网站，让现有客户能看到升级会员可以得到什么，因为我目前是口头解释会员等级，客户回家后就忘了，所以我想要一个简单的网站，能显示当前会员等级、下一个等级有什么福利以及价格差异，还有一个按钮来确认升级，这样我就不会再失去那些有兴趣但最后没有跟进的客户。

corpus_topic: Photography studio portrait package promotional web page
query_text: Need a web page for my photography studio that lays out all the portrait packages and their current promo prices in a way I can just send people the link instead of typing out the same details every week, so I want a website where each package shows sample photos, what's included like number of edited shots and backdrop options, and the promotional price, with a form at the end where they can book a session.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页为我的摄影工作室展示所有的人像套餐和当前的促销价格，这样我就可以直接把链接发给客户而不用每周都打字重复相同的内容，所以我想要一个网站，每个套餐显示样本照片、包含的内容比如编辑后的照片数量和背景选择，还有促销价格，最后有一个表格让他们可以预订一次拍摄。

corpus_topic: 外卖下单
query_text: Build a web app for food delivery ordering that lets customers browse the menu, pick items, and submit their order without having to call in, because right now I take orders over the phone and I write things down wrong half the time, so I want a browser-based tool where customers see the menu with prices, add things to their order, put in their delivery address, and send it through so I get a clean order summary on my end.
query_text_zh: 做一个外卖订餐网站，让客户能浏览菜单、选择商品、提交订单，不用打电话，因为现在我通过电话接单，经常记错内容，所以我想要一个网站，客户能看到菜单和价格、添加商品到订单、输入收货地址，然后提交，这样我能收到一份清洁的订单总结。

corpus_topic: 会员储值
query_text: A member stored-value top-up tool for my shop, built as a website customers can open on their desktop browser, where they can see their current balance, pick from a few top-up amounts that come with bonus credits, and confirm the recharge, because right now I track this in a notebook and customers have no way to check their own balance without asking me, so the whole thing takes way too long at the counter.
query_text_zh: 为我的店做一个会员储值充值工具，放在一个客户可以在电脑浏览器上打开的网站，这样他们可以看到当前余额、选择几个充值金额选项、这些选项会附带奖励积分，然后确认充值，因为现在我用笔记本记录这些，客户没办法查看自己的余额除非问我，所以整个流程在收银台花了太多时间。

corpus_topic: service quote calculator for small home repair contractors
query_text: Need a calculator tool for my home repair contracting work that lets me fill in the job type, materials, hours, and any travel fee so it spits out a quote I can hand to the customer, because right now I do this math in my head or in a notes app and I always miss something, so I want a web app I can open in the browser, enter the details for each job, and get a clean total with a breakdown I can show the customer on the spot.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个计算器工具来做我的家庭维修承包工作，能让我输入工作类型、材料、工时数和任何上门费，然后给出一个报价我可以给客户，因为现在我要么心算要么用笔记应用，总是会遗漏什么，所以我想要一个网站应用，能在浏览器打开、输入每个工作的详情、然后得到一个清洁的总计和明细，我可以当面给客户看。

corpus_topic: staff rota planner web app for micro-restaurant teams
query_text: A weekly staff schedule planner for my small restaurant team, the kind you open in a desktop browser and just fill in who works which shift each day, because right now I write it on paper and half the staff says they never saw it, so I want a web app where I can assign each person their shifts for the week, see any overlaps or gaps at a glance, and share the finished schedule so everyone can check it themselves.
query_text_zh: 为我的小餐厅团队做一个每周员工排班计划，是那种在电脑浏览器打开然后填入每个员工每天值班哪个班次的类型，因为现在我写在纸上，一半的员工说他们没看到，所以我想要一个网站，能让我给每个人分配他们这周的班次、一眼就能看到有没有重叠或空缺，然后分享完成的排班表，这样大家都能自己查看。

corpus_topic: freelance caterer invoice and receipt generation portal
query_text: Create a web app that helps me generate invoices and receipts for my catering gigs, because right now I type everything into a text document and it looks unprofessional, so I want a browser-based tool where I enter the client name, event date, what food and services I provided, and the price, and it produces a clean invoice I can print or send as a PDF, with a separate receipt I can give once they pay.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站帮我为我的餐饮活动生成发票和收据，因为现在我把所有东西都打到文本文档里，看起来不专业，所以我想要一个浏览器工具，输入客户名称、活动日期、我提供的食物和服务、还有价格，然后它就生成一个漂亮的发票我可以打印或发送为PDF格式，还有一份单独的收据我可以在他们付款后给他们。

corpus_topic: local loyalty punch-card program web dashboard
query_text: A loyalty punch-card tracker for my local shop, running as a web app customers can check on their computer, where each customer has a running stamp count and can see how many more purchases they need before earning a free item, because right now I do it on paper cards that people lose all the time, so I want something I can pull up at the counter to log a purchase and show the customer their updated progress.
query_text_zh: 为我的本地店做一个会员打卡记录系统，是一个客户可以在他们的电脑上查看的网站应用，每个客户有一个不断累加的印章计数、可以看到还要购买多少次才能赢得一个免费商品，因为现在我用纸卡片记录，客户经常丢失纸卡，所以我想要一个应用，我可以在收银台拉起来记录一次购买、给客户显示他们更新后的进度。

corpus_topic: table reservation and deposit collection site for independent restaurants
query_text: Build a web app for my independent restaurant that handles table reservations and collects a small deposit when someone books, because people make reservations and then just never show up and I lose that table for the whole night, so I want a website where customers pick a date, time, and party size, see the available slots, pay a small holding deposit through the site, and I get a confirmed booking I can actually rely on.
query_text_zh: 为我的独立餐厅做一个网站来处理餐桌预订并收取一笔小的订金，因为人们预订后就不来了，我那张桌子整晚都空着，所以我想要一个网站，客户选择日期、时间和人数、看到可用的时段、通过网站支付小额押金、我得到一个确认的预订我可以真正依赖。

corpus_topic: inventory reorder alert tracker for small neighborhood retailers
query_text: Create a web app inventory tracker for my small neighborhood store that warns me when stock on any item is getting low so I know when to reorder, because right now I walk the shelves and guess what needs restocking and I always miss things until they run out, so I want a browser-based tool where I enter my products with their reorder thresholds and it flags anything that has fallen below that level so I can place orders before I run out.
query_text_zh: 为我的小社区店做一个库存追踪网站应用，当任何商品的库存不足时警告我让我知道什么时候该补货，因为现在我在货架上走来走去靠猜测什么需要补货，我总是会错过一些直到它们售完，所以我想要一个浏览器工具，输入我的商品和它们的补货阈值，当任何商品低于这个水平时它就会标记出来，这样我可以在售完之前下单。

corpus_topic: wholesale price list portal for local food and beverage suppliers
query_text: Need a web app that shows my wholesale price list to small restaurant and cafe buyers who order from me regularly, because right now I send updated price lists over chat and people always have the old version, so I want a browser-based site where I can update prices myself and buyers can log in to see the current rates per item, filter by category like beverages or dry goods, and submit a bulk order directly from the price list.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站应用来展示我的批发价目表给经常从我这里订货的小餐厅和咖啡馆老板，因为现在我通过聊天发送更新的价目表，客户总是有旧版本，所以我想要一个网站，我可以自己更新价格、买家可以登录看当前的每件商品的价格、按饮料或干货等品类筛选、直接从价目表提交批量订单。

corpus_topic: small agency service portfolio and client case study showcase site
query_text: Need a website that shows off my small agency's past projects and client results so I can send it to potential clients instead of attaching a bunch of files to an email, because right now my portfolio is just a folder on my desktop that I screenshot and paste together, so I want a web app where I can list each project with a brief description, the results we got for that client, and a way for interested businesses to reach out through the site.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站来展示我小型代理公司的过往项目和客户成果，这样我可以把它发给潜在客户而不用附加一堆文件到邮件里，因为现在我的作品集就是我电脑桌面上的一个文件夹，我截图然后粘贴到一起，所以我想要一个网站应用，能列出每个项目包括简要描述、我们为那个客户取得的成果、还有一种方式让感兴趣的公司通过这个网站与我联系。

corpus_topic: e-signature contract portal for independent local service providers
query_text: Create a web app that lets me send contracts to clients so they can sign them online and I get a confirmed copy, because right now I print everything and either mail it or have people come in just to sign a piece of paper, which wastes everyone's time, so I want a browser-based tool where I upload the contract, the client gets a link, they read it and add their signature on the site, and I get notified when it is done.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站让我能把合同发给客户，这样他们可以在线签署它而且我会得到一份确认的副本，因为现在我打印所有东西然后要么邮寄要么让人们来办公室就为了签署一张纸，这太浪费时间了，所以我想要一个浏览器工具，我上传合同、客户得到一个链接、他们读它、在网站上添加签名、我在完成时得到通知。

corpus_topic: daily sales reconciliation dashboard for small multi-category shops
query_text: Need a web app that helps me reconcile my daily sales across different product categories so I can close out the register at the end of each day without spending an hour hunting down discrepancies, because right now I add things up manually and I always find a mismatch I cannot explain, so I want a browser-based tool where I enter the cash, card, and transfer totals by category and it shows me whether everything matches or where the gap is.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站来帮我按不同产品类别核对我的日销售情况，这样我就能在每天结束时关闭收银机而不需要花一个小时寻找差异，因为现在我手动加总，总是发现一个不匹配我无法解释，所以我想要一个浏览器工具，输入现金、卡和转账总额按类别分类、然后它显示我是否一切都匹配或差异在哪里。

corpus_topic: B2B quote and inquiry management site for small artisan makers
query_text: Build a web app for my handmade goods business where wholesale buyers can submit an inquiry with the items and quantities they want, and I can respond with a quote, because right now buyers email me with random details and I spend ages piecing together what they actually need, so I want a website where they fill out a proper inquiry form, I get a clean summary, and I can send back a quote they can accept or negotiate.
query_text_zh: 为我的手工商品业务做一个网站，批发买家可以提交一个询价单，说他们想要的商品和数量，然后我可以回复一个报价，因为现在买家用随机的细节给我发邮件，我花很久才能搞清楚他们实际需要什么，所以我想要一个网站，他们填出一个正式的询价单、我得到一个清洁的总结、然后我可以回复一个他们可以接受或协商的报价。

corpus_topic: restaurant tip pooling and payroll split calculator site
query_text: Need a web app calculator for my restaurant that figures out how to split the tip pool and the payroll among the staff after each shift, because right now I do it by hand and someone always argues the math, so I want a browser-based tool where I enter the total tips collected, the hours each person worked, and their role, and it calculates each person's share automatically so I can just show everyone the breakdown and be done with it.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站计算器为我的餐厅计算如何在每个班次后分配小费池和工资给员工，因为现在我手工计算，总有人对数学提出异议，所以我想要一个浏览器工具，输入收集的总小费、每个人工作的小时数和他们的职位、然后它自动计算每个人的份额，这样我就可以给大家显示明细然后就完事了。

corpus_topic: 试妆/咨询预约
query_text: Need a web app for my beauty studio that lets clients book a makeup trial or a consultation without having to message me back and forth, because I spend so much time just coordinating times and it always takes several messages to confirm one appointment, so I want a website where clients pick a service type, choose a date and time slot from my available calendar, and submit their booking so it just shows up in my schedule automatically.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站为我的美妆工作室让客户能预订化妆试色或咨询而不用来回给我发信息，因为我花了太多时间就在协调时间、总是要花好几条信息才能确认一个约会，所以我想要一个网站，客户选择服务类型、从我的可用日历选择日期和时间段、提交预订，这样它就直接显示在我的日程里了。

corpus_topic: pet grooming salon appointment booking site
query_text: Make a booking site for my pet grooming salon that works in a desktop browser so clients can pick their dog or cat, choose a grooming service, and schedule an appointment without calling me, because I miss calls when I am in the middle of a groom and then I lose customers, so I want a web app where they see my open time slots, select one, enter their pet's details, and confirm the appointment so I see it right away.
query_text_zh: 为我的宠物美容沙龙做一个预订网站，能在电脑浏览器上用，客户可以选择他们的狗或猫、选择美容服务、安排一个约会而不用打电话给我，因为当我在给宠物美容时我会漏接电话然后我就丢失客户，所以我想要一个网站应用，他们看到我的空闲时段、选择一个、输入他们宠物的详情、确认约会，这样我就立刻看到它。

corpus_topic: local music tutor one-on-one lesson booking platform
query_text: Need a web app for scheduling one-on-one music lessons with me as a local tutor, because right now my students and their parents text me at all hours asking if I have a slot open and I have to check my paper calendar every time, so I want a website where people can see which lesson times I have available, pick the instrument and lesson length they want, fill in their info, and confirm the booking so it goes straight onto my schedule.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站来安排和我一对一的音乐课程作为本地老师，因为现在我的学生和他们的父母随时给我发短信问我是否有空闲时段、我得每次都查我的纸质日历，所以我想要一个网站，人们能看到我有哪些课程时间可用、选择他们想要的乐器和课程时长、填写他们的信息、确认预订，这样它直接进入我的日程。

corpus_topic: photography studio portrait session reservation site
query_text: Need a web app for a photography studio where clients can book portrait sessions online without having to call and wait on hold, because that whole back-and-forth is such a waste of time. It should show which time slots are open, let people pick a session type (headshots, family portraits, etc.), fill in their name and contact info, and get a confirmation right away, so the studio owner and the client both know what's happening.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站让摄影工作室的客户能在线预订人像拍摄而不用打电话等待接听，因为来回协调真的太浪费时间了，它应该显示哪些时段是开放的、让人们选择一种拍摄类型比如证件照或全家福等、填写他们的名字和联系方式、立刻得到确认，这样摄影师和客户都知道发生了什么。

corpus_topic: small auto repair shop service appointment scheduler
query_text: Need a web app that lets a small auto repair shop take service appointments online, so customers can just go to the site and pick a time themselves instead of calling during busy hours. It should let people choose the type of service they need, like oil change or tire rotation, pick an open slot on the calendar, and submit their car info, and the shop side should be able to see all upcoming appointments lined up in one place.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站让小型汽车修理店能在线接受维修预约，所以客户可以直接去网站选择时间而不用在忙碌时段打电话，它应该让人们选择他们需要的服务类型比如换油或轮胎旋转、选择一个日历上的开放时段、提交他们的车辆信息、店铺这一侧应该能在一个地方看到所有即将到来的约会排成一行。

corpus_topic: independent nail salon slot and walk-in booking site
query_text: Need a web app for a small nail salon that lets customers book a specific time slot or sign up as a walk-in so the owner stops getting messaged on her phone all day. The booking side should show which nail techs have open slots, let customers pick a service and time, and the salon owner should be able to see the day's appointments and current walk-in queue in one browser window so nothing gets mixed up.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站为小型美甲沙龙让客户能预订一个特定的时段或作为现场客户登记，这样老板就不会一整天都被手机消息轰炸，预订这一侧应该显示哪些美甲技师有开放时段、让客户选择服务和时间、沙龙老板应该能在一个浏览器窗口看到这天的约会和当前的现场客户队列，这样就不会混淆了。

corpus_topic: local tattoo artist portfolio and session booking site
query_text: Need a web app for a local tattoo artist that shows off their portfolio and lets people book a session right from the same site, because right now everything is scattered across Instagram and text messages and it's a mess. Clients should be able to browse the artist's past work by style, pick an available date, describe what they want, and submit a booking request, and the artist should see all requests in a simple list they can approve or decline.

query_text_zh: 做个新闻稿包页面真的要像一个有灵魂的真实公司而不只是文件夹转储。我想要浏览器里干净有品味的排版让记者能轻松拿到logo文件、品牌色、产品截图和创始人头照不用发邮件。整个东西应该看起来有意图而且有自己安静的身份，让你能看出有人在乎它的样子。

corpus_topic: SaaS affiliate and referral program portal
query_text: A referral and affiliate program page for a SaaS startup that carries the same personal identity as the rest of the product, not some generic sign-up wall. It should feel like you are being welcomed into something real, with a sidebar showing your referral link and earnings in a way that feels thoughtful rather than transactional. The browser page should have enough warmth that someone actually wants to share it.
query_text_zh: 一个SaaS创业的推荐和联盟计划页面要和产品的个人身份一样而不是某个泛泛的注册墙。应该感觉像被欢迎进入真实的东西，侧栏显示你的推荐链接和收入的方式要周到而不是交易性的。浏览器页面应该有足够温暖让人真的想去分享它。

corpus_topic: Email newsletter opt-in landing page
query_text: Build a newsletter sign-up page that has its own personality and does not feel like every other generic opt-in form on the internet. I want it to have a specific look in the browser, something with taste, where the headline and the small details around the email field make someone feel like they are joining something worth caring about. The whole page should carry the identity of the thing it is promoting.
query_text_zh: 建个新闻通讯注册页面有自己的个性而不像互联网上其他泛泛的选择加入表单。我想要浏览器里有具体的样子有品味，标题和邮件字段四周的小细节让人感觉像是在加入什么值得在乎的东西。整个页面要承载它在推广的东西的身份。

corpus_topic: Third-party integrations and app marketplace directory
query_text: Need a page in the browser where people can browse all the tools and services our app connects with, like a directory of everything it plays nice with. I want it to feel like a curated collection rather than just a big technical list, with a sidebar or categories that let you filter by type of tool. It should feel like someone with taste put it together, not like an auto-generated index page.
query_text_zh: 要在浏览器里一个页面让人浏览我们的应用连接的所有工具和服务就像一个工具目录。我想要感觉像精选的集合而不是纯粹的技术列表，侧栏或类别让你按工具类型过滤。应该感觉像有品味的人组织的而不是自动生成的索引页。

corpus_topic: Public changelog and product release notes page
query_text: Build a public changelog page that has the kind of identity a good indie product carries, not just a plain list of version numbers and bullet points. Every update entry should feel like a small piece of writing someone actually cared about, with a consistent visual tone across the whole browser page. People who follow the product should feel something when they open it, like they are watching something grow with intention.
query_text_zh: 建个公开更新日志页面有好的独立产品那样的身份而不只是版本号和要点列表。每条更新条目应该感觉像一小段有人真的在乎的文字，整个浏览器页面有一致的视觉语调。追踪这个产品的人打开它应该有感受就像他们在看一个有意图地成长的东西。

corpus_topic: Year-in-review annual milestones microsite
query_text: Create a year-in-review microsite that feels like a love letter to the year rather than a corporate report dressed up in colorful charts. I want it to open in the browser as something with its own mood, where the milestones, numbers, and little stories from the year all feel deliberately placed. The whole thing should carry a specific identity so people can immediately tell it belongs to us.
query_text_zh: 建个年度回顾微网站感觉像是对这一年的情书而不是穿着彩色图表的企业报告。我想要它在浏览器里打开有自己的气氛，里面的里程碑、数字和这一年的小故事都感觉是精心放置的。整个东西应该有具体的身份这样人们能立刻看出这是我们的。

corpus_topic: Founder story and team bios about page
query_text: Build an about page that tells the founder story and shows the team in a way that actually feels honest and specific, not like every other startup about page with the same stock-photo energy. I want it to open in the browser with its own visual character where each person's bio has the kind of detail that makes them feel real. The page should carry the identity of the product so it reads as one coherent thing.
query_text_zh: 建个关于页面用真实具体的方式讲创始人故事和展示团队而不像其他所有创业公司的关于页面有那样的库存照片能量。我想要它在浏览器里打开有自己的视觉特征每个人的自传有那样让他们看起来像真人的细节。页面应该有产品的身份这样读起来像一个连贯的东西。

corpus_topic: SaaS enterprise pricing calculator with annual contract options
query_text: Make a pricing calculator page for enterprise plans where I can put in how many seats or users we have and it just figures out the annual cost without me needing to call a sales rep. I want it to work right in the browser, maybe with a slider or some simple number fields, and it should be honest about what each tier actually covers so I can compare annual vs monthly without going cross-eyed. Just something that saves me the back-and-forth.
query_text_zh: 做个企业计划的价格计算页面我能输入我们有多少座位或用户它就算出年成本不用我打电话给销售。我想要它在浏览器里工作可能用滑块或简单的数字字段，它应该老实说明每一档实际包括什么这样我能比较年付和月付不用看花眼。就是个省去来回讨论的东西。

corpus_topic: B2B sales proposal and quote generation platform
query_text: A simple web tool where my sales team can fill in a client name, the services we are pitching, and a few line items and it spits out a clean proposal or quote they can send right away without copying stuff between spreadsheets. It needs to work in the browser so anyone on the team can use it without installing anything, and the output should look professional enough that we are not embarrassed to send it to a real business client.
query_text_zh: 简单的网络工具我的销售团队能填进客户名、我们在推销的服务和一些行项目然后它就吐出干净的建议或报价他们能直接发不用在电子表格间复制。它需要在浏览器里工作这样任何人都能用而不用装东西，输出应该足够专业这样我们不尴尬发给真实的商业客户。

corpus_topic: SaaS ARR and revenue forecasting dashboard for teams
query_text: Make a page where the whole team can look at our recurring revenue numbers and see a simple forecast for the next few months without anyone needing to dig through spreadsheets. I want it to open in the browser so everyone can check it during a meeting, with clear numbers showing current revenue, projected growth, and maybe a simple chart so you can spot trends at a glance. Nothing fancy, just something that saves us from emailing each other updated spreadsheets every week.
query_text_zh: 做个页面全团队能看我们的定期收入数字而且看几个月后的简单预测而不用谁去挖电子表格。我想要它在浏览器里打开这样每个人都能在会议里查，清晰的数字显示现在的收入、预测增长也许一个简单的图表这样你能一眼看出趋势。不用复杂，就是能省每周互相发更新电子表格的东西。

corpus_topic: Multi-tier subscription plan comparison and selection page
query_text: A side-by-side plan comparison page in the browser where someone can look at all our subscription tiers at once and see clearly what each one includes, without having to click between separate pages to figure out what they are actually paying for. It should be easy to read so a normal person can pick the right plan without needing to email support, and maybe let them select the one they want right from the comparison view.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里一个平行对比的计划页面有人能一次看到我们的所有订阅档位清楚地看每个包括什么而不用点击不同页面去弄清楚他们实际付的是什么。应该容易读这样普通人能挑对计划而不用发邮件联系支持，也许让他们从对比视图里直接选。

corpus_topic: Customer expansion revenue and upsell opportunity tracker
query_text: Make a web page where the sales team can see which existing customers might be ready to upgrade or buy more, without having to dig through a bunch of separate reports. I want a simple list or view in the browser that shows which accounts have been growing their usage, which ones are close to hitting a limit, and maybe a place to note the next step for each one. Just something that makes it obvious where to focus instead of guessing.
query_text_zh: 做个页面销售团队能看哪些现有客户可能准备升级或买更多而不用挖一堆分离的报告。我想要在浏览器里简单的列表或视图显示哪些账户使用在增长、哪些接近碰到限制也许有个地方记录下一步。就是个让明显该聚焦在哪而不是猜的东西。

corpus_topic: SaaS startup invoice and billing management portal
query_text: Need a billing page in the browser where I can see all our invoices, check what is paid or overdue, and send reminders without having to log into three different places. I want it to show a clean list of everything we have billed, let me download individual invoices, and make it obvious at a glance if anything needs attention. Right now tracking this stuff takes way too long and I always feel like I am missing something.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里一个账单页面我能看所有发票、查看什么付了什么过期还能发提醒而不用登到三个不同的地方。我想要它显示干净的一切我们开的账单清单、让我下载单个发票、一眼看清什么需要注意。现在追踪这个花的时间太长我总觉得漏什么。

corpus_topic: Partner reseller program enrollment and commission tracking portal
query_text: Build a portal in the browser where reseller partners can sign up for our partner program, see how much commission they have earned, and track which of their referrals have converted into paying customers. I want everything in one place so partners are not emailing us every week asking for updates, with a clear view of their current status, payout history, and what they need to do to reach the next tier.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里建个门户经销商伙伴能注册我们的伙伴计划、看他们赚了多少佣金、追踪他们的哪些推荐转成付费客户。我想要一切在一个地方这样伙伴不是每周都邮件我们要更新，清晰地看他们的现在状态、支付历史和他们需要做什么达到下一档。

corpus_topic: Quote-to-cash workflow automation platform for SaaS teams
query_text: A web tool that handles the whole process of turning a quote into a signed deal and then into a paid invoice without the team having to copy information between three different apps. It should live in the browser so everyone can access it, track where each deal is in the process, and make it obvious when something is stuck waiting on a signature or a payment. Right now we lose time every week just chasing things through email.
query_text_zh: 网络工具处理整个流程把报价变成签署的交易然后变成付费发票而不用团队在三个不同应用间复制信息。它应该在浏览器里这样大家都能访问、追踪每个交易在流程的什么地方、让明显什么卡在等签名或付款。现在我们每周浪费时间用邮件追踪东西。

corpus_topic: Self-service account tier upgrade and downgrade portal
query_text: Make a page where customers can upgrade or downgrade their own subscription plan without having to contact support and wait for someone to do it for them. I want it to work right in the browser, show clearly what each plan costs and what changes, and let them confirm the switch without anything confusing happening to their billing. It would save us so many support tickets if people could just handle this themselves.
query_text_zh: 做个页面客户能自己升级或降级订阅计划而不用联系支持等有人给他们做。我想要它在浏览器里工作清楚显示每个计划的成本和什么改变，让他们确认转换而不会发生什么令人困惑的事到他们的账单。如果人们能自己处理这个会省我们那么多支持工单。

corpus_topic: B2B inbound lead scoring and sales routing dashboard
query_text: Need a page in the browser where incoming leads get scored and assigned to the right sales person automatically so nobody has to manually sort through a pile of form submissions every morning. I want to see a list of new leads with some kind of priority indicator, which rep they got sent to, and a way to quickly reassign if something looks wrong. It would cut out a lot of the daily manual work we do just to figure out who should follow up on what.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里要个页面进来的线索被计分和自动指派给对的销售人员这样没人用手动整理每天早上的表单提交堆。我想看一个新线索的列表某种优先指示符、他们被发给哪个代表和快速重新指派的方法如果什么看起来不对。会去掉很多日常手动工作我们只是做弄清谁应该跟进什么。

corpus_topic: Trial-to-paid conversion funnel analytics and optimization site
query_text: Create a page in the browser where we can see how many free trial users are actually converting to paid, where most of them drop off, and what kinds of users tend to convert so we can figure out what to improve. I want it to show the numbers clearly without me having to pull reports from five different places, maybe a simple view of the conversion rate over time and which steps in the trial most people are reaching before they leave.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里建个页面我们能看有多少免费试用用户实际在转成付费、他们在哪最多掉队、什么类型的用户倾向于转换这样我们能弄清什么要改进。我想要没有我从五个地方拉报告的数字清楚显示，也许一个简单的看过时间的转换率和试用里大多数人到达什么步骤后就离开。

corpus_topic: Corporate vendor evaluation and procurement shortlisting portal
query_text: Need a web page where our team can evaluate vendors we are considering and keep track of who made the shortlist and why, instead of having everyone's notes scattered across email and random shared documents. I want a browser-based place where we can add vendors, fill in some standard questions for each one, score them, and see a summary of how they stack up so the final decision is not just whoever sent the best email.
query_text_zh: 要个网页我们的团队能评估我们在考虑的供应商并追踪谁进了短名单和为什么，而不用每个人的笔记散落在邮件和随机的共享文件里。我想一个浏览器地方我们能加供应商、给每个填标准问题、给他们评分、看到摘要怎么堆积这样最终决定不只是谁发了最好的邮件。

corpus_topic: Business contract e-signature and renewal management tool
query_text: Build a tool in the browser where we can send contracts out for e-signature and also track when each one is up for renewal so we are not suddenly blindsided by expired agreements. I want a list of all our active contracts, who signed them, what date they renew, and an easy way to send out a new version when it is time. Right now I have a spreadsheet for this but it never stays current and I always miss something.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里建个工具我们能发合同去电子签名而且也追踪每个什么时候更新这样我们不会突然被过期的协议吓到。我想要一个列表所有活跃合约、谁签的、什么日期更新、还有发新版本的简单方法当它是时候了。现在我有电子表格这个但它从不保持最新而且我总是漏什么。

corpus_topic: Waitlist 登记
query_text: Build a waitlist sign-up page in the browser where people can put in their email and get added to a list before we officially launch, without me needing to set up anything complicated. I want it to confirm their spot once they sign up and maybe show how many people are already on the list so it feels like something worth waiting for. It should be simple to share the link and easy for me to see how many people have signed up.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里建个等待名单注册页面人能输入邮件被加到列表里在我们正式推出前而不用我设置什么复杂的东西。我想要它在他们注册后确认他们的位置也许显示已经有多少人在列表里这样感觉像什么值得等的。应该简单分享链接对我来说容易看有多少人注册了。

corpus_topic: Investor pitch call scheduling page for pre-seed founders
query_text: Need a page in the browser where investors can book a short call with me to hear about my startup, without the back-and-forth of trying to find a time over email. I want them to be able to see my available slots, pick one that works, and get a confirmation without me having to do anything manually. Something straightforward that makes me look organized and saves both of us the scheduling headache.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里要个页面投资者能和我预订短通话听我的创业而不用邮件里试图找时间的来回。我想要他们能看我有效的时间段、挑一个适合的、得到确认而不用我手动做什么。简单的东西让我看起来有组织而且给我们俩省了日程安排的头痛。

corpus_topic: Co-founder matching speed-dating session booking site
query_text: A web page where early-stage founders who are looking for co-founders can book into speed-dating style sessions, pick a time slot that works for them, and see who else will be in the same session so they can come prepared. It should be easy to navigate in the browser and not require a bunch of setup from the person booking, just find a slot, fill in a bit about what they are working on, and confirm.
query_text_zh: 网页早期创始人在找合伙人能预订到相亲风格会话、选一个对他们有效的时间段、看谁也会在同样会话这样他们能准备好。应该容易在浏览器里导航而且不用那个预订人设置一堆，只是找时间段、填一点他们在做什么、确认。

corpus_topic: Startup mentor office-hours slot reservation portal
query_text: Build a simple page in the browser where startup founders can see a mentor's available office hours and book a slot without having to send a cold email and wait to hear back. I want the mentor to be able to set their available times and the founder to just pick one, add a short note about what they want to discuss, and get a confirmation. It should save everyone from the back-and-forth that makes these kinds of sessions harder to set up than they need to be.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里建个简单页面创业创始人能看导师有效的办公时间和预订时间段而不用发冷邮件然后等回音。我想导师能设他们有效的时间而且创始人只是选一个、加一短句他们想讨论什么、得到确认。应该省每个人从让这样的会话比他们需要难设置的来回。

corpus_topic: Accelerator cohort interview time-slot booking platform
query_text: Create a booking page in the browser where startup founders applying to an accelerator can pick a time slot for their interview from whatever times are still available, so the whole interview scheduling process does not have to be done manually by email. I want it to show open slots clearly, let someone pick and confirm in a couple of clicks, and automatically mark that slot as taken so two people cannot book the same time.
query_text_zh: 在浏览器里建个预订页面创业创始人申请加速器能从仍然有效的时间里选一个时间段这样整个采访日程流程不用邮件手动做。我想要它清楚显示开放的时间段、让有人在几次点击里选并确认、自动标记那个时间段为已占所以两个人不能订同样的时间。

corpus_topic: Beta user product feedback video call scheduler
query_text: Make a web app that handles scheduling video calls with beta users who want to give feedback on the product, because right now I'm doing this all manually and it's a total pain. The app should let beta users pick a time from my available slots, collect a quick note about what they want to talk about, and send a confirmation with the call link, so I stop chasing people over email just to set up a 30-minute call.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用来帮我管理和测试用户的视频通话预约，因为现在我都是手动安排，效率特别低。应用应该让测试用户从我的时间段中选择一个，记录一下他们想聊什么问题，然后自动发送确认邮件和通话链接，这样我就不用一个一个地追邮件来安排30分钟的通话了。

corpus_topic: UX research participant interview booking for SaaS teams
query_text: Build a browser-based tool for SaaS teams to book interview slots with UX research participants, so we can stop juggling spreadsheets and calendar invite chains every time we need to talk to users. The tool should show available time slots on one side and let participants pick a slot and fill in a short form with their background, and the team should see all booked interviews in a simple list they can manage from desktop.
query_text_zh: 我想为我们的SaaS团队建一个浏览器工具，用来预约用户研究的时间段，这样就不用再折腾电子表格和日历邀请链了。这个工具应该一边显示可用的时间段，另一边让参与者选择时间并填一个简短的表单说一下他们的背景信息，然后团队可以在一个简单的列表里看到所有预约的访谈，在桌面上就能管理。

corpus_topic: Enterprise onboarding kickoff call booking for new SaaS clients
query_text: Make a web app that new enterprise clients can use to book their onboarding kickoff call after they sign up for the SaaS product, so our team doesn't have to manually coordinate this every single time. The app should show our team's available times, let the client choose a slot and enter their company name and main contact, and fire off a confirmation so everyone knows when the kickoff call is happening.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，让新的企业客户在注册我们的SaaS产品后可以预约他们的入职启动通话，这样我们的团队就不用每次都手动协调。这个应用应该显示我们团队的可用时间，让客户选择一个时间段并输入他们的公司名称和主要联系人，然后发送确认信息，这样每个人都知道什么时候进行启动通话。

corpus_topic: Customer success quarterly business review appointment system
query_text: Build a web app that lets our customer success team schedule quarterly business review meetings with clients without the usual back-and-forth email chaos. The tool should show a calendar of open slots, let clients pick a time that works for them, and keep a list of all upcoming and past review appointments organized by account name so the team can actually stay on top of who needs a review and when.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络应用来帮我们的客户成功团队安排与客户的季度业务回顾会议，避免那些烦人的邮件来回。这个工具应该显示一个日历，里面是开放的时间段，让客户选择适合他们的时间，并保存一个包含所有即将进行和过去的回顾约会的列表，按账户名称组织，这样团队可以真正跟上谁需要回顾以及什么时候。

corpus_topic: Free trial upgrade consultation call booking page
query_text: A simple booking tool for desktop browsers where free trial users can schedule a quick call with someone on the team to talk about upgrading, so we stop missing people who are interested but never hear back from us. The app should have a list of available times, a short form where the user says what they want to know before the call, and a confirmation page with the meeting details all in one spot.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个简单的预约工具，免费试用用户可以在桌面浏览器上预约一个快速通话来讨论升级事宜，这样我们就不会错过那些感兴趣但没有得到回复的用户。这个应用应该有一个可用时间的列表，一个简短的表单让用户说明他们在通话前想了解什么，还有一个确认页面，所有细节都在一个地方。

corpus_topic: SaaS implementation project kickoff call scheduler
query_text: Make a web app that helps our team schedule implementation kickoff calls with new clients right after they buy our SaaS product, because right now we're just sending emails back and forth and things fall through the cracks constantly. The app should show which project managers are available and when, let clients pick a time slot, and keep everything organized in a running list the team can check from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络应用来帮我们的团队在新客户购买我们的SaaS产品后立即安排实施启动通话，因为现在我们只是来回发邮件，经常会漏掉一些事情。这个应用应该显示哪些项目经理有空以及什么时候，让客户选择一个时间段，并在一个运行列表中保持所有内容的组织，团队可以从桌面浏览器中查看。

corpus_topic: Advisory board one-on-one meeting booking portal
query_text: Build a web-based booking tool where founders can schedule one-on-one meetings with their advisory board members without all the painful back-and-forth scheduling. The app should list each advisor with their available times, let you pick a slot and write a short agenda for the meeting, and then show all your upcoming advisor meetings in one place so you actually remember who you've talked to recently and who you've been neglecting.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络预约工具，让创业者可以和他们的顾问委员会成员预约一对一的会议，避免那些痛苦的日程来回。这个应用应该列出每个顾问和他们的可用时间，让你选择一个时间段并写一个简短的会议议程，然后在一个地方显示你所有即将进行的顾问会议，这样你就真的能记住最近和谁谈过，谁一直被你忽略了。

corpus_topic: Growth marketing audit call booking for early-stage startups
query_text: Build a web app that early-stage startups can use to book a growth marketing audit call with a consultant, because digging through contact forms and waiting days for a reply just to get a call on the calendar is ridiculous. The app should show open call slots, ask the startup a couple of quick questions about their current situation when they book, and give both sides a confirmation with the meeting time and a summary of what was submitted.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络应用，让早期创业公司可以预约一个增长营销审计通话，因为通过联系表格然后等好几天才能回复实在太麻烦了。这个应用应该显示开放的通话时间，问初创公司几个关于他们当前情况的快速问题，并为双方提供一个包含会议时间和提交内容摘要的确认。

corpus_topic: 最佳实践库
query_text: Make a web app that works as a best practices library for the team, where everyone can save, browse, and look up proven approaches we've figured out over time. I want each entry to have a clear title, a category so things stay organized, and a short description of when and why to use it. It should be easy to search from a desktop browser, and I'd like to see everything sorted by category in a sidebar so I can quickly jump to what I need.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用来作为团队的最佳实践库，每个人都可以保存、浏览和查找我们多年来摸索出的经过验证的方法。每个条目应该有一个清晰的标题、一个类别来保持组织，以及一个简短的描述说明何时以及为什么要使用它。应该很容易从桌面浏览器中搜索，我想在侧边栏中看到按类别排序的所有内容，这样我可以快速跳到我需要的东西。

corpus_topic: Interactive API sandbox with live code execution
query_text: Need a browser-based tool that works like a live coding sandbox so I can try out API calls and immediately see what comes back, with a text area on the left for writing the request and a results area on the right that shows the response right away. I also want a saved examples list so I can reload common requests quickly, and the whole thing should work well on a desktop browser with side-by-side panes so I can see both the input and output at the same time.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个浏览器工具，就像一个实时代码沙箱，可以试用API调用并立即看到返回的结果，左边是一个文本区域用来写请求，右边是一个结果区域立即显示响应。我还想要一个保存的示例列表，这样我可以快速重新加载常见的请求，整个应该在桌面浏览器上运行得很好，左右两边各一个窗格，这样我可以同时看到输入和输出。

corpus_topic: SaaS onboarding checklist portal for new team members
query_text: Make a web app that new team members can open on their desktop browser to see all their onboarding steps in one place, with each task listed clearly and a checkbox to mark it done so nothing gets missed. I want tasks grouped by topic, like account setup, tool access, and first-week goals, and each task should have a short note explaining what it is and why it matters, so new people know exactly what they need to do and in what order.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，让新团队成员可以在桌面浏览器上打开，在一个地方看到他们所有的入职步骤，每个任务清楚地列出来，还有一个复选框来标记完成，这样什么都不会遗漏。我想要任务按主题分组，比如账户设置、工具访问和第一周的目标，每个任务应该有一个简短的说明来解释它是什么以及为什么重要，这样新人就确切地知道他们需要做什么以及什么顺序。

corpus_topic: Feature adoption analytics dashboard for product teams
query_text: Need a web app for product teams to track how many users are actually picking up each new feature after it ships, with a simple list of features on one side and usage numbers next to each one. I want to be able to see which features are getting traction and which ones people are ignoring, with the option to filter by time period, and the whole thing should be accessible on a desktop browser so the team can pull it up during planning meetings.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用让产品团队跟踪有多少用户在新功能发布后真正开始使用，一边显示功能列表，另一边显示每个功能旁边的使用数字。我想要看到哪些功能获得了关注，哪些人在忽视，并且能够按时间段过滤，整个应该在桌面浏览器上可以使用，这样团队可以在规划会议中调出来。

corpus_topic: Customer education portal with multi-tier certification tracks
query_text: Make a web app that customers can use to work through different levels of product training and earn certificates when they finish each level, kind of like a course path that starts with the basics and goes up to advanced topics. I want each level to have its own set of lessons, a progress bar so users can see how far along they are, and a certificate they can download when they complete a level, all accessible from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络应用，让客户可以通过不同级别的产品培训，在完成每个级别时获得证书，有点像一个课程路径，从基础开始然后上升到高级主题。我想要每个级别都有自己的一套课程，一个进度条让用户可以看到他们已经完成了多少，还有一个他们在完成一个级别时可以下载的证书，全部可以从桌面浏览器访问。

corpus_topic: Interactive product walkthrough creator for SaaS demos
query_text: An interactive walkthrough builder app for desktop browsers where the team can put together step-by-step product demos by recording the main steps of a feature and adding a short explanation to each step. The app should let you string steps together into a complete walkthrough, preview how it looks before sharing, and organize all saved walkthroughs by product area so the demo library stays tidy and easy to hand off to sales or support.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个交互式演练构建应用，在桌面浏览器中团队可以通过记录一个功能的主要步骤并为每个步骤添加简短说明来组合分步产品演示。这个应用应该让你把步骤串在一起形成完整的演练，在分享前预览它的外观，并按产品区域组织所有保存的演练，这样演示库保持整洁，容易传递给销售或支持。

corpus_topic: Internal startup wiki with AI-powered semantic search
