query_text: Create a wiki app for our startup team that lives in the browser and lets everyone search for any topic using plain everyday language instead of having to know the exact title of a page. I want a clean sidebar with organized sections on the left and the article content on the right, and the search bar should be smart enough to surface the right page even if I type something slightly different from what the page is actually called, so we stop losing knowledge in a pile of old documents.
query_text_zh: 我想为我们的创业团队创建一个wiki应用，运行在浏览器中，让每个人都可以用平常的语言搜索任何主题，而不必知道一个页面的确切标题。我想要左边有一个干净的侧边栏，里面有组织好的部分，右边是文章内容，搜索栏应该足够聪明，即使我输入的内容与页面的实际标题略有不同，也能找到正确的页面，这样我们就不会在一堆旧文档中丢失知识。

corpus_topic: Employee LMS built specifically for SaaS startup teams
query_text: Build a training platform web app for our startup team where we can put together short courses for employees and track who has finished what, because right now onboarding training is just a pile of shared docs with no way to know if anyone actually read them. The app should let admins create courses with a few lessons each, let employees check off lessons as they finish, and show a simple progress view per person on the desktop browser so managers can see where everyone is.
query_text_zh: 我想为我们的创业团队建立一个培训平台网络应用，我们可以为员工编排短课程并跟踪谁完成了什么，因为现在入职培训只是一堆共享文档，没有办法知道是否有人真的读过。这个应用应该让管理员创建有几节课程的课程，让员工在完成课程时打勾，并在桌面浏览器上显示每个人的简单进度视图，这样经理可以看到每个人的进展。

corpus_topic: SaaS product certification and credentialing platform
query_text: Create a web app that lets our SaaS product team issue certificates to users who pass a product knowledge test, with a list of available certifications on the main screen and a simple way for users to take a short quiz and get a downloadable certificate if they pass. I want admins to be able to add new certification tracks from a desktop browser, and users should have a profile that shows all the certificates they've earned so they can share it.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网络应用，让我们的SaaS产品团队可以向通过产品知识测试的用户颁发证书，主屏幕上有一个可用认证的列表，用户有一个简单的方法来参加一个简短的测验，如果通过就可以获得一个可下载的证书。我想让管理员可以从桌面浏览器添加新的认证轨道，用户应该有一个个人资料显示他们赚取的所有证书，这样他们可以分享它。

corpus_topic: Case study explorer filtered by industry and use case
query_text: Need a web app that works like a library of customer case studies I can filter by industry and by what problem the customer solved, so I can quickly find the right story for a pitch or a conversation. The app should show each case study as a card with the company name, industry, and a one-line summary, and clicking one should open the full write-up in a reading view on the right side, all working nicely on a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，就像一个可以按行业过滤以及按客户解决的问题过滤的客户案例研究库，这样我可以快速找到适合推销或对话的正确故事。这个应用应该将每个案例研究显示为一个卡片，包含公司名称、行业和一行摘要，点击一个应该在右侧的阅读视图中打开完整的撰写内容，全部在桌面浏览器上运行良好。

corpus_topic: Changelog site with embedded per-feature micro-tutorials
query_text: Create a website that works as a product changelog where every update entry has a short how-to video or walkthrough built right into it, so users can read about a new feature and immediately see how to use it in the same place. I want the updates listed in order from newest to oldest, each one labeled with the date and a short title, and each entry should have space for a quick tutorial clip or a few annotated steps right below the description.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网站，作为一个产品更新日志，其中每个更新条目都内置了一个简短的操作视频或演练，所以用户可以了解一个新功能并立即看到如何在同一个地方使用它。我想要更新按从最新到最旧的顺序列出，每个都标有日期和简短标题，每个条目应该在描述下方有一个快速教程剪辑或几个带注释的步骤的空间。

corpus_topic: Technical glossary reference for SaaS product teams
query_text: Need a web app that works like a shared glossary for our SaaS product team, where everyone can look up what a term means and see a plain-language explanation right away. I want terms listed alphabetically with a search bar at the top so I can find things fast on a desktop browser, and each entry should show the term, a clear definition, and optionally a note about where it came from or how it's used in our product specifically.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，就像我们SaaS产品团队的一个共享词汇表，每个人都可以查找一个术语的含义并立即看到一个通俗易懂的解释。我想要术语按字母顺序列出，顶部有一个搜索栏，这样我可以在桌面浏览器上快速找到东西，每个条目应该显示术语、一个清晰的定义，以及可选的一个关于它来自何处或它在我们产品中如何使用的说明。

corpus_topic: Third-party integration setup guide library
query_text: Create a web app that collects all our third-party integration setup guides in one place, organized so the team can find the right guide quickly by browsing a list of integrations in a sidebar on the left and reading the step-by-step instructions on the right side of the screen. I want each guide to have the name of the tool, the setup steps in plain language, and a spot for notes or common gotchas, all accessible from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网络应用，将我们所有的第三方集成设置指南汇集在一个地方，组织得让团队可以通过浏览左侧侧边栏中的集成列表并在屏幕右侧阅读分步说明来快速找到正确的指南。我想要每个指南都有工具的名称、纯语言的设置步骤，以及一个用于笔记或常见陷阱的位置，全部可以从桌面浏览器访问。

corpus_topic: Feature Request
query_text: Create a web app where users can submit feature requests for a product, vote on ones other people have already suggested, and leave a short comment explaining why they want something. I like the idea of having a simple list of all submitted requests that anyone can browse from a desktop browser, with the most-voted ones rising to the top, and a quick form for adding a new request that just asks for a title and a short description of what problem it solves.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网络应用，用户可以在其中提交功能请求，对其他人已经建议的功能进行投票，并留下一个简短的评论说明他们为什么想要某些东西。我喜欢有一个简单的所有提交的请求列表的想法，任何人都可以从桌面浏览器浏览，投票最多的请求会浮到顶部，一个快速表单用于添加新请求，只是要求一个标题和一个简短的问题解决描述。

corpus_topic: public product roadmap voting board for SaaS users
query_text: Build a web app where SaaS users can see what the team is planning to build next, vote on the things they care about most, and add their own ideas to the list. I want it to feel open and honest, like users are genuinely part of deciding what comes next, with a simple voting button on each item and a way to see roughly when planned things might ship, all accessible from a desktop browser so people can check in whenever they want.
query_text_zh: 我想建一个网络应用，SaaS用户可以看到团队接下来要建什么，对他们最关心的东西投票，并为列表添加自己的想法。我想要它感觉开放和诚实，就像用户真的是决定接下来会发生什么的一部分，每个项目都有一个简单的投票按钮，一个方式可以大致看到计划的东西什么时候可能发货，全部可以从桌面浏览器访问，这样人们可以随时查看。

corpus_topic: customer story submission and showcase portal
query_text: Make a web app where customers can write up their story about using the product and submit it, and then approved stories show up in a public gallery that anyone can browse. I want there to be a simple submission form where customers fill in their name, company, and their story, plus a spot for a photo if they have one, and the gallery side should let visitors browse stories by topic so it's easy to find ones that are relevant to what they're looking for, all on a website that works well on desktop.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络应用，让客户可以写下他们关于使用该产品的故事并提交，然后批准的故事显示在一个任何人都可以浏览的公共画廊中。我想要有一个简单的提交表单，让客户填入他们的名字、公司和他们的故事，加上一个照片的位置，如果他们有的话，画廊方面应该让访问者按主题浏览故事，这样很容易找到与他们正在寻找的相关的故事，全部在一个在桌面上运行良好的网站上。

corpus_topic: open beta tester recruitment and sign-up site
query_text: Make a website where people who want to try out our product before it fully launches can sign up to become beta testers, with a short form asking about their background and what they're hoping to test. I also want a public-facing page that explains what being a beta tester involves so people know what they're signing up for, and an admin view in the web app where we can see who applied and mark people as accepted so we can manage the whole recruitment process without using separate spreadsheets.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网站，那些想在我们的产品完全推出前试用的人可以注册成为测试版测试者，有一个简短的表单询问他们的背景以及他们希望测试什么。我还想要一个公开面向的页面来解释成为测试版测试者的含义，这样人们知道他们在注册什么，以及网络应用中的一个管理员视图，我们可以看到谁申请了，并将人们标记为已接受，这样我们可以管理整个招募过程而不使用单独的电子表格。

corpus_topic: community-driven changelog with reaction threads
query_text: A page in the browser where my startup posts updates and people can reply under each one with their thoughts, like a little conversation thread per change, so users feel like they actually have a say in where things are going. I want visitors to see a running list of what we shipped, click into any entry, leave a quick reaction or comment, and others can pile on with their own takes without it getting messy.
query_text_zh: 我想要在浏览器中有一个页面，我的创业公司在其中发布更新，人们可以在每个更新下回复他们的想法，就像每个变化有一个小对话线索，这样用户感觉他们真的在决定事情的走向中有发言权。我想让访问者看到一个我们发货的运行列表，点击任何条目，留下一个快速反应或评论，其他人可以用他们自己的看法堆积，而不会变得混乱。

corpus_topic: developer relations hub with API docs and forums
query_text: Create a place on our site where developers can read all our how-to guides and look up how our tool works, and also jump into a community section to ask questions or share tips with other people building on it, so everything they need is in one spot in the browser instead of scattered across different links.
query_text_zh: 我想在我们的网站上创建一个地方，开发者可以阅读我们所有的操作指南并查找我们的工具如何工作，并且也可以跳入一个社区部分来提出问题或与其他在其上构建的人分享提示，这样他们需要的一切都在浏览器中的一个地方，而不是分散在不同的链接上。

corpus_topic: power user ambassador program enrollment page
query_text: Need a page on our website where power users who really love the product can sign up to become official ambassadors, with a short form telling us a bit about themselves and why they want to join, plus a spot showing the perks they will get and maybe a list of current ambassadors so new people feel like they are joining something real.
query_text_zh: 我需要在我们的网站上有一个页面，真正喜欢该产品的高级用户可以注册成为官方大使，有一个简短的表单告诉我们一点关于他们自己以及他们为什么想加入，加上一个显示他们将获得的福利的地方，也许还有一个当前大使的列表，这样新人感觉他们正在加入真实的东西。

corpus_topic: community knowledge base wiki with voting
query_text: Need a place on our site that works like a shared wiki where any community member can write up answers or tips, and other people can vote the best ones to the top so the most useful stuff is easy to find, kind of like a living help center that our users actually maintain together in the browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要在我们的网站上有一个地方，就像一个共享的wiki，任何社区成员都可以写下答案或提示，其他人可以投票最好的到顶部，这样最有用的东西很容易找到，有点像我们的用户在浏览器中实际维护的一个生活帮助中心。

corpus_topic: user-generated tutorial and how-to library
query_text: Build a section of our site where users can post their own step-by-step guides or short walkthroughs showing others how to use the product for different things, with a way to browse by topic and maybe save the ones you want to come back to, so the whole library grows as more people chip in.
query_text_zh: 我想在我们网站的一个部分建立，用户可以发布他们自己的分步指南或简短的演练，展示其他人如何为不同的事情使用该产品，有一个按主题浏览的方式，也许保存你想回来的那些，这样整个库随着越来越多的人贡献而增长。

corpus_topic: public bug report tracking and upvote board
query_text: A board in the browser where anyone can submit a bug they ran into, see what others have already reported, and vote up the issues that are bothering the most people, so our team can quickly tell which problems to tackle first and users feel heard rather than just shouting into the void.
query_text_zh: 我想要浏览器中的一个板块，任何人都可以提交他们遇到的错误，看到其他人已经报告的内容，并投票最困扰大多数人的问题，这样我们的团队可以快速判断应该先处理哪些问题，用户感到被倾听而不是只是对着虚空大喊。

corpus_topic: early adopter hall of fame recognition wall
query_text: Make a special recognition wall on our website that celebrates the people who joined us really early, showing their name, maybe a small note about when they signed up, and some kind of badge or highlight so it feels like a real honor rather than just a list, something they would actually want to share with friends.
query_text_zh: 我想在我们的网站上创建一个特殊的认可墙，庆祝那些真的早早加入我们的人，显示他们的名字、也许关于他们什么时候注册的一个简短说明，以及某种徽章或突出显示，所以它感觉像一个真正的荣誉而不仅仅是一个列表，这是他们实际上想与朋友分享的东西。

corpus_topic: community newsletter archive and subscription site
query_text: Need a page on our site that keeps all the past newsletters in one browsable archive so people can read old issues they missed, and also has a clean sign-up spot at the top so new visitors can subscribe without having to hunt around for where to put their email.
query_text_zh: 我需要在我们的网站上有一个页面，把所有过去的通讯保存在一个可浏览的档案中，这样人们可以阅读他们错过的旧问题，并且在顶部也有一个干净的注册地点，这样新访问者可以订阅而不必费力寻找在哪里输入他们的电子邮件。

corpus_topic: launch announcement board for new SaaS features
query_text: Make a page in the browser where we announce every new feature or update we ship, with each post getting its own little section so people can read the full story behind a change, and maybe a spot to leave a quick note or thumbs-up so we know if folks are excited about a particular thing we released.
query_text_zh: 我想在浏览器中创建一个页面，我们宣布我们发货的每个新功能或更新，每个帖子都有自己的小部分，这样人们可以阅读变化背后的完整故事，也许还有一个地方留下一个快速笔记或竖起大拇指，这样我们知道人们是否对我们发布的特定东西感到兴奋。

corpus_topic: 数据分析台
query_text: Need a page in the browser that pulls together all the numbers from our data into one view so I can actually see what is going on without opening five different spreadsheets, with some charts or summary rows that make it obvious at a glance whether things are going up or down, and filters to narrow down to a specific time period or team.
query_text_zh: 我需要浏览器中的一个页面，把所有我们数据中的数字整合到一个视图中，这样我可以真的看到发生了什么而不用打开五个不同的电子表格，有一些图表或摘要行让人一眼就能看出事情是在上升还是下降，还有过滤器来缩小到一个特定的时间段或团队。

corpus_topic: API documentation portal for developer-facing SaaS tools
query_text: A documentation site in the browser that shows all our API endpoints in a clean organized way, where people can read what each one does, see example requests and responses, and maybe try a quick call right from the page without having to set anything up themselves, so new developers can get going without emailing us every five minutes.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网络中的文档站点，以一个干净有组织的方式显示我们所有的API端点，人们可以阅读每个做什么，看到示例请求和响应，也许可以直接从页面尝试一个快速调用而不必自己设置任何东西，这样新开发者可以不用每五分钟就给我们发邮件就可以开始。

corpus_topic: Feature flag management console for SaaS teams
query_text: Need a web page where my team can turn specific features on or off for different groups of users without touching any code, just toggling a switch and saving, so we can roll things out slowly and turn them off fast if something goes wrong, and anyone on the team can see which features are live for which customers.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络页面，我的团队可以为不同的用户组打开或关闭特定的功能而不用接触任何代码，只是切换一个开关并保存，这样我们可以缓慢推出东西，如果出问题可以快速关闭，任何人都可以看到哪些功能对哪些客户是活跃的。

corpus_topic: Customer onboarding checklist builder for SaaS products
query_text: Create a tool in the browser that lets me put together a step-by-step checklist for new customers when they first sign up, so they know exactly what to do to get set up and can check things off as they go, and I can see which steps people tend to get stuck on so I know where to add more help.
query_text_zh: 我想在浏览器中创建一个工具，让我可以为新客户在他们刚注册时制定一个分步清单，这样他们就确切地知道该怎么做才能设置，并可以随着他们的进展而检查东西，我可以看到人们倾向于在哪些步骤上卡住，这样我就知道在哪里添加更多帮助。

corpus_topic: Team roadmap and sprint planning web app
query_text: A page in the browser where our whole team can see what we are working on this week versus next month, with tasks laid out so it is obvious who owns what and when things are supposed to be done, and we can drag stuff around or add new items without having to explain the whole plan from scratch in a meeting every time.
query_text_zh: 我想要浏览器中的一个页面，我们整个团队可以看到我们这周在做什么与下个月，任务布置得让人一目了然谁拥有什么以及什么时候应该完成，我们可以拖动东西或添加新项目而不必在每次会议中都从头解释整个计划。

corpus_topic: SaaS pricing page A/B testing tool
query_text: Build a tool in the browser where I can set up two versions of our pricing page and show each one to a different chunk of visitors, then see which version gets more people to actually sign up, so I can stop guessing which price layout works better and just look at the real numbers.
query_text_zh: 我想在浏览器中建立一个工具，让我可以设置我们定价页面的两个版本并向不同的访问者显示每一个，然后看到哪个版本让更多的人真的注册，这样我可以停止猜测哪个价格布局运行更好并只是查看真实数字。

corpus_topic: Startup equity and cap table management tool
query_text: Make a web page where I can keep track of who owns how much of the company, so when we bring on a new investor or give someone options I can update the numbers and immediately see the new breakdown, without having to rebuild the whole thing in a spreadsheet every single time something changes.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页，让我可以跟踪谁拥有公司的多少，这样当我们引入一个新投资者或给某人期权时，我可以更新数字并立即看到新的细目，而不必每次有东西改变时都在电子表格中重建整个东西。

corpus_topic: MRR and subscription metrics reporting tool
query_text: Make a reporting page in the browser that shows how our subscription revenue is changing month by month, with a simple chart or table so I can see at a glance whether we are growing or losing customers, and maybe a way to filter by plan type so I know which tier is actually doing well.
query_text_zh: 我想要浏览器中的一个报告页面，显示我们的订阅收入如何逐月变化，有一个简单的图表或表格，这样我可以一眼看出我们是在增长还是失去客户，也许还有一个按计划类型过滤的方法，这样我就知道哪个层级真的在做得好。

corpus_topic: Internal knowledge base builder for early-stage startups
query_text: Make a spot in the browser where our small team can write up and organize all the stuff we keep having to explain to new people, like how we do certain things or who to contact for what, so instead of re-answering the same questions over and over we just point people to the right page and they can read it themselves.
query_text_zh: 我想在浏览器中创建一个地方，我们的小团队可以写下并组织所有我们不断为新人解释的东西，比如我们如何做某些事情或为什么要联系谁，这样与其一遍遍重新回答相同的问题，我们只是指向人们正确的页面，他们可以自己阅读。

corpus_topic: User interview scheduling and research notes aggregator
query_text: Create a page in the browser where I can book user interviews without back-and-forth emails, and then attach my notes from each session so everything is in one place, making it easy to look back across multiple conversations and spot patterns in what people are telling us about the product.
query_text_zh: 我想在浏览器中创建一个页面，让我可以预约用户访谈而不用来回发邮件，然后为每个会话附加我的笔记，这样所有东西都在一个地方，让我可以轻松查看多个对话，并发现人们告诉我们关于产品的内容中的模式。

corpus_topic: Competitor monitoring and sales battlecard builder
query_text: Create a web page where I can track what our main competitors are up to and jot down quick notes about how we compare, so when someone on the sales team is in a tough conversation they can pull up a simple reference sheet and know what to say instead of making things up on the spot.
query_text_zh: 我想创建一个网页，让我可以跟踪我们的主要竞争对手在做什么，并记录关于我们如何比较的快速笔记，这样当销售团队处于困难的对话中时，他们可以拉出一个简单的参考表，并知道要说什么，而不是当场编造。

corpus_topic: API usage quota and billing management portal
query_text: A page in the browser where customers can see how much of their monthly usage they have left and what it is going to cost them, with a clear breakdown so there are no surprises on the bill, and maybe a way to upgrade their plan or ask for more capacity right from that same page without contacting support.
query_text_zh: 我想要浏览器中的一个页面，客户可以看到他们每月还剩多少使用量以及要花多少钱，有一个清晰的细目，这样账单上就没有惊喜，也许还有一个从同一页面升级他们的计划或要求更多容量的方法，而不用联系支持。

corpus_topic: Multi-tenant workspace administration console
query_text: Make a web page where I can see all the different company workspaces using our product in one list, switch into any of them to check on things, adjust their settings, or add and remove users, so I am not logging into each account separately every time something needs to be changed.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页，让我可以看到所有不同的公司工作空间在一个列表中使用我们的产品，切换到任何一个来检查事情，调整他们的设置，或添加和删除用户，这样我就不用每次有东西需要改变时都分别登入每个账户。

corpus_topic: 教师团队页
query_text: Build a page on our school website that lists every teacher and staff member with their name, photo, what subject or role they handle, and maybe a short note about them, so parents and new students can easily figure out who to reach out to without having to ask around or dig through old emails.
query_text_zh: 我想在我们的学校网站上建立一个页面，列出每个教师和工作人员，包括他们的名字、照片、他们处理的主题或角色，以及也许关于他们的一个简短说明，这样家长和新学生可以很容易地想出谁去联系而不必问周围或通过旧邮件挖掘。

corpus_topic: University course catalog and program directory site
query_text: Create a place on the university website in the browser where prospective students can browse all the programs and courses we offer, filtered by subject area or degree type, with a clear description of each one so they can compare options and figure out what fits their goals without having to request a printed brochure.
query_text_zh: 我想在大学网站上的浏览器中创建一个地方，有意的学生可以浏览我们提供的所有程序和课程，按主题区域或学位类型过滤，每个都有清晰的描述，这样他们可以比较选项并想出什么适合他们的目标，而不必请求印刷的小册子。

corpus_topic: Alumni success stories and career outcomes showcase
query_text: A section on the school website in the browser that highlights what graduates have gone on to do after finishing the program, with short write-ups and maybe a photo for each person, so prospective students can see real examples of where the degree can take them rather than just reading a list of generic job titles.
query_text_zh: 我想在学校网站上的浏览器中有一个部分，突出显示毕业生在完成课程后去做的事情，有短的撰写和也许每个人的一个照片，这样有意的学生可以看到真实的例子，说明学位可以带他们去哪里，而不仅仅是阅读一个通用职位名称的列表。

corpus_topic: Institutional accreditations and awards display page
query_text: Make a web app that shows all of a school's official accreditations and awards in one organized place, where each entry has the name of the certifying body, the year it was received, and a short description, and the whole list can be filtered by category so visitors can quickly find the kind of recognition they are looking for, like academic rankings or industry certifications.
query_text_zh: 开发一个校园网应用，集中展示学校的所有官方认证和荣誉，每个荣誉项目都包含认证机构名称、获得年份和简短描述，访客可以按类别筛选（如学术排名或行业认证），快速找到他们想了解的认可信息。

corpus_topic: Student capstone project portfolio gallery site
query_text: A browser-based gallery tool for showing off student capstone projects, where each project gets its own card with the student's name, project title, a short summary, and a link to the full write-up or demo, and visitors can browse by graduation year or subject area so they can find relevant work without scrolling through everything at once.
query_text_zh: 建一个浏览器上的学生毕业设计展示平台，每个项目都有卡片展示学生姓名、项目标题、简要概述和完整作品或演示链接，访客可以按毕业年份或学科领域浏览，不用一次看完全部内容就能找到感兴趣的作品。

corpus_topic: Campus virtual tour and 360-degree walkthrough site
query_text: Need a web app that lets prospective students walk through the campus virtually, with a clear list of locations like the library, dorms, and sports facilities that they can click through one by one, each showing a 360-degree photo and a brief description of what that space is used for, so they get a real sense of the campus before visiting in person.
query_text_zh: 做一个虚拟校园游览网应用，让考生可以点击浏览校园各地点（如图书馆、宿舍、体育设施等），每个位置都配有360度全景照片和简要介绍，这样他们在实地访问前就能真切地感受校园。

corpus_topic: Academic research highlights and publications page
query_text: Make a website that highlights a university's academic research and published papers, organized so that each entry shows the title, the researchers involved, the year it was published, and the subject area it belongs to, and visitors can filter the list by department or year to find the specific kind of research they are interested in without having to dig through everything.
query_text_zh: 创建一个大学科研成果网站，展示学校发表的研究论文，每条内容都显示论文标题、研究人员、发表年份和学科领域，访客可以按部门或年份筛选，轻松找到感兴趣的研究而不用翻遍所有内容。

corpus_topic: Open day and campus visit event landing page
query_text: Build a web app for promoting and organizing a school's open day and campus visit events, where each event has a date, a short description of what to expect, and a simple sign-up form, and the main screen shows upcoming events in order so families can quickly find the next available date and register their visit without any confusion.
query_text_zh: 建立一个学校开放日和校园参观活动的推广网应用，每个活动都有日期、简短描述和报名表单，主页按顺序显示即将举办的活动，让家长能快速找到合适的时间并完成报名。

corpus_topic: Scholarship programs and financial aid showcase
query_text: A browser-based tool that lays out all the scholarship programs and financial aid options a school offers, with each entry showing the scholarship name, the amount, who it is for, and how to apply, so prospective students can go through the whole list in a desktop browser and tick off the ones that match their situation before deciding where to apply.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器工具，展示学校提供的所有奖学金和经济资助选项，每项都显示名称、金额、适用对象和申请方式，学生可以在电脑浏览器中逐一查看并对比，找出符合自己情况的选项。

corpus_topic: International partner universities and exchange programs directory
query_text: Build a web app that lists all of a university's international partner schools and exchange programs in one place, where each entry shows the partner university's name, the country it is in, the program duration, and any eligibility notes, and the whole directory can be filtered by region or program length so students can find the right exchange option for their schedule.
query_text_zh: 开发一个大学国际交流项目目录网应用，集中列出所有合作高校和交换项目，每条内容显示合作校名称、所在国家、项目期限和录取条件，访客可以按地区或时长筛选，找到适合自己日程的交换机会。

corpus_topic: Student testimonials and enrollment reviews display page
query_text: Need a web app that collects and displays student testimonials and enrollment reviews in a clear format, where each review shows the student's name, their program, the year they enrolled, and what they said about their experience, and visitors can sort by program or rating so they can read the feedback most relevant to the course they are considering.
query_text_zh: 建设一个学生见证和课程评价展示平台，清晰展示每条评价的学生姓名、专业、入学年份和体验分享，访客可以按专业或评分排序，快速了解最相关的课程反馈。

corpus_topic: Step-by-step admissions process overview site
query_text: Need a web app that walks prospective students through the admissions process step by step, where each step is listed clearly with a title, a plain-language explanation of what is required, and a checklist of documents or actions needed, so someone sitting at a desktop can follow the whole process from start to finish without missing anything important.
query_text_zh: 开发一个逐步指引申请流程的网应用，清楚列出每一步的标题、平白的说明和所需文件或行动的清单，这样坐在电脑前的人能从头到尾完整跟随，不会遗漏任何重要环节。

corpus_topic: Campus facilities and amenities photo gallery
query_text: Build a web app that shows off all the campus facilities and amenities through photos, where each facility has its own entry with a name, a short description, and a set of photos visitors can click through, and the app lets you filter by facility type like dining, sports, or study spaces so it is easy to find what you are looking for when browsing on a desktop.
query_text_zh: 建一个校园设施和便利设施的图片展示网应用，每个设施都有独立条目显示名称、简介和一套可点击浏览的照片，访客可以按设施类型（如餐饮、运动、学习区）筛选，方便在电脑上快速找到想看的内容。

corpus_topic: 研究成果
query_text: Need a web app that organizes and shows a research team's published work and key findings, where each research output has a title, the names of the people involved, the year it came out, and a brief plain-language summary, and users can filter the list by topic area or year so it is easy to find the right piece without scrolling through everything in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 开发一个研究团队科研成果和主要发现的汇总网应用，每项研究成果都包含标题、参与人员名单、发布年份和简洁的非专业总结，用户可以按主题或年份筛选，在电脑浏览器中轻松找到需要的内容。

corpus_topic: 教育资讯
query_text: Make a web app that serves as a running feed of education news and updates, where each article or announcement shows the date, a clear headline, a short summary, and a link to read more, and the left side of the screen has a list of topic categories so readers on a desktop can quickly jump to the kind of education news they care about most.
query_text_zh: 做一个教育新闻和更新动态的实时信息流网应用，每条文章或公告都显示日期、清晰标题、简要摘要和阅读链接，左侧有主题分类列表，电脑用户可以快速跳转到最关心的教育新闻类别。

corpus_topic: faculty research profile and biography directory site
query_text: A faculty directory tool for a university website, where each professor's entry shows their photo, name, department, a short biography, and a list of their recent research topics, and the whole directory can be searched by name or filtered by department so anyone browsing in a desktop browser can quickly pull up the right person's profile and see what they work on.
query_text_zh: 建立一个大学教师目录工具，每位教授的条目显示照片、姓名、所在部门、简要生平和最近研究方向，整个目录可以按姓名搜索或按部门筛选，电脑用户可以快速找到想了解的教授并查看他们的研究工作。

corpus_topic: alumni success story and career journey magazine
query_text: An online magazine-style app that features stories about alumni and their careers after graduation, where each story has the person's name, graduation year, current job, and a longer write-up about their journey, and readers can browse by industry or graduation decade so they can find the alumni whose paths are most similar to what they are hoping to do, all in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个在线杂志风格的应用，刊登校友毕业后职业生涯的故事，每个故事包含人名、毕业年份、现在工作和职业发展历程的详细介绍，读者可以按行业或毕业年代浏览，找到与自己目标最相近的校友案例，都在电脑浏览器中进行。

corpus_topic: open courseware and free lecture notes portal
query_text: Build a web app that gathers open courseware and free lecture notes from a university in one easy-to-browse place, where each course entry shows the subject, the instructor's name, the level it is aimed at, and links to the available materials, and visitors can filter by subject area or format so they can find the right free learning resource without wading through a long unorganized list.
query_text_zh: 建立一个开放课程和免费讲义资源的汇总网应用，每个课程条目都显示学科、讲师名称、难度等级和材料链接，访客可以按学科或格式筛选，轻松找到需要的免费学习资源而不用在长长的无序列表中浏览。

corpus_topic: graduate thesis and dissertation digital repository
query_text: Make a web app that works as a searchable library of graduate theses and dissertations, where each entry shows the title, the author, the year it was submitted, the department, and a short abstract, and users browsing in a desktop browser can filter by year, subject, or degree level so they can zero in on the research that is most relevant to what they are studying.
query_text_zh: 做一个研究生学位论文和毕业论文的可搜索资料库网应用，每条记录显示标题、作者、提交年份、所属部门和内容摘要，电脑用户可以按年份、学科或学位级别筛选，精准找到最相关的研究资料。

corpus_topic: department seminar recordings and schedule archive
query_text: Build a web app that keeps track of a department's seminar recordings and upcoming talks in one organized place, where each entry has the seminar title, the speaker, the date, and a link to the recording if one is available, and the list can be filtered by semester or topic so faculty and students on a desktop browser can find past talks or plan which upcoming ones to attend.
query_text_zh: 开发一个部门学术讲座录像和即将举行讲座的汇总网应用，每条内容显示讲座标题、讲者、日期和录像链接（如有），列表可按学期或主题筛选，师生在电脑浏览器中可以找到过往讲座或计划参加哪些即将举行的讲座。

corpus_topic: university press digital book and monograph hub
query_text: A digital catalog tool for a university press, running in a desktop browser, where each book or academic title has its own entry showing the cover, the author's name, the publication year, a short description, and a link to order or download it, and visitors can browse by subject area or publication year to find the exact kind of scholarly work they are looking for.
query_text_zh: 做一个大学出版社的电子目录工具，在电脑浏览器中运行，每本著作或学术书籍都有独立条目显示封面、作者名、出版年份、简要描述和订购或下载链接，访客可以按学科或出版年份浏览，找到想要的学术著作。

corpus_topic: faculty-hosted educational podcast series platform
query_text: Need a web app that serves as a home for a series of educational podcasts hosted by university faculty, where each episode listing shows the host's name, the episode title, the subject it covers, and a player so you can listen right in the browser, and episodes can be filtered by topic or host so listeners can easily find the series they want to follow without hunting through a long unsorted list.
query_text_zh: 建设一个大学教师录制的教育播客系列网应用，每集都显示主持人名字、集名、主题和可直接在浏览器中收听的播放器，用户可以按主题或主持人筛选，轻松找到想要关注的系列而不用在长长的未分类列表中费劲搜索。

corpus_topic: student-run online newspaper and opinion site
query_text: Build a web app for a student-run online newspaper where articles are organized by section like news, opinion, and campus life, each post shows the headline, the author, the date, and a preview of the article, and readers on a desktop browser can browse by section or search by keyword so they can quickly find the stories they want to read without scrolling through everything at once.
query_text_zh: 建立一个学生办报的在线新闻网应用，文章按新闻、观点、校园生活等板块分类，每篇文章显示标题、作者、日期和摘要，电脑读者可以按板块浏览或关键词搜索，快速找到想看的文章而不用一次看完所有内容。

corpus_topic: annual institutional statistics and transparency report portal
query_text: Need a browser-based tool that presents a university's yearly statistics and transparency figures in a clear and readable way, where key numbers like enrollment totals, graduation rates, and research funding are listed by category with a short explanation of what each figure means, and users can switch between years to compare how the numbers have changed over time.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器工具，以清晰易读的方式呈现大学的年度统计和透明度数据，比如注册人数、毕业率、科研经费等数字都按类别列出并有简短说明，用户可以对比不同年份，看出数据随时间的变化。

corpus_topic: continuing education and professional certification course catalog
query_text: Need a web app that lists all the continuing education and professional certification courses a school offers, where each course entry shows the name, the subject area, the length, the cost, and who it is designed for, and visitors browsing on a desktop can filter by topic or schedule format so working adults can quickly find the right course to fit into their existing routine.
query_text_zh: 建设一个继续教育和职业认证课程的汇总网应用，每个课程条目显示名称、学科、时长、费用和目标群体，电脑访客可以按主题或时间安排筛选，在职成人能快速找到适合融入日常的合适课程。

corpus_topic: academic conference proceedings and presentation archive
query_text: Make a web app that archives academic conference papers and presentations in one organized place, where each entry shows the paper title, the author, the conference name, the year, and a link to the full text or slides, and users can filter by year or subject field so researchers browsing on a desktop browser can find the specific presentations they need without sorting through a huge unordered list.
query_text_zh: 做一个学术会议论文和演讲报告的归档网应用，每条内容显示论文标题、作者、会议名称、年份和完整文本或幻灯片链接，用户可以按年份或学科筛选，电脑研究人员能快速找到需要的具体报告而不用在巨大的无序列表中翻找。

corpus_topic: 公开课推广
query_text: A promotional web app for a school's open courses, where each course has its own entry showing the course name, a short description of what you will learn, the schedule, and a clear sign-up button, and the home screen of the app groups courses by subject so visitors browsing in a desktop browser can quickly find the open course that fits what they want to learn and register right away.
query_text_zh: 做一个学校开设课程的推广网应用，每个课程都有独立条目显示课程名、学习内容简介、上课时间表和清晰的报名按钮，应用首页按学科分组课程，电脑访客能快速找到符合需求的课程并直接报名。

corpus_topic: 招生会报名
query_text: Build a web app for handling sign-ups to a school enrollment fair, where visitors can see a list of scheduled sessions with the date, time, location, and a brief description of what the fair covers, and they can fill in their name, contact details, and which session they want to attend so the school has a clear record of who is coming and the whole process works smoothly in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 建立一个学校招生展览会报名处理网应用，访客能看到各场次时间、地点和简要介绍，并填写姓名、联系方式和想要参加的场次，学校可以清楚记录参与者信息，整个过程在电脑浏览器中顺畅进行。

corpus_topic: free trial lesson sign-up landing page
query_text: Need a free trial lesson sign-up page for a browser-based education site where people can register their name and email, pick a time slot, and confirm their spot right there on the page without needing to go somewhere else. I want the sign-up form to be easy to find, with clear spots for contact info and lesson choice, and a confirmation message after someone submits so they know it worked.
query_text_zh: 做一个免费试听课报名页面，学生可以输入姓名和邮箱、选择时间段、确认参加位置，全过程在同一个页面完成，报名表显眼易填，提交后即时收到确认提示，清楚知道报名已经成功。

corpus_topic: alumni career outcomes and success stories showcase
query_text: Build a web app for an education site that shows alumni career outcomes and success stories, with a clean list of graduates and what they went on to do after finishing the program. I want each person to have their own little profile showing their field of work and a short quote, so prospective students browsing on desktop can easily read through and get a sense of where past students ended up.
query_text_zh: 建立一个教育网站的校友职业前景展示网应用，列出毕业学员及他们的职业发展情况，每个人都有小档案显示工作领域和一句个人评价，电脑上浏览的学生能轻松看完所有案例，了解往届学生的职业走向。

corpus_topic: corporate training package inquiry and quote site
query_text: Need a web-based site for a training company where businesses can browse available corporate training packages, see what is included in each one, and fill out a short form to request a custom quote. The site should have a clear list of package options with pricing tiers shown side by side, and a simple inquiry form that captures the company name, team size, and preferred topics so someone can follow up with them.
query_text_zh: 做一个企业培训公司的网站，让商业客户可以浏览可用的培训套餐、查看每个套餐的内容，并填表申请定制报价。网站应该并排展示不同价位的套餐，提供简单的询询表单捕捉公司名称、团队规模和偏好主题，便于后续跟进。

corpus_topic: summer intensive program enrollment promotional site
query_text: Make a browser-based promotional site for a summer intensive program where students can read about what is covered, see session dates and costs, and complete their enrollment right on the page. I want a clear breakdown of the program schedule, the key things students will learn, and a registration section with fields for name, contact details, and payment, so the whole process is handled in one place.
query_text_zh: 做一个暑期集中培训课程的推广网站，学生可以了解课程内容、看到各期日期和费用，并在页面上直接完成报名。网站要清晰展示课程时间表、学生将学到的核心内容和报名区域（含姓名、联系方式和支付信息），整个流程在一个地方完成。

corpus_topic: student referral rewards and discount portal
query_text: Create a web app for a student referral rewards and discount system where current students can log in, see their unique referral link, track who they have brought in, and check what discounts or rewards they have earned so far. The site should have a clear summary of how many referrals each person has made, what the reward tiers are, and a simple way to copy or share the referral link directly from the browser.
query_text_zh: 开发一个学生转介奖励和折扣系统的网应用，在校学生可以登录、查看自己的独特转介链接、追踪已介绍的人员、确认已赚取的折扣或奖励。网站应清楚显示每个人做过的转介数、奖励等级信息，并提供简便的方式直接从浏览器中复制或分享转介链接。

corpus_topic: certification program comparison and enrollment landing page
query_text: Need a certification program comparison and enrollment page for a desktop browser where I can see several different certification options listed side by side, with details on what each one covers, how long it takes, and what it costs. There should be a clear way to pick the one I want and then go straight into enrollment by filling out a form with my name, email, and payment info, all in the same spot.
query_text_zh: 做一个认证课程对比和报名页面供电脑用户使用，在一个界面中并排列出多个认证选项，详细说明每个选项的课程内容、时长和费用。应该清晰地让我挑选中意的选项并直接填表报名，包括姓名、邮箱和支付信息，一切都在同一个地方完成。

corpus_topic: live webinar series registration and replay hub
query_text: Need a web app for a live webinar series where people can register for upcoming sessions, see a schedule of all the coming webinars with topics and dates, and also go back and watch replays of past ones. I want each webinar listed with a short description, the date and time, and a sign-up button, plus a separate area where past sessions are available to watch again, all accessible right in the browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个线上讲座系列的网应用，人们可以报名参加即将举办的讲座、查看包含主题和日期的讲座时间表，还能观看过去讲座的回放。每个讲座都列出简要介绍、日期和时间以及报名按钮，过去的讲座单独放在一个区域可以重新观看，全部内容都在浏览器中访问。

corpus_topic: early-bird tuition discount countdown enrollment page
query_text: Build a web-based enrollment page for a course that shows a clear countdown timer to when the early-bird tuition discount expires, along with the regular price and the discounted price so visitors can see exactly what they save by enrolling before the deadline. The page should have an enrollment form right there with fields for name, email, and payment details, and the timer should update in real time as someone browses on their desktop.
query_text_zh: 建立一个课程报名页面，显示优惠学费截止的倒计时、常规价格和折扣价格，让访客清楚看到提前报名能省多少钱。页面上就有报名表，包括姓名、邮箱和支付详情字段，倒计时实时更新，用户在电脑上浏览时能看到变化。

corpus_topic: free study guide download lead capture page
query_text: Build a page for an education site where visitors can download a free study guide by entering their name and email address, with a clear description of what is in the guide so people know what they are getting before they sign up. I want a clean form at the top of the page, a short list of what topics the guide covers, and a confirmation message or download link that appears right away after someone submits their info in the browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个教育网站的页面，访客可以通过输入姓名和邮箱来下载免费学习指南，清晰的说明让人们知道指南包含什么内容。页面上面是简洁的表单，下面列出指南涵盖的主题，用户在浏览器中填完信息后立即看到确认信息或下载链接。

corpus_topic: instructor credentials and faculty spotlight showcase
query_text: Create a web app for an education company where site visitors can browse instructor profiles and see each teacher's background, qualifications, and the subjects they specialize in, all laid out clearly in a desktop-friendly layout. I want each instructor to have their own spotlight entry with their photo, a list of their credentials, years of experience, and the courses they teach, so prospective students can quickly find someone whose background matches what they are looking for.
query_text_zh: 开发一个教育公司的网应用，网站访客可以浏览讲师档案、查看每位教师的背景、资质和专业方向，界面电脑友好。每位讲师都有专门的展示区，包括照片、资质清单、工作经验和授课科目，学生候选人能快速找到背景匹配自己需要的讲师。

corpus_topic: student testimonial video gallery and social proof site
query_text: Build a browser-based site for an online course provider where current and potential students can watch video testimonials from past students and read short written reviews, all organized in a way that is easy to scroll through on a desktop. I want the videos and quotes grouped so visitors can filter by course or outcome type, and each entry should show the student's name and what they studied so the whole thing feels trustworthy and easy to browse.
query_text_zh: 建立一个在线课程提供商的网站，现有和潜在学生可以观看往届学生的视频见证并阅读简短的文字评价，全部内容易于在电脑上滚动浏览。视频和引言可按课程或成果类型分组，访客可筛选查看，每条评价显示学生名字和所学课程，让整体感受可信且易浏览。

corpus_topic: 证书购买
query_text: Need a web app where I can browse available certification programs, pick the one I want, and actually buy it without being bounced around to different pages or having to email someone. Right now buying a certificate means digging through emails and waiting, so I want a site in the browser where I can see what certificates are available, select one, pay for it, and get a confirmation right away without any back and forth.
query_text_zh: 做一个网应用，让我可以浏览可用的认证课程、选中想要的、在浏览器中直接购买，不需要跳转到不同页面或发邮件给某人。现在购买证书意味着挖邮件和等待，我想要一个浏览器网站，可以看到有哪些证书、选择一个、付款，然后立即得到确认，不需要来回邮件。

corpus_topic: enterprise training package customization and quote portal
query_text: Need a web-based portal where an HR person or manager can go and actually customize a corporate training package for their company instead of having to send emails back and forth for weeks waiting on a quote. I want to be able to pick the topics we need, say how many people will attend, choose the delivery format, and get a price estimate without having to talk to anyone first, all right there in the browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络门户，人力资源或经理可以去自己定制公司的企业培训方案，不用花几周时间来回发邮件等报价。我想能选择需要的课题、说清楚会有多少人参加、选择交付方式，然后得到价格估算，全部在浏览器中完成，不用先和任何人沟通。

corpus_topic: bulk course seat purchasing platform for HR managers
query_text: Create a web platform where HR managers can buy course seats in bulk for their team without having to negotiate a separate deal every single time. The whole process of picking the courses, choosing how many seats we need, and actually checking out should happen in one place in the browser so I do not have to email a sales rep and wait days just to get people enrolled in something.
query_text_zh: 做一个网平台，人力资源经理可以为团队批量购买课程座位，不用每次都要独立谈判一份协议。选择课程、确定座位数和实际结账的整个过程应该在浏览器中的一个地方完成，这样我就不用发邮件给销售代表，也不用等上好几天才能把人员注册到某个课程里。

corpus_topic: corporate training ROI calculator and reporting dashboard
query_text: A web-based tool for corporate buyers where you enter your team size, the training topics you are planning, and how long the program runs, and it works out the return on investment for you based on things like time saved and skill improvements. Right now trying to justify training budgets means building spreadsheets from scratch every time, so having something in the browser that runs the numbers and gives you a clear summary report would save a lot of effort.
query_text_zh: 做一个网工具供企业采购者使用，输入团队规模、计划的培训主题和项目时长，系统就根据时间节约和技能提升等因素为我计算投资回报率。现在为培训预算辩护意味着每次都要从头开始造电子表格，如果浏览器里有个工具能自动算账并生成清晰的汇总报告，能省不少力气。

corpus_topic: training vendor comparison marketplace for procurement teams
query_text: Need a web app that brings together different training vendors in one place so procurement teams can compare what each one offers, what it costs, and what other buyers have said about them, without having to chase down quotes from five different companies separately. The whole point is to cut out the part where you have to request information from every vendor one by one just to do a basic comparison, so everything should be browsable and filterable right in the browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网应用，把不同的培训供应商汇集到一个地方，采购团队可以对比他们各自的产品、价格和其他买家的评价，不用分别向五家公司追要报价。重点是切掉那些必须逐个向每个供应商索取信息的繁琐环节，所有内容都应该在浏览器中可浏览和可筛选。

corpus_topic: group enrollment management portal for company admins
query_text: A web portal where a company admin can manage which employees are enrolled in which courses, add or remove people from groups, and see the status of everyone's enrollment in one place in the browser. Keeping track of who is signed up for what right now means juggling spreadsheets and emails, so having a central place where I can just look up a person and see all their active enrollments would actually make the job manageable.
query_text_zh: 做一个网门户，公司管理员可以管理哪些员工报名了哪些课程、添加或删除群组里的人、在浏览器中的一个地方查看每个人的报名状态。现在追踪谁报了什么课程意味着要处理电子表格和邮件，有个集中的地方可以查到某个人的所有在读课程会让工作变得可控。

corpus_topic: training invoice and payment portal for business clients
query_text: Need a web-based billing and payment site where a business client can see all their outstanding invoices for training services, download copies, and pay them online without having to call or email to ask for paperwork. Chasing down invoices and getting approvals takes forever when everything is done over email, so I want a place in the browser where the invoices are just there, ready to view and pay whenever someone has time to log in and handle it.
query_text_zh: 做一个网账单和支付网站，商业客户可以看到所有培训服务的未付发票、下载副本和在线支付，不用打电话或发邮件要求文件。通过邮件追要发票和获得批准太费时了，所以我想要一个浏览器地方，发票就在那儿，任何人登录后有时间就能查看和支付。

corpus_topic: reseller partner onboarding and commission tracking dashboard
query_text: Build a web app for reseller partners of a training company where they can get set up with all the info they need to start selling, track how many sales or referrals they have made, and see what commission they have earned so far. Right now there is no central place to check any of this, so having a browser-based hub where a partner can log in and actually see their numbers and access their resources would be a lot better than relying on emails and spreadsheets.
query_text_zh: 做一个培训公司转售伙伴的网应用，他们可以获得开始销售所需的所有信息、追踪销售或介绍数量、查看迄今为止的佣金所得。现在没有集中的地方查这些信息，有个浏览器中心枢纽，伙伴可以登录实际看到他们的数字、访问资源，会比依靠邮件和电子表格好得多。

corpus_topic: white-label course catalog configurator for B2B clients
query_text: Build a web-based tool where a business client can go in and set up their own branded version of a course catalog by choosing which courses to include, adding their company name and logo, and adjusting what their employees will see when they log in. The goal is to make it so a B2B client does not need to email someone every time they want to update their catalog, they can just handle it themselves in the browser without waiting on anyone.
query_text_zh: 做一个网工具，商业客户可以去自己创建课程目录的品牌化版本，选择要包含的课程、添加公司名称和标志、调整员工登录时看到的内容。目标是让企业客户不用每次想更新目录就邮件某人，他们可以在浏览器中自己处理，不用等着别人。

corpus_topic: training content licensing and royalty management site
query_text: Make a web-based management site for training content creators and the companies licensing their material, where both sides can see the active license agreements, track how much content has been used, and check royalty earnings and payments in one place. Keeping all of this straight across email threads and invoices is a real mess, so having a browser app where everything is recorded and visible without digging through old messages would make the whole thing much less painful.
query_text_zh: 做一个网管理网站供培训内容创作者和许可其材料的公司使用，双方都能在一个地方看到有效的许可证协议、追踪有多少内容被使用过、查阅版税所得和支付。在邮件主题和发票中理清所有这些事儿是真的乱，有个浏览器应用把所有东西都记录并显示出来、不用翻找旧邮件会轻松得多。

corpus_topic: annual subscription plan upgrade and renewal portal
query_text: Make a web portal where subscribers to a training platform can see what plan they are on, check when it renews, switch to a higher tier if they want more features, and complete the renewal payment all in the same place in the browser. Right now figuring out subscription status means hunting through old emails for confirmation messages, so having a single place where everything is laid out clearly and I can just click to renew or upgrade would be much easier.
query_text_zh: 做一个网门户，培训平台的订户可以查看自己的套餐级别、确认何时续订、想要更多功能时升级到更高等级、在浏览器中的同一个地方完成续订支付。现在弄清楚订阅状态意味着在旧邮件中寻找确认信息，有个单一地方清楚列出一切并可以点击续订或升级会简单得多。

corpus_topic: corporate account self-service onboarding and setup site
query_text: Need a web-based setup site where a new corporate account can get itself up and running without having to wait for someone from the training company to walk them through everything manually. I want to be able to enter our company details, add the admin users, set up our preferences, and get confirmation that we are ready to go, all by going through a clear step-by-step process right in the browser without needing a support call.
query_text_zh: 做一个网设置网站，让新注册的企业账户可以自己启动并运行，不用等着培训公司的人手把手教。我想能输入公司详情、添加管理员用户、设置偏好设置并得到我们已准备好的确认，全部通过浏览器中清晰的分步流程完成，不需要打支持电话。

corpus_topic: custom training program builder and pricing estimator
query_text: Build a web tool where someone can describe what kind of training they need for their team, pick things like the number of sessions, the topics, and the delivery format, and immediately see a price estimate based on what they have selected. Right now getting any kind of cost figure requires waiting on a sales person to send something back, so having a tool in the browser where the estimate updates as you make choices would cut out a lot of unnecessary waiting.
query_text_zh: 做一个网工具，人们可以描述团队需要什么培训、选择场次数、课题和交付方式等因素，立即看到基于选择的价格估算。现在要任何成本数字都得等销售人员回信，有个浏览器工具能在做出选择时实时更新估算会切掉很多不必要的等待。

corpus_topic: 入学面试预约
query_text: Need a web-based app where job candidates can book an interview time slot with a company directly in their browser, picking from a calendar of available times without having to go back and forth over email just to agree on a meeting. I want to be able to enter my name and contact info, choose a time that works, and get a confirmation right away so neither side has to chase the other down to figure out when the interview is happening.
query_text_zh: 做一个网应用，求职者可以直接在浏览器中与公司预约面试时间段，从可用时间日历中选择，不用来回发邮件来确定会议时间。我想能输入姓名和联系方式、选择合适的时间、立即得到确认，这样双方都不用互相追问来弄清楚面试什么时候进行。

corpus_topic: One-on-one tutoring session booking platform for K-12 students
query_text: Make a web app for booking one-on-one tutoring sessions for K-12 kids, because right now I have to go back and forth with the tutor over messages just to find a time that works, which takes forever. I want to be able to see the tutor's open slots on a calendar, pick a time, and lock it in all in one place, with a confirmation showing up somewhere on the screen so I know it actually went through.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个一对一家教预约网页应用，因为现在我得不停地和家教通过消息来回协商时间，非常费时间。我想能在日历上看到家教的空闲时间段，选一个时间，在一个地方就全搞定，屏幕上显示确认信息，这样我就知道预约真的成功了。

corpus_topic: Language school speaking practice slot reservation site
query_text: Make a web app where students can reserve speaking practice slots at a language school without having to call the front desk or send emails every single time. I just want to open it in the browser, see which time slots are still open for the week, pick one, and be done with it, maybe with a small note field to say which language level I am so the teacher knows what to expect.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，让学生可以预约语言学校的口语练习时间段，不用每次都给前台打电话或发邮件。我只想在浏览器里打开，看看这周还有哪些空闲时间段，选一个就完成了，还可以有一个小输入框说明我的语言水平，这样老师就知道对我的期望了。

corpus_topic: Music lesson teacher matching and scheduling portal
query_text: A web-based tool for matching students with music lesson teachers and locking in a practice schedule, because hunting for a teacher who has open slots on the right days is such a headache. The main part of the site should show available teachers, what instruments they teach, and their open time slots, so a parent or student can just pick a match and book the first session without having to send a bunch of messages back and forth.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页工具，用来匹配学生和音乐课老师，并锁定练习日程，因为找到一个有合适空闲时间的老师真的很麻烦。网站主要部分应该显示可用的老师、他们教什么乐器、他们的空闲时间段，这样家长或学生就能直接选择并预约第一堂课，不用来回发消息。

corpus_topic: University campus tour appointment booking system
query_text: Build a web app for booking university campus tour appointments, since right now you have to dig through multiple emails and forms just to sign up for a slot. I want a simple booking tool that shows available tour dates and times, lets you fill in your info and pick a spot, and then gives you a clear confirmation on screen so you actually know your spot is reserved and you don't have to wonder if it went through.
query_text_zh: 做一个大学校园参观预约网页应用，因为现在得在多个邮件和表格里翻来覆去才能报名参观。我想要一个简单的预约工具，显示有哪些参观日期和时间可选，让你填入信息并选择时间段，然后在屏幕上给你一个明确的确认信息，这样你就知道你的名额已经确保，不用担心是否报上了。

corpus_topic: Coding bootcamp discovery call and eligibility screening scheduler
query_text: Need a web app that handles scheduling discovery calls and quick eligibility checks for a coding bootcamp, so applicants aren't left hunting for a contact form or waiting days for someone to email back with available times. The tool should let someone pick a date and time for their call, answer a few short questions about their background right in the booking flow, and get a confirmation right away so everything is settled in one visit.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，来处理编程训练营的咨询电话预约和快速资格检查，这样申请者就不用到处找联系表或等好几天才能得到邮件回复。这个工具应该让人选择通话的日期和时间，在预约流程中回答几个关于背景的简短问题，然后马上得到确认，这样一次访问就全搞定了。

corpus_topic: SAT/ACT test prep tutoring session calendar
query_text: Build a web app that acts as a calendar and booking tool for SAT/ACT tutoring sessions, because keeping track of scheduled prep sessions across multiple students and tutors in my head or in a spreadsheet is a mess. I want a simple site where a student or parent can see upcoming available times, book a session, and check which sessions are already on the books, with a sidebar showing the student's name and which test they're prepping for.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，用作SAT/ACT家教预约和日历工具，因为要在多个学生和老师之间跟踪预约的补习课，用脑子或表格实在太乱了。我想要一个简单的网站，学生或家长可以看到即将空闲的时间，预约一堂课，查看已经预约的课程，旁边有一个栏显示学生名字和他们准备的考试科目。

corpus_topic: Corporate soft-skills training workshop seat reservation platform
query_text: Make a web app for reserving seats in corporate soft-skills training workshops, because every time HR announces a new session I have to reply to an email and then wait to find out if I actually got a spot. I want a browser-based reservation tool where I can see what workshops are coming up, how many seats are left, and just click to claim my spot with my name and team, then get a confirmation without any back-and-forth.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，用来预约公司软技能培训工作坊的座位，因为每次人力资源宣布新课程我都得回邮件，然后等着看自己是否抢到座位。我想要一个浏览器工具，能看到即将的工作坊日期、剩余座位数，直接点击就能抢座位并输入我的名字和团队，然后得到确认，不用来回协商。

corpus_topic: Online course instructor office hours booking tool
query_text: A browser-based booking tool for reserving office hours with online course instructors, because right now there is no easy way to know when a slot is actually open and you end up messaging the instructor and waiting around. The app should show the instructor's available hours for the week in a clear layout, let a student click a time and enter a short question or topic they want to discuss, and then confirm the booking right away.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页预约工具，用来预约在线课程讲师的办公时间，因为现在没有简单的方式知道什么时候才是真正空闲的，最后都得去给讲师发消息并等着。这个应用应该清晰地显示讲师这周的空闲时间，让学生点击一个时间并输入一个简短的问题或想要讨论的话题，然后立即确认预约。

corpus_topic: Academic advisor appointment scheduling portal for enrolled students
query_text: Create a web app for enrolled students to schedule meetings with their academic advisor, since the current process is sending an email and hoping for a reply with open times, which wastes days. I want a simple scheduling tool that shows all of the advisor's open appointment slots, lets me pick one and put in a brief reason for the meeting, and then shows a confirmed appointment on a little upcoming-meetings list so I can keep track without digging through emails.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用，让学生可以约见学术顾问，因为现在的流程是发邮件然后等回复中的空闲时间，这样要耽误好几天。我想要一个简单的预约工具，显示顾问所有的空闲预约时间段，让我选一个并输入一个简短的会议理由，然后在一个近期会议列表上显示已确认的预约，这样我就能跟踪而不用去翻邮件。

corpus_topic: Study abroad program consultation booking site
query_text: Make a web app for booking consultations about study abroad programs, because right now finding out which programs you qualify for and actually talking to an advisor feels like it takes ten steps. I want a simple site that lists available consultation times, lets students pick a slot and mention which country or program they are interested in, and then sends a clear confirmation so they know the meeting is set without having to check their email three times.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来预约出国留学咨询，因为现在要找出你符合哪些项目并真正和顾问谈话感觉要十多个步骤。我想要一个简单的网站，列出可用的咨询时间，让学生选择时间段并提到他们感兴趣的国家或项目，然后发送一个明确的确认，这样他们就知道会议已经定好，不用检查三遍邮件。

corpus_topic: Special educational needs assessment appointment system
query_text: Make a web app for scheduling special educational needs assessments for children, because parents currently have to make phone calls and wait for callbacks just to get an appointment time. I want a browser-based booking tool where a parent can see available assessment dates, pick a suitable time, fill in some basic info about the child, and confirm the booking in one go, so nothing slips through the cracks and there is a clear record of what was booked.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来预约儿童特殊教育评估，因为家长现在必须打电话并等回电才能约到时间。我想要一个浏览器预约工具，家长可以看到可用的评估日期，选一个合适的时间，填入孩子的一些基本信息，然后一次性确认预约，这样就不会遗漏任何事情，还有一个清楚的预约记录。

corpus_topic: Art and design class trial session booking platform
query_text: Build a web app for booking trial sessions at art and design classes, because right now signing up for a trial class means finding the studio's contact page, sending a message, and waiting to hear back about whether there is space. I want a booking tool that shows available trial slots for different classes like drawing, painting, or graphic design, lets someone pick a time, and confirms the reservation on screen so the whole thing is done in a couple of clicks from the desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来预约艺术和设计班的试听课，因为现在报名试听课意味着要找到工作室的联系页面，发消息，然后等着听是否还有名额。我想要一个预约工具，显示不同课程如素描、绘画或平面设计的可用试听时间段，让人选一个时间，在屏幕上确认预约，这样从桌面浏览器上点击几下就全搞定了。

corpus_topic: 题库/模拟测试
query_text: Need a web app that works like a practice test bank, where I can take timed mock tests on a subject, see which questions I got wrong, and look up the correct answers right after. I want to be able to browse questions by topic, pick a set to work through, and then see a score at the end with a clear breakdown of which areas I need to study more, all in the browser so I can use it at my desk while studying.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，像一个练习题库一样，我可以在某个科目上做计时模拟考试，看到我做错了哪些题，然后立即查看正确答案。我想能根据主题浏览题目，选一组来做，然后在最后看到分数，并清楚地分解出哪些领域我需要更多学习，全部在浏览器里完成，这样我可以在书桌前学习时使用。

corpus_topic: Flashcard and spaced-repetition study tool site
query_text: A website-based flashcard study tool where I can create decks organized by subject, add cards with a question on one side and the answer on the other, and have the app decide which cards to show me more often based on how well I know them. I want the study session to show one card at a time, let me flip it to check the answer, and then mark it as easy, okay, or hard so the tool knows when to bring it back.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页式抽认卡学习工具，我可以创建按科目整理的卡牌组，每张卡的一面是问题另一面是答案，应用根据我对卡牌的掌握程度决定更频繁地显示哪些卡。我想让学习环节每次显示一张卡，可以翻到查看答案，然后标记为简单、还行或困难，这样工具就知道什么时候要再次显示它。

corpus_topic: Academic paper annotation and reading progress tracker
query_text: A web-based tracker for keeping notes on academic papers I am reading, where I can add a paper by title and author, jot down highlights or comments on specific parts, and mark it as in-progress or finished. I want to see a list of all the papers I have added with a reading status next to each one, and be able to open a paper entry to read back my annotations without losing my place, all from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页学术论文笔记追踪器，可以按标题和作者添加论文，记下重点或对特定部分的评论，标记为进行中或已完成。我想能看到我添加的所有论文的列表，每个旁边显示阅读状态，还能打开论文条目来回看我的注释而不丢失我的位置，全部从桌面浏览器上操作。

corpus_topic: Collaborative study group scheduling and matching platform
query_text: Make a web app for organizing and scheduling study groups, where students can create a group for a specific course, list which days and times they are free, and get matched with other students who have overlapping availability. I want the app to show a side-by-side view of everyone's availability so picking a meeting time is obvious, and then let the group confirm a time slot and note what topics they plan to cover.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来组织和安排学习小组，学生可以为某个课程创建一个小组，列出他们有空的日期和时间，然后和其他具有重叠空闲时间的学生匹配。我想应用显示一个所有人空闲时间的并排视图，这样选择见面时间就很明显，然后让小组确认一个时间段并注明他们计划覆盖哪些话题。

corpus_topic: Language vocabulary builder with native-speaker audio clips
query_text: Need a vocabulary-building web app for language learners that lets me add new words, attach a short meaning, and play a recorded audio clip of a native speaker saying the word. I want to keep my word list organized by language and topic, be able to click through words one at a time to hear the pronunciation, and mark the ones I feel confident about so I can focus review time on the ones I keep forgetting.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个语言学习者的词汇构建网页应用，让我添加新单词、附加简短含义、播放母语使用者说这个单词的录音片段。我想按语言和话题组织我的单词表，能逐个点击单词听发音，标记我觉得掌握的单词，这样我可以专注复习那些我不断遗忘的单词。

corpus_topic: Coding bootcamp curriculum and project submission portal
query_text: Make a web app for coding bootcamp students to track their curriculum progress and submit finished projects, where each week's lessons show up as a checklist you can tick off as you complete them. I want a spot to upload or paste a link to each finished project, see which assignments are still pending, and have the whole thing accessible in a desktop browser so I can check it easily while I am working through the material.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用让编程训练营学生追踪他们的课程进度和提交完成的项目，每周的课程作为一个检查表显示，完成时可以打钩。我想有一个地方上传或粘贴指向每个完成项目的链接，看哪些作业还在等待中，整个东西可以在桌面浏览器上访问，所以我可以在做课程时轻松查看。

corpus_topic: K-12 homework help and live tutoring marketplace
query_text: Need a web app that works as a marketplace for K-12 homework help and live tutoring, where parents can search for tutors by subject and grade level, see their ratings and available hours, and book a session. I want a simple list of tutors with their subjects and hourly rate, a way to pick a time slot, and a section where the student can describe what they need help with before the session starts.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，用作K-12家教帮助和实时家教的市场，家长可以按科目和年级搜索家教，看他们的评分和可用时间，并预约一堂课。我想看到一个简单的家教列表，包括他们的科目和时薪，有方式选择一个时间段，还有一个区域让学生在课程开始前描述他们需要帮助的内容。

corpus_topic: Professional certification exam prep and practice site
query_text: Build a web app for preparing for professional certification exams, where I can browse practice questions sorted by topic, take a timed practice test, and then review a results breakdown showing which topics I did well on and which ones I need to revisit. I want the questions to be multiple-choice with explanations for the correct answers, and I want to be able to save a set of weak-area questions for extra review, all in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来准备专业认证考试，我可以按话题浏览分类的练习题，做一个计时练习测试，然后查看显示我在哪些话题做得好以及哪些需要复习的结果分解。我想要多选题包含正确答案的解释，还能保存一组弱项的题目供额外复习，全部在桌面浏览器上完成。

corpus_topic: University course catalog and four-year degree planner
query_text: A web-based degree planner for university students where I can browse the full course catalog, drag courses into a four-year schedule laid out by semester, and see at a glance which required courses I have covered and which ones are still missing. I want to be able to search the catalog by subject or course number, click a course to see its description and any prerequisites, and then place it into whichever semester makes sense for my plan.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页式学位规划师给大学生，我可以浏览完整的课程目录，把课程拖到一个四年日程中按学期布局，一眼看出我涵盖了哪些必修课以及哪些还缺。我想能按科目或课程编号搜索目录，点击一个课程查看其描述和任何先修课，然后把它放到对我的计划有意义的任何学期中。

corpus_topic: Corporate employee onboarding and compliance training portal
query_text: Need a web app for managing employee onboarding and compliance training, where new hires can see a checklist of required training modules, complete each one in order, and track which ones they have finished. I want the app to show each training topic as a step with a short description, mark it complete once the person has gone through it, and display an overall progress indicator so managers and employees can both see how far along the onboarding is.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来管理员工入职和合规培训，新员工可以看到必需培训模块的检查表，按顺序完成每一个，追踪他们完成了哪些。我想应用把每个培训话题显示为一个步骤，带一个简短描述，一旦这个人完成了就标记为完成，显示总体进度指示器，这样经理和员工都能看到入职进行到哪一步了。

corpus_topic: STEM interactive virtual lab simulation platform
query_text: Need a web app that lets students run interactive virtual lab simulations for STEM subjects right in the browser, without needing any special software installed. I want a catalog of available experiments organized by subject like physics, chemistry, or biology, where I can click one, adjust variables like temperature or force using sliders, and then see the results update on the screen so it actually feels like doing an experiment, with a spot to log my observations.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用让学生在浏览器中直接运行交互式虚拟实验室模拟，不需要安装任何特殊软件。我想有一个可用实验的目录，按物理、化学或生物等科目组织，我可以点击一个，用滑块调整温度或力等变量，然后看到屏幕上的结果实时更新，这样感觉像在做真正的实验，还有一个地方记录我的观察。

corpus_topic: Peer skill-exchange and learning community site
query_text: Make a web app for a peer skill-exchange community where people can list a skill they are willing to teach and another skill they want to learn, then browse other members to find a good swap match. I want a simple profile for each member showing what they offer and what they want, a way to send a connection request, and a section on the home screen that shows recently posted skill offers so it is easy to see what is available.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用给一个同伴技能交换社区，人们可以列出他们愿意教的技能和想学的技能，然后浏览其他成员找一个好的交换匹配。我想每个成员都有一个简单的档案显示他们提供什么和想要什么，有一种方式发送连接请求，主屏幕上有一个区域显示最近发布的技能，这样容易看到有什么可用的。

corpus_topic: Academic essay writing feedback and rubric grading tool
query_text: Build a web app for getting feedback on academic essays, where a student can paste in their writing, see comments tied to specific parts of the text, and check how the essay scores against a rubric covering things like argument strength, structure, and evidence. I want the rubric scores to show up as a simple rating for each category and the feedback to appear alongside the essay text in the desktop browser so everything is visible at once.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来获得学术论文的反馈，学生可以粘贴他们的写作，看到与文本特定部分相关的评论，检查论文如何根据覆盖论点强度、结构和证据等的标准评分。我想标准评分显示为每个类别的简单评分，反馈出现在桌面浏览器中论文文本旁边，所以所有内容一次可见。

corpus_topic: 家长沟通群
query_text: Need a web app for managing a parent communication group where the class teacher can post announcements and parents can reply or ask questions in one shared space, with a left sidebar listing all announcements by date and the main area showing the full thread so everything stays organized and easy to scroll through on a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来管理家长沟通组，班级老师可以发送公告，家长可以在一个共享空间内回复或提问，左边栏按日期列出所有公告，主区域显示完整的对话线程，这样所有内容都很有组织并且在桌面浏览器上易于滚动浏览。

corpus_topic: peer tutoring marketplace for university course students
query_text: Create a web app that works as a peer tutoring marketplace for university students, where students looking for help can browse tutors by subject and course, see each tutor's background and hourly rate, and send a booking request, while tutors can set up a simple profile listing what they can teach and when they're free, all usable in a desktop browser with a clean two-column layout.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用用作大学生的同伴家教市场，寻求帮助的学生可以按科目和课程浏览家教，看每个家教的背景和时薪，发送预约请求，同时家教可以设置一个简单的档案列出他们能教什么以及什么时候有空，全部在桌面浏览器上使用，具有干净的两列布局。

corpus_topic: study group finder for enrolled online learners
query_text: Create a study group finder app for online course students where you can post what class you're taking and what kind of study partner you're looking for, and browse others doing the same, with a simple browser-based interface that shows open groups on one side and a short profile or message thread on the other so people can actually connect and start studying together.
query_text_zh: 做一个学习小组查找应用给在线课程学生，你可以发布你正在上什么课以及你在寻找什么样的学习伙伴，浏览其他也在做同样事情的人，有一个简单的浏览器界面在一侧显示开放的小组，在另一侧显示简短的档案或消息线程，这样人们可以真正连接并开始一起学习。

corpus_topic: faculty mentorship matching platform for graduate students
query_text: Build a web app that helps graduate students find faculty mentors to work with, where students can browse professor profiles by research area and then send a short intro message to request a mentorship connection, and professors can list their interests and whether they're currently taking students, all laid out nicely for desktop browsers with a sidebar for filtering by department or topic.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用帮助研究生找到一起工作的教师导师，学生可以按研究领域浏览教授档案，然后发送一个简短的自我介绍消息请求导师关系，教授可以列出他们的兴趣以及他们是否目前收学生，所有的都为桌面浏览器整理得很好，有一个边栏用按部门或话题过滤。

corpus_topic: collaborative lecture note wiki for enrolled course cohorts
query_text: Build a collaborative note-sharing app for students in the same course where anyone in the cohort can add lecture notes to a shared wiki-style space, edit or expand what someone else wrote, and leave comments on specific sections, all running in a desktop browser so you can have the notes open on one side while working on the other, making it easy to build up a shared knowledge base over the semester.
query_text_zh: 做一个协作笔记共享应用给同一课程的学生，群组中的任何人都可以给共享的维基式空间添加讲座笔记，编辑或扩展别人写的内容，在特定部分留下评论，全部在桌面浏览器中运行，这样你可以在一侧打开笔记，在另一侧工作，轻松在学期中建立一个共享知识库。

corpus_topic: coding bootcamp cohort community and job board
query_text: Create a web app for a coding bootcamp cohort that combines a community space with a job board, where students and alumni can post questions, share resources, and cheer each other on in a group feed, while a separate jobs section lets people post openings or share leads they've heard about, all accessible in a browser with a sidebar to switch between the community and jobs areas.
query_text_zh: 做一个编程训练营群组的网页应用，结合一个社区空间和一个工作板，学生和校友可以在一个小组动态中发布问题、分享资源和互相加油，同时一个单独的工作岗位部分让人发布职位空缺或分享他们听到的机会，全部在浏览器上可访问，有一个边栏来切换社区和工作岗位区域。

corpus_topic: language exchange partner matching for language school enrollees
query_text: Need a language exchange partner matching app for people enrolled in a language school, where you fill in what language you're learning and what you can offer in return, then the app shows you other enrolled students who are a good fit so you can reach out and set up practice sessions, built as a website that works well on a desktop with a browseable list of potential partners and a simple messaging thread.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个语言交换伙伴匹配应用给在语言学校注册的人，你填入你正在学的语言和你可以作为回报提供的东西，然后应用显示你其他注册的学生中很合适的，这样你可以联系并设置练习课程，建立为在桌面上运行得好的网站，有一个可浏览的潜在伙伴列表和一个简单的消息线程。

corpus_topic: teacher professional learning community and resource forum
query_text: Make a web app for teachers to run their own professional learning community, where they can share lesson ideas, classroom strategies, and useful links in a shared resource forum, organized by subject or grade level so it's easy to find what you need, with a desktop-friendly layout that shows topic categories on the left and posts or resources on the right for comfortable reading and browsing.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用给老师运行他们自己的专业学习社区，他们可以分享课程想法、课堂策略和有用的链接在一个共享的资源论坛，按科目或年级组织，这样容易找到你需要的，有一个桌面友好的布局，左边显示话题类别，右边显示帖子或资源，用于舒适的阅读和浏览。

corpus_topic: school volunteer coordination hub for parents and staff
query_text: Build a school volunteer coordination app for parents and staff where upcoming volunteer opportunities are listed with time slots, and parents can sign up for the ones that work for them, while staff can post new needs and see at a glance how many people have signed up, built as a browser-based tool with a calendar-style overview and a detail panel on the right showing who's signed up for each slot.
query_text_zh: 做一个学校志愿者协调应用给家长和员工，即将到来的志愿者机会与时间段一起列出，家长可以注册适合他们的那些，而员工可以发布新需求并一眼看出有多少人已经注册，建立为浏览器工具，有一个日历式概览和右边的详细面板显示谁注册了每个时间段。

corpus_topic: student project showcase gallery with peer feedback
query_text: Create a web app that acts as a student project showcase gallery where each student can post their completed project with a title, description, and screenshots or links, and classmates and teachers can leave feedback comments on each one, with a desktop browser layout that shows all projects in a browseable gallery on the main area and opens the full project detail with comments alongside when you click one.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用用作学生项目展示库，每个学生都可以发布他们完成的项目，带标题、描述和截图或链接，同学和老师可以在每个上面留下反馈评论，有一个桌面浏览器布局，在主区域显示所有项目的可浏览库，当你点击一个时打开完整的项目详情和评论在旁边。

corpus_topic: homeschool co-op coordination and curriculum sharing site
query_text: Build a web app for homeschool co-op families to coordinate their group activities and share curriculum materials, where parents can post their available teaching slots, share lesson plans or book lists that worked well for them, and sign kids up for co-op classes, all running in a desktop browser with a weekly schedule view on one side and a shared resource library on the other for easy browsing.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用给家学合作家庭协调他们的小组活动和共享课程材料，家长可以发布他们可用的教学时间段，分享对他们有效的课程计划或书单，为合作班级注册孩子，全部在桌面浏览器中运行，一侧有一个周日程视图，另一侧有一个共享资源库用于轻松浏览。

corpus_topic: graduate research collaboration and co-author network
query_text: A browser-based researcher network app where graduate students and academics can post their research interests and ongoing projects, browse others working on related topics, and send a short message to propose co-authoring or collaboration, with a profile page for each person showing their publications and areas of focus and a simple search on the side for filtering by field or keyword.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器研究员网络应用给研究生和学术界，他们可以发布他们的研究兴趣和进行中的项目，浏览从事相关话题的其他人，发送一个简短的消息来提议共同作者或协作，每个人都有一个档案页面显示他们的出版物和专注领域，还有一个简单的搜索在侧边用按字段或关键词过滤。

corpus_topic: campus club directory and student-run event calendar
query_text: Create a web app for a university campus that combines a club directory with a student-run event calendar, where each club has a short profile with contact info and meeting details, and any club officer can add upcoming events to a shared calendar that all students can browse, built for desktop browsers with a sidebar listing all clubs and a main area showing the calendar or a selected club's page.
query_text_zh: 做一个大学校园的网页应用，结合一个俱乐部目录和一个学生运营的事件日历，每个俱乐部都有一个带联系信息和会议细节的简短档案，任何俱乐部官员都可以给一个所有学生都可以浏览的共享日历添加即将来临的事件，为桌面浏览器建立，有一个边栏列出所有俱乐部，主区域显示日历或选定俱乐部的页面。

corpus_topic: 考试/作业平台
query_text: Make a web app that handles the whole exam and homework submission hassle in one place, where students can find their assigned work, upload their answers or files before the deadline, and see their grades and feedback once the teacher has reviewed things, while teachers can post assignments, set due dates, and go through submissions without dealing with a mess of emails, all working in a regular desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用在一个地方处理整个考试和家庭作业提交的麻烦，学生可以找到他们分配的工作，在截止日期前上传他们的答案或文件，看他们的成绩和反馈一旦老师审阅了东西，同时老师可以发布作业、设置截止日期，并浏览提交而不用处理一堆邮件的混乱，全部在常规的桌面浏览器中工作。

corpus_topic: attendance tracking dashboard for K-12 schools
query_text: Make a browser-based attendance tracking app for K-12 schools where teachers can quickly mark who showed up, who was late, and who was absent each day from a class list, and the school office can pull up a summary for any student or class over a chosen time range without digging through paper records or scattered spreadsheets, with a clean per-class view on the left and a records summary panel on the right.
query_text_zh: 做一个浏览器考勤追踪应用给K-12学校，老师可以从班级名单中快速标记谁出席、谁迟到、谁缺席每一天，学校办公室可以为任何学生或班级拉出一个选定时间范围的摘要而不用翻纸质记录或分散的表格，有一个干净的左边班级视图和右边的记录摘要面板。

corpus_topic: academic transcript request and verification portal
query_text: Create a web app where students can submit a transcript request and track whether it has been processed and sent, so they stop having to email the registrar's office and wait without knowing what is happening, with a simple form to fill out the request details and a status tracker that updates as the office reviews and completes it, all accessible from a desktop browser without any extra steps.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用让学生可以提交成绩单请求并追踪它是否已被处理和发送，这样他们就不用给登记员办公室发邮件然后等着不知道发生了什么，有一个简单的表格来填出请求细节和一个随着办公室审阅和完成而更新的状态追踪器，全部可以从桌面浏览器访问而不用任何额外步骤。

corpus_topic: teacher lesson plan builder with shared library
query_text: Create a web app that lets teachers build and save their lesson plans in a shared library, where they can write out their plan with the topic, learning goals, activities, and materials, and also browse plans shared by other teachers at the school to reuse or adapt, so they stop reinventing the wheel every term, with a desktop browser layout that shows the plan editor on one side and the shared library on the other.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用让老师可以在一个共享库中构建和保存他们的课程计划，他们可以写出他们的计划，包含话题、学习目标、活动和材料，还可以浏览学校其他老师分享的计划来重复使用或调整，这样他们就不用每学期重新发明轮子，有一个桌面浏览器布局在一侧显示计划编辑器，另一侧显示共享库。

corpus_topic: rubric designer and grading criteria builder
query_text: Need a web-based rubric builder where teachers can set up grading criteria for an assignment by listing each category and the point values for different performance levels, save it as a reusable rubric, and then use it later to grade student work by clicking the appropriate level for each row, so grading is consistent and students can clearly see where their marks came from, all in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页标准构建器，老师可以通过列出每个类别和不同性能水平的分值来为作业建立分级标准，保存它作为可重复使用的标准，然后稍后通过点击每行的适当水平来用它评分学生的作业，这样分级就一致了，学生可以清楚地看到他们的分数来自哪里，全部在桌面浏览器中。

corpus_topic: student academic progress analytics dashboard
query_text: Create a web app that shows each student's academic progress in one place, pulling together their grades across subjects and how those scores have changed over time, so teachers and advisors can spot who is falling behind without manually comparing different gradebooks, with a per-student summary view and a side panel for filtering by class or time period, all running in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用在一个地方显示每个学生的学术进度，汇总他们的各科成绩以及这些分数如何随时间变化，这样老师和顾问就可以找出谁落后了而不用手动比较不同的成绩册，有一个每学生摘要视图和一个侧面板用按班级或时间段过滤，全部在桌面浏览器中运行。

corpus_topic: classroom seating chart editor for teachers
query_text: Need a classroom seating chart editor for teachers that works in the browser, where you can drag and drop student names onto a visual grid that represents the room layout, rearrange seats when needed, and save multiple arrangements for different activities, so you stop fiddling with hand-drawn charts or spreadsheets every time the seating changes, with a clean desktop-friendly editor and a saved charts list on the side.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个在浏览器中运行的课堂座位表编辑器给老师，你可以把学生名字拖放到表示房间布局的视觉网格上，在需要时重新排列座位，保存多个不同活动的安排，这样你就不用每次座位改变时都摆弄手绘图表或表格，有一个干净的桌面友好的编辑器和左边保存的图表列表。

corpus_topic: plagiarism detection results viewer for instructors
query_text: Create a web app for instructors to view plagiarism detection results for submitted student work without having to navigate clunky external tools, where each submission shows a similarity score and highlights the flagged passages so the instructor can quickly decide whether it needs a closer look, with a list of all submissions on the left and the detailed results for the selected one on the right, built for desktop browser use.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用让讲师看不到复杂外部工具就能查看学生提交作业的抄袭检测结果，每个提交都显示一个相似度分数并突出标记的段落，这样讲师可以快速决定是否需要更仔细地查看，左边有一个所有提交的列表，右边有选定提交的详细结果，为桌面浏览器使用建立。

corpus_topic: parent-teacher conference scheduler and messaging hub
query_text: Build a web app that handles parent-teacher conference scheduling and messaging so schools can stop coordinating everything through phone calls and paper slips, where parents can pick an available time slot with their child's teacher and send a short note about what they want to discuss, and teachers can see their full schedule for the day and reply to any messages, all working in a desktop browser with a calendar on one side and messages on the other.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来处理家长-老师会议预约和消息，这样学校就可以停止通过电话和纸片协调所有事情，家长可以选择一个与孩子老师的可用时间段并发送一个简短的说明关于他们想讨论什么，老师可以看到他们当天的完整日程并回复任何消息，全部在桌面浏览器中工作，一侧有日历，另一侧有消息。

corpus_topic: school event and room booking calendar
