query_text: Make a school event and room booking calendar app for the browser where staff can see which rooms and time slots are already taken, submit a booking request for a room and event, and check if it was approved, so there's no more confusion about double-booking the gym or auditorium, with a weekly calendar view that shows all events color-coded by location and a booking form that pops up when you click an open slot.
query_text_zh: 做一个学校事件和房间预约日历应用给浏览器，员工可以看到哪些房间和时间段已被占用，提交一个房间和事件的预约请求，检查它是否被批准，这样就不再有关于双重预约体育馆或礼堂的混乱，有一个周日历视图显示所有按位置色码的事件和一个当你点击开放时间段时弹出的预约表格。

corpus_topic: peer tutor matching and session booking platform
query_text: Create a web app that matches students who need help in a subject with peer tutors who know it well, where tutors can list what they teach and when they're free, and students can browse and book a session without going through a whole back-and-forth, so the whole process takes minutes instead of days of emailing, built for desktop browsers with a tutor directory on the main page and a simple booking flow.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用给需要科目帮助的学生匹配懂这科的同伴家教，家教可以列出他们教什么以及什么时候有空，学生可以浏览并预约一堂课而不用通过整个来回协商，这样整个流程只用分钟而不是几天的邮件，为桌面浏览器建立，主页上有一个家教目录和一个简单的预约流程。

corpus_topic: spaced repetition flashcard study manager
query_text: Build a web app for managing a spaced repetition flashcard study routine, where you can create decks of cards for different subjects, study them in the browser each day with the app deciding which cards to show based on how well you remembered them last time, and track your progress so you can see which topics still need work and which you've got down, with a clean desktop interface for both card creation and study sessions.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来管理一个间隔重复抽认卡学习例程，你可以为不同科目创建卡牌组，每天在浏览器中学习他们，应用根据你上次如何记住他们来决定显示哪些卡，追踪你的进度这样你可以看到哪些话题还需要工作以及哪些你已掌握，有一个干净的桌面界面用于卡创建和学习课程。

corpus_topic: collaborative online whiteboard for live classroom use
query_text: Need a collaborative online whiteboard tool that the teacher and all students can draw and write on at the same time during class, where everyone can see each other's changes live in the browser without any delay, and the teacher can also lock certain areas so only they can write there while students work on their own sections, all accessible from a regular desktop web browser with no software to install.
query_text_zh: 需要一个协作在线白板工具，让老师和所有学生在课堂上可以同时一起绘图和写字，每个人都能在浏览器里实时看到彼此的改动，没有任何延迟，老师还可以锁定某些区域只让自己写那里，学生在各自的部分工作，所有这些都可以从普通桌面网络浏览器访问，无需安装任何软件。

corpus_topic: 品牌百年史
query_text: Create a website that tells the hundred-year story of a brand in a way that actually feels worth looking at, with a richly layered timeline running along the side where each decade has its own mood and color palette, and clicking into any era brings up the old logos, packaging, and ad imagery from that period in a way that feels more like flipping through a beautifully printed book than scrolling a webpage, all designed for a desktop browser so the wide layout really breathes.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站讲述一个品牌的百年历史，要让人真的想去看，用一条精心设计的时间线放在旁边，每个年代都有自己的氛围和色彩调色板，点进任何一个时代都能看到那个时期的老logo、包装和广告图片，感觉更像是翻一本印刷精美的书而不是滚动网页，全部为桌面浏览器设计，这样宽布局才能真正展现。

corpus_topic: Magazine cover archive gallery spanning decades
query_text: Need a magazine cover archive gallery app that lets you browse decades of covers in a visually lush way right in the desktop browser, where the covers are displayed large enough to actually appreciate the typography and photography of each era, and you can filter by decade or publication so the whole thing feels like wandering through a curated art collection rather than a plain image search.
query_text_zh: 需要一个杂志封面存档库应用，让你可以在桌面浏览器里用视觉上很丰富的方式浏览几十年的封面，封面要显示得足够大才能真正欣赏每个时代的字体和摄影，你可以按年代或杂志来筛选，整体感觉像是在逛一个精心策展的艺术收藏展览，而不是普通的图片搜索。

corpus_topic: Newspaper historical front page browser site
query_text: Create a website for browsing historical newspaper front pages, where the overall feel is warm and slightly aged like old newsprint but still clean and easy to read on a desktop browser, with a timeline you can scrub through by year or decade to pull up front pages from that moment in history, and each page should show a nicely rendered image of the full front page alongside a short note about the headline story.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站浏览历史报纸头版，整体感觉温暖、略微显旧像老报纸，但在桌面浏览器上仍然清晰易读，有一条时间线可以按年或按十年跳转，拉出那个历史时刻的头版，每一页应该显示一个很好渲染的头版整页图片，旁边配一个关于头条故事的简短说明。

corpus_topic: Publishing house complete book catalog showcase
query_text: Create a book catalog showcase app for a publishing house where the whole thing feels like stepping into a well-designed independent bookshop, displayed beautifully in a desktop browser with covers shown large and the sidebar letting you filter by genre or year, and clicking any title opens a clean spread with the cover art front and center, a short description, and a list of related titles from the same series or author.
query_text_zh: 为出版社做一个图书目录展示应用，整个体验感觉就像走进一家设计精美的独立书店，在桌面浏览器上漂亮地展示，书封要显示得很大，边栏可以按流派或年份筛选，点击任何书名都会打开一个清晰的页面，书皮艺术品居中，带有简短描述和相同系列或同作者的相关书籍列表。

corpus_topic: Literary journal back-issue archive browser
query_text: Build a literary journal back-issue archive browser that has the kind of quiet, considered visual quality you'd expect from the journals themselves, running in a desktop browser where the layout gives each issue its own cover image and a gentle year label, and browsing feels like pulling volumes off a shelf, with the ability to click into any issue and read the table of contents with contributor names listed in elegant type.
query_text_zh: 做一个文学期刊过刊存档浏览器，有那种你从期刊本身会期待的安静、精致的视觉品质，在桌面浏览器里运行，布局让每期期刊都有自己的封面图片和柔和的年份标签，浏览感觉就像从书架上抽出书卷，能够点进任何一期阅读目录，看到贡献者的名字用优雅的字体列出来。

corpus_topic: Podcast network show and episode visual directory
query_text: Need a podcast network directory app that works in a desktop browser and feels visually rich rather than flat and utilitarian, where each show has its own cover art displayed prominently and a sidebar lets you browse by topic or host, and clicking a show takes you to its episode list with the key art staying visible so the whole experience feels more like browsing a record store than a plain list of links.
query_text_zh: 需要一个播客网络目录应用，在桌面浏览器上工作，视觉上丰富而不是扁平功利风格，每个节目都有自己的封面艺术品突出显示，边栏可以按话题或主持人浏览，点击一个节目会打开它的剧集列表，关键艺术品保持可见，所以整个体验更像逛唱片店而不是普通链接列表。

corpus_topic: Documentary film series synopsis and stills showcase
query_text: Make a documentary film series showcase app for desktop browsers where each film in the series gets its own full-width still image as the backdrop, with the synopsis laid over it in clean readable type, and a filmstrip-style row at the top lets you move between titles in the series so the pacing feels slow and cinematic rather than rushed, with the stills chosen for mood so the whole app feels like a carefully curated film program.
query_text_zh: 做一个纪录片系列展示应用给桌面浏览器，系列中的每部电影都有自己的全宽剧照作为背景，脚本用清晰易读的字体覆盖在上面，顶部的胶卷式行让你在标题之间移动，节奏感慢而电影化而不是匆忙，剧照的选择讲究氛围感，所以整个应用感觉像一个精心策展的电影节目。

corpus_topic: News brand design and typography heritage site
query_text: Build a heritage site app for a news brand that celebrates its history of design and typography, running in a desktop browser with a layout that itself references the brand's visual legacy, where you can explore how the masthead and typefaces evolved over the decades through large specimen images and short written context, and the overall tone is reverent and editorial, like a retrospective exhibition catalog brought to the web.
query_text_zh: 为新闻品牌做一个遗产网站，庆祝它在设计和字体方面的历史，在桌面浏览器上运行，布局本身就参考了品牌的视觉遗产，你可以通过大的样本图片和简短的书面背景来探索过去几十年里标题和字体的演变，整体基调崇敬而编辑性，像一个回顾展览目录搬到网上。

corpus_topic: Bestseller list visual retrospective timeline site
query_text: A bestseller list retrospective timeline app for desktop browsers where each year on the timeline glows with the aesthetic of that moment, cover art from the top titles of each year arranged in a row so you can feel the shift in publishing tastes across decades, and hovering on any title brings up a small panel with the author, a one-line description, and how many weeks it held the top spot, all rendered with warm typography that makes the whole thing feel like a love letter to reading culture.
query_text_zh: 做一个畅销书单回顾时间线应用给桌面浏览器，时间线上的每一年都闪耀着那个时刻的审美，每年排名靠前的书的封面艺术品排成一行，你可以感受到几十年间出版品味的转变，鼠标悬停在任何书上都会弹出一个小面板，显示作者、一句话描述和它保持最高排名的周数，全部用温暖的字体呈现，让整个东西感觉像是对阅读文化的情书。

corpus_topic: Wire service archive photography showcase
query_text: Need a wire service archive photography showcase app that treats these historical press photos with the same visual respect you'd give fine art, running in a desktop browser with a generous layout where the images fill most of the screen and the caption and dateline appear in clean secondary type alongside, and a filter along the top lets you narrow by decade or subject so browsing feels like curating a photography book rather than searching a database.
query_text_zh: 需要一个通讯社存档摄影展示应用，以你对待艺术品一样的视觉尊重来对待这些历史新闻照片，在桌面浏览器上运行，有大方的布局让图片填满大部分屏幕，说明和日期用清晰的次要字体显示在旁边，顶部的筛选器让你按年代或主题缩小范围，浏览感觉像是在策展一本摄影书而不是搜索数据库。

corpus_topic: Newsroom staff and correspondent profile directory
query_text: A newsroom staff and correspondent profile directory app, beautifully laid out in a desktop browser where each journalist gets a portrait and a short bio written in a warm, human tone rather than a dry resume format, with the left side letting you filter by beat or region and the profiles themselves arranged in a grid that feels considered and editorial, the kind of page where you actually want to linger and read rather than scan and leave.
query_text_zh: 做一个新闻编辑室工作人员和通讯员简历目录应用，在桌面浏览器里漂亮地呈现，每个记者都有肖像和用温暖、人性化的语气而不是干燥简历格式写的简短简历，左边可以按话题或地区筛选，简历本身排列成一个感觉精致、编辑性的网格，那种你真的想逗留并阅读而不是快速扫一眼就离开的页面。

corpus_topic: Annual report interactive infographic display site
query_text: Need a website that turns a company annual report into something visually stunning and actually worth exploring in a desktop browser, where the numbers and milestones from the year are presented through large illustrated charts and bold typographic callouts that feel more like a magazine spread than a financial document, and you can click into any section to get more detail while the overall layout stays clean and editorial throughout.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网站把公司年报变成视觉上令人惊叹、实际上值得在桌面浏览器里探索的东西，年度的数字和里程碑通过大型插图图表和粗体字体标注来呈现，感觉更像杂志页面而不是财务文件，你可以点击任何部分获得更多细节，同时整体布局始终保持清晰、编辑性。

corpus_topic: Data journalism visual explainer archive
query_text: Make a data journalism visual explainer archive app that collects all the past illustrated explainers and data stories in one place for desktop browsers, with each piece shown as a preview image and a short headline so browsing the collection feels like flipping through a coffee table book of visual storytelling, and clicking any piece opens it full width with the original charts and illustrations intact so nothing gets cramped or loses its intended visual impact.
query_text_zh: 做一个数据新闻可视化说明档案应用，把所有过去的插图说明和数据故事收集在一个地方给桌面浏览器，每件作品都显示为一个预览图片和简短标题，浏览收藏感觉像是翻一本可视化故事讲述的咖啡桌书，点击任何一件都会全宽打开它，原始图表和插图完整保留，所以没有什么会显得拥挤或失去预期的视觉冲击力。

corpus_topic: 特稿专栏
query_text: Make a feature stories column app for desktop browsers that gives long-form writing the visual presentation it deserves, where each piece opens with a full-width atmospheric photo, the headline is set in large editorial type that sets the right mood before you even start reading, and a sidebar on the left shows the rest of the column's recent pieces with their cover images so the reader can wander between stories the way you'd browse a beautiful print magazine.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个特稿专栏应用，给长篇写作提供它应得的视觉呈现，每件作品都以全宽大气照片开篇，标题用大型编辑字体排版，这个排版在你开始阅读之前就设定了正确的氛围，左边的边栏显示其他最近的专栏作品和它们的封面图片，读者可以像浏览一本漂亮的印刷杂志一样在故事之间漫游。

corpus_topic: 播客节目站
query_text: Make a podcast show site for desktop browsers that feels warm and inviting rather than technical, where the show's cover art sits large and front and center, the episode list below it has a generous layout with each episode's title and a one-line description shown clearly, and the overall visual tone matches the personality of the show through thoughtful color choices and typography that makes even first-time visitors feel like they already know what this podcast is about.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个播客节目网站，感觉温暖邀人而不是技术性，节目的封面艺术品坐在大而突出的位置，下面的剧集列表有宽松的布局，每个剧集的标题和一句话描述清晰显示，整体视觉基调通过深思的色彩选择和字体来匹配节目的个性，即使初次访客也能感觉到他们已经知道这个播客是什么了。

corpus_topic: 电子期刊
query_text: Build a digital journal app for desktop browsers where each issue feels like a real publication rather than a plain webpage, with the current issue's cover displayed prominently at the top, a clean table of contents where each article entry has a small mood image alongside the title, and past issues accessible through a back-catalog shelf that shows their covers lined up the way physical journals would look on a reading room table.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个数字期刊应用，每期都感觉像一个真实的出版物而不是普通网页，当期的封面突出显示在顶部，清晰的目录，每个文章条目旁边都有一个小的氛围图片，过期期刊可以通过一个后目录书架访问，显示它们的封面像物理期刊在阅读室桌子上那样排列。

corpus_topic: long-form investigative journalism platform for local regions
query_text: Create a long-form investigative journalism platform focused on local regions, built as a web app for desktop browsers, where each investigation gets a beautifully designed opening spread with a strong lead photo and a standfirst that draws you in before the full piece begins, and a region filter in the sidebar lets readers browse stories by area so local journalism feels as carefully presented as the best national magazines.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器创建一个以地方地区为重点的长篇调查新闻平台网络应用，每项调查都有一个设计精美的开篇页，有强有力的引导照片和一个在完整作品开始前吸引你的导言，边栏的地区筛选器让读者按地区浏览故事，所以地方新闻感觉像最好的全国杂志一样精心呈现。

corpus_topic: digital photo essay and photojournalism publication
query_text: Make a digital photo essay and photojournalism publication app where the whole experience in a desktop browser feels cinematic and slow, each photo essay opening with a single large image that fills most of the screen, the text flowing alongside in measured paragraphs so the writing and photography breathe together, and a front page that shows recent essays through their lead images in a layout that looks handpicked rather than algorithmically generated.
query_text_zh: 做一个数字摄影文章和摄影新闻出版应用，整个桌面浏览器体验感觉电影化而缓慢，每篇摄影文章都以一张单独的填满大部分屏幕的大图片开篇，文字流在旁边成段落，所以写作和摄影一起呼吸，前页通过它们的引导图片显示最近的文章，看起来像精心挑选而不是算法生成。

corpus_topic: science explainer and research translation newsroom
query_text: Build a science explainer and research translation newsroom website for desktop browsers that has the visual intelligence of a design-forward magazine, where each explainer piece uses well-chosen illustrations or diagrams displayed at a scale that actually lets you see what they mean, the tone throughout feels approachable and curious rather than academic, and the home layout groups stories by theme in a way that looks genuinely considered rather than just sorted by date.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个科学解释和研究翻译新闻室网站，有设计前瞻杂志的视觉智能，每个解释作品使用精心挑选的插图或图表，以一个能让你真正看到它们意思的尺度显示，始终的基调感觉平易近人和好奇而不是学术的，主页布局按主题对故事分组，看起来真的很精致而不是仅仅按日期排序。

corpus_topic: literary excerpt and book review editorial site
query_text: Create a literary excerpt and book review editorial site as a web app for desktop browsers, where the reading experience itself feels precious and unhurried, with each review opening in a clean wide column of text set in a typeface that makes you want to keep reading, the book cover shown to one side at a generous size, and a section on the home screen that surfaces recent excerpts with pull quotes displayed in a size large enough to stop you mid-scroll.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器创建一个文学摘录和书评编辑网站网络应用，阅读体验本身感觉珍贵而不急不躁，每个书评都以清晰宽阔的文本列打开，用一种让你想继续阅读的字体排版，书封显示在一侧，大方的尺寸，首页一个区域浮现最近的摘录，pull quotes显示得足够大停下你的滚动。

corpus_topic: documentary film companion text and transcript archive
query_text: Create a documentary film companion text and transcript archive app for desktop browsers, where each film's companion materials are organized in a calm, well-spaced layout that lets the writing stand on its own, with the film's key still images woven into the text at natural intervals rather than shoved into a gallery, and a sidebar index showing all the films in the archive so you can move between companion pieces the way you'd browse a well-organized library collection.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器创建一个纪录片配套文本和成绩单档案应用，每部电影的配套材料都组织在一个平静、空间充足的布局中，让写作自己独立，电影的关键剧照自然间隔编织到文本中而不是塞进一个库，边栏索引显示档案中的所有电影，你可以在配套作品之间移动，就像在一个组织良好的图书馆收藏中浏览。

corpus_topic: data-driven journalism and interactive chart newsroom
query_text: Build a data-driven journalism and interactive chart newsroom app for desktop browsers where the charts and visual stories are treated as the main event rather than decoration, each piece opening with its most striking chart displayed large so the insight hits you immediately, the surrounding text minimal and purposeful, and a home layout that previews the visual character of each story through a thumbnail of its lead chart so the whole site feels like a gallery of illuminating ideas.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个数据驱动新闻和互动图表新闻室应用，图表和视觉故事被视为主要事件而不是装饰，每件作品都以它最引人的图表大显示打开，所以洞察力立即击中你，周围的文本最少化和有目的，主页布局通过它的引导图表的缩略图预览每个故事的视觉特性，所以整个网站感觉像是一个启蒙想法的库。

corpus_topic: opinion and editorial commentary magazine site
query_text: Make a opinion and editorial commentary magazine site for desktop browsers that has the confident visual voice of a publication that knows exactly what it stands for, with each piece introduced by a bold typographic treatment of the headline that sets a tone before a word of the article is read, contributor portraits shown with a warmth that makes the writers feel like real people, and a home layout that groups pieces by conversation thread so related opinions and responses are shown together.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个观点和社论评论杂志网站，有一个知道自己代表什么的出版物的自信视觉声音，每件作品都由标题的粗体字体处理介绍，这个处理在文章的一个词被读之前就设定了基调，贡献者肖像用温暖感显示，让作者感觉像真实的人，主页布局按对话线程对作品分组，所以相关意见和回应显示在一起。

corpus_topic: academic preprint reading and annotation digest
query_text: Create a web app for desktop browsers where readers can browse and annotate academic preprints in a digest format that actually feels pleasant to spend time in, with each preprint entry showing a short plain-language summary alongside the original title so you can decide whether to go deeper, and a personal notes area on the right side of the reading view where your annotations sit visibly alongside the text in a calm, typographically refined layout that makes serious reading feel less overwhelming.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器创建一个网络应用，让读者可以浏览和注释学术预印本的摘要格式，这种格式实际上感觉是令人愉快花费时间的，每个预印本条目显示一个简短的平原语言摘要和原始标题，所以你可以决定是否更深入，读取视图右边有一个个人笔记区域，你的注释在一个平静、排版细致的布局中清楚地在文本旁边，这让认真阅读感觉不那么压倒。

corpus_topic: travel narrative and destination writing publication
query_text: Need a travel writing app for desktop browsers where each destination gets its own richly atmospheric spread, the kind where a full-bleed landscape photo sits alongside long-form narrative prose and the typography feels editorial and considered, like a coffee table book that lives in your browser. I want readers to be able to move through destinations in a flowing, story-first way, and I want the whole thing to carry a consistent visual mood, warm and unhurried, that makes every piece feel like it belongs to the same journey.
query_text_zh: 需要一个旅游写作应用给桌面浏览器，每个目的地都有自己的氛围丰富的页面，那种有全幅风景照片坐在长篇叙述散文旁边的类型，字体感觉编辑和精致，像一本住在你浏览器里的咖啡桌书。我想让读者能够以一种流畅、故事优先的方式在目的地之间移动，我想让整个东西保持一致的视觉氛围，温暖而不急不躁，让每件作品都感觉像属于同一个旅程。

corpus_topic: environmental and climate crisis reporting magazine
query_text: Need a climate and environmental crisis magazine app that feels as urgent and serious as the stories inside it, built for desktop browsers so there is real room to breathe. I want the visual tone to be stark and honest, dark backgrounds with bold headline typography and full-width photojournalism imagery that stops you in your tracks, not something cheerful or clean-tech looking. Articles should sit in a focused reading layout with the sidebar showing related stories, and the whole app should feel like it was art-directed by someone who cares deeply about the subject.
query_text_zh: 需要一个气候和环境危机杂志应用，感觉与内部的故事一样紧迫和严肃，为桌面浏览器构建，所以有真正的空间呼吸。我想让视觉基调是严峻和诚实的，黑色背景配粗体标题字体和全宽摄影新闻图像让你停在轨道上，不是什么欢快或清洁科技感觉。文章应该坐在一个专注的阅读布局中，边栏显示相关故事，整个应用应该感觉像被一个深切关心这个主题的人艺术指导。

corpus_topic: 活动宣传页
query_text: Create a web app for promoting events that has the kind of visual energy that actually makes people want to show up, with a big expressive hero area at the top that sets the mood instantly using bold color and strong imagery, then a clean event details section below where the date, location, and description are easy to scan. The whole thing should feel like a well-designed poster brought to life in the browser, confident and eye-catching, not like a plain form you fill out at a government office.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用推广事件，有那种实际上让人想去参加的视觉能量，顶部有一个大表达性英雄区域，用粗体颜色和强有力的图像立即设定氛围，然后下面是一个清晰的事件详细信息部分，日期、位置和描述易于扫描。整个东西应该感觉像一个设计精美的海报在浏览器中活跃，自信和醒目，不像你在政府办公室填写的普通表格。

corpus_topic: digital magazine newsletter signup and lead-gen landing page
query_text: Build a newsletter signup and reader acquisition site for a digital magazine that actually feels worth subscribing to, for desktop browsers, where the visual presentation alone makes you want to hand over your email address. I want a beautiful hero area that communicates the magazine's personality immediately through typography and imagery, a sample issue preview that gives people a real taste of the content and aesthetic, and a signup area that feels inviting rather than transactional, like you are joining a community with taste rather than clicking a checkbox.
query_text_zh: 为桌面浏览器做一个通讯稿注册和读者获取网站，针对一个数字杂志，实际上感觉值得订阅，单单视觉呈现就让你想交出你的电子邮件地址。我想要一个美丽的英雄区域，立即通过字体和图像沟通杂志的个性，一个示例期刊预览，给人们一个真正的内容和审美品尝，和一个注册区域，感觉邀请而不是交易的，像你加入一个有品味的社区而不是点击复选框。

corpus_topic: media kit and advertising packages showcase site
query_text: Make a media kit website where brands and advertisers can browse advertising packages in a way that feels genuinely impressive rather than like reading a spreadsheet, designed for desktop browsers with generous space to let the numbers and audience stats breathe. The whole site should have the polished confidence of a publication that knows its own value, with each package presented so the pricing and reach stats feel compelling and beautifully framed, and a clear sense of the magazine's visual identity running through every part of it.
query_text_zh: 做一个媒体包网站，品牌和广告商可以在其中浏览广告套餐，感觉真正令人印象深刻而不像读电子表格，为桌面浏览器设计，有充分空间让数字和观众统计呼吸。整个网站应该有一个知道自己价值的出版物的抛光自信，每个套餐呈现，所以定价和到达统计感觉令人信服和美丽的框架，和杂志视觉身份的清晰感贯穿它的每一部分。

corpus_topic: podcast network listener growth promotional campaign page
query_text: Create a web app promotional site for a podcast network that makes people genuinely excited to become listeners, where the design energy matches the kind of shows being featured, warm and inviting and full of personality. I want each show to have its own little moment on the page with artwork that pops, a short preview description, and a way to subscribe or follow right from the browser, all wrapped in a layout that feels like the work of someone who actually listens to and loves podcasts, not a generic media company page.
query_text_zh: 为播客网络创建一个网络应用宣传网站，让人们真的兴奋成为听众，设计能量与被展示的节目种类相匹配，温暖邀人且充满个性。我想让每个节目在页面上都有自己的小时刻，弹出的艺术品，简短的预览描述，和一个从浏览器订阅或关注的方式，所有包装在感觉像某个真的听过和热爱播客的人的工作的布局中，不是一个泛型媒体公司页面。

corpus_topic: book publisher seasonal bundle deals promotional page
query_text: Create a seasonal book bundle deals site for a publisher that has the cozy, gift-worthy visual warmth of a well-curated bookshop window, designed for desktop browsers so there is enough horizontal space to show several bundles side by side with their gorgeous cover arrangements. Each bundle should feel like a thoughtful, considered set with a little description of the theme tying the titles together, and the whole page should carry a seasonal mood, whether autumnal or festive or summery, through its color palette and typographic choices.
query_text_zh: 为出版社创建一个季节书籍捆绑交易网站，有一个精心策展的书店窗口的舒适、礼物式的视觉温暖，为桌面浏览器设计，所以有足够的水平空间一次显示几个包，有它们漂亮的封面排列。每个包应该感觉像一个深思的、精致的集合，有一个将标题绑在一起的小主题描述，整个页面应该通过它的色彩调色板和字体选择承载一个季节氛围，无论是秋天还是节日还是夏天。

corpus_topic: documentary series exclusive early-access preview landing page
query_text: An early-access preview site for a documentary series where the very first thing you see in the browser is a cinematic full-screen moment, maybe a striking still from the film or a title treatment with the kind of atmosphere that makes you immediately want to watch, and then as you scroll down the page slowly reveals more about the story, the filmmakers, and how to get access before anyone else. The whole app should feel like the documentary itself in miniature, with a visual mood and pacing that is intentional and atmospheric rather than promotional in a corporate way.
query_text_zh: 做一个纪录片系列的早期访问预览网站，你在浏览器看到的第一件事是一个电影全屏时刻，也许是电影中的一个引人注目的剧照或一个有那种氛围让你立即想看的标题处理，然后当你向下滚动页面时慢慢揭示更多关于故事、电影制作者和如何在任何人之前获得访问权。整个应用应该感觉像电影本身的小型化，有一个有意和大气的视觉氛围和节奏，而不是以公司的方式推广。

corpus_topic: news outlet gift subscription holiday campaign page
query_text: A holiday gift subscription site for a news outlet where the feeling is warm and celebratory but still editorially credible, with the kind of layout that makes giving a year of quality journalism feel like a genuinely thoughtful present. The web app should have a cozy seasonal look, rich colors and considered type, with a gift selection area where you can choose the subscription length and add a personal message, all laid out spaciously for desktop browsers so the whole experience feels considered and generous rather than rushed.
query_text_zh: 一个新闻机构的假日礼物订阅网站，感觉温暖和庆祝但仍然编辑上可信，有那种让给一年高质量新闻感觉像一个真正深思礼物的布局。网络应用应该有一个舒适的季节外观，丰富的颜色和深思的类型，有一个礼物选择区域，你可以选择订阅长度和添加个人消息，全部为桌面浏览器宽松布局，所以整个体验感觉深思和慷慨而不是匆忙。

corpus_topic: author book launch preorder countdown microsite
query_text: Make a book launch microsite for an author that lives in the browser and has the atmosphere of the book itself baked into every design choice, the typography, the color palette, the imagery, so that by the time someone reaches the preorder button they already feel like they know the world of the book. I want a live countdown timer that adds a bit of anticipation, an excerpt or chapter preview to give readers a real taste, and the whole thing should feel like a love letter to the book rather than a generic product page.
query_text_zh: 为作者做一个书籍发布微网站，生活在浏览器中，有书籍本身的氛围融入每个设计选择，字体、色彩调色板、图像，所以当某人到达预订按钮时他们已经感觉像他们知道书的世界。我想要一个实时倒计时计时器，增加一点期待，一个摘录或章节预览，给读者一个真正的品尝，整个东西应该感觉像书的情书而不是一个泛型产品页面。

corpus_topic: publisher affiliate and referral rewards enrollment portal
query_text: Need a web app portal where people can sign up as affiliates or referral partners for a publishing brand, and the experience of signing up should feel as considered and welcoming as the brand itself, with a clear explanation of how the rewards work laid out beautifully for desktop browsers. I want the enrollment flow to feel guided and graceful, not like filling out a corporate form, with the tier levels and earning potential presented in a visual way that feels exciting and motivating, consistent with the editorial taste of the publication.
query_text_zh: 需要一个网络应用门户，人们可以注册为出版品牌的会员或推荐合作伙伴，注册的体验应该像品牌本身一样精致和欢迎，对回报的工作方式有一个清晰的解释，为桌面浏览器漂亮地布局。我想让注册流感觉引导和优雅，不像填写公司表格，有层级和赚取潜力以一种感觉兴奋和激励的视觉方式呈现，与出版物的编辑品味一致。

corpus_topic: editorial awards ceremony sponsorship microsite
query_text: Create a sponsorship microsite for an editorial awards ceremony that has the gravitas and elegance the occasion deserves, built to look stunning in a desktop browser with lots of room for the ceremony's visual identity to show through. I want a site that lays out the sponsorship tiers and what each one includes in a way that feels prestigious rather than transactional, with imagery from past ceremonies and testimonials from previous sponsors that give the whole thing credibility and warmth, the kind of page that makes a brand actually want to put their name on the event.
query_text_zh: 为编辑奖项仪式创建一个赞助微网站，有这个场合应得的庄严和优雅，为在桌面浏览器看起来惊人而构建，有很多空间仪式的视觉身份展示。我想要一个网站，以一种感觉有名望而不是交易的方式，布局赞助层级和每一个包括的东西，有过去仪式的图像和以前赞助商的证词，给整个东西可信度和温暖，那种让品牌真的想把他们的名字放在事件上的页面。

corpus_topic: branded content studio portfolio and pitch landing page
query_text: Make a portfolio and pitch site for a branded content studio that works beautifully in a desktop browser, where potential clients land and immediately feel the creative confidence of the studio through the way the work is shown, full-screen case studies with atmospheric stills, confident typography, and a consistent point of view running through everything. I want the pitch section to feel like an invitation rather than a sales deck, with a brief description of the studio's philosophy and a way for brands to start a conversation, all wrapped in a visual identity that is memorable and tasteful.
query_text_zh: 为品牌内容工作室做一个作品集和宣传网站，在桌面浏览器中漂亮地工作，潜在客户着陆并立即通过工作显示方式感觉工作室的创意自信，全屏案例研究配大气剧照、自信的字体和贯穿一切的一致观点。我想让宣传部分感觉像一个邀请而不是销售甲板，与工作室哲学的简短描述和一个品牌开始对话的方式，所有包装在一个可记忆和有品味的视觉身份中。

corpus_topic: student journalist press pass application site
query_text: Build a web app where student journalists can apply for a press pass, and make the experience feel genuinely encouraging and professional rather than bureaucratic, because the design should signal to young reporters that their work is being taken seriously. I want a clean application form that is easy to fill out on a desktop browser, with room to share their affiliation, a portfolio link, and the events they want to cover, plus a clear picture of what the press pass actually gets them, laid out with the editorial confidence of the publication issuing it.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，学生记者可以在其中申请记者证，让体验感觉真的鼓励和专业而不是官僚，因为设计应该向年轻记者发出信号，他们的工作被认真对待。我想要一个清晰的应用表格，在桌面浏览器上易于填写，有空间分享他们的隶属关系、作品集链接和他们想覆盖的事件，加上关于记者证实际得到什么的清晰图片，用发布它的出版物的编辑自信来布局。

corpus_topic: investigative journalism crowdfunding campaign page
query_text: A crowdfunding campaign site for investigative journalism where every design decision communicates seriousness and trust, because people giving money to fund reporting need to feel that their contribution is going somewhere meaningful and credible. The web app should have a clear story about the investigation at its center, laid out in the browser with long-form prose and supporting imagery, a funding progress display that feels honest and transparent, and contribution tiers explained in plain language that respects the reader's intelligence and makes the act of supporting feel important.
query_text_zh: 一个调查新闻的众筹活动网站，每个设计决策都传达严肃和信任，因为给钱资助报道的人需要感觉他们的贡献去某个有意义和可信的地方。网络应用应该有一个关于调查的清晰故事在它的中心，在浏览器中布局，有长篇散文和支持图像，一个感觉诚实和透明的资金进度显示，和以尊重读者智力的平原语言解释的贡献层级，使支持的行动感觉重要。

corpus_topic: 打赏系统
query_text: Make a tipping and donation tool for web browsers where readers can send a quick payment to a creator or writer without me having to wire everything up manually every time someone asks how to say thanks. I need a simple way for the creator to set up tip amounts, like a few preset options plus a custom field, and for the payer to finish the whole thing in a couple of clicks so they don't abandon it halfway through, with a basic record of who sent what and when so the creator isn't hunting through email to figure out their totals.
query_text_zh: 为网络浏览器做一个小费和捐赠工具，读者可以快速向创意者或作者发送支付，无需我每次有人问如何说谢谢时手动挂上一切。我需要一个简单的方式让创意者设置小费金额，像几个预设选项加一个自定义字段，对于支付人来说，在几次点击中完成整个东西，所以他们不会在半途放弃，有一个谁发了什么和什么时候的基本记录，所以创意者不是狩猎通过电子邮件来计算他们的总数。

corpus_topic: digital magazine subscription management portal
query_text: Build a subscription management web app for a digital magazine where subscribers can log in, see exactly what plan they are on, update their billing info, and pause or cancel without having to email customer support every single time. Right now it is a mess where people send angry emails because there is no self-service option at all, so I just need something browser-based that handles the basics, shows renewal dates clearly, and lets someone swap between monthly and annual without creating a whole support ticket.
query_text_zh: 为数字杂志做一个订阅管理网络应用，订户可以登录，清楚地看到他们在什么计划上，更新他们的账单信息，暂停或取消，无需每次都向客户支持发送电子邮件。现在这是一个混乱，人们发送愤怒的电子邮件，因为根本没有自助选项，所以我只需要处理基础的浏览器网络应用，清晰显示续期日期，让某人在月度和年度之间交换，无需创建整个支持票。

corpus_topic: press release distribution marketplace for brands
query_text: Make a press release distribution marketplace web app where a brand or PR person can submit a release, pick which outlets or journalist categories they want to reach, and actually track whether it got picked up, because right now the whole process is just emailing spreadsheets and hoping for the best. I need the submission form to be straightforward, the targeting options to be filterable by beat or region in the browser, and some kind of confirmation or status tracker so brands stop asking me if their release went out.
query_text_zh: 做一个新闻稿发布市场网络应用，品牌或公关人员可以提交发布，选择他们想到达哪些媒体或记者类别，并实际追踪它是否被挑选，因为现在整个过程就是通过电子邮件发送电子表格并希望最好。我需要提交表格很直接，目标选项可以在浏览器中按话题或地区筛选，某种确认或状态追踪器，所以品牌停止问我他们的发布是否出去。

corpus_topic: sponsored content placement marketplace for publishers
query_text: Make a sponsored content marketplace web app where publishers can list their available placement slots with audience numbers and topic areas, and brands can browse and book a spot directly in the browser without needing to go back and forth over email for two weeks just to agree on a price. I need publishers to be able to set their own rates and available dates, brands to be able to filter by audience size or topic, and some kind of simple booking confirmation so both sides know the deal is locked without anyone having to chase anyone.
query_text_zh: 做一个赞助内容市场网络应用，出版商可以列出他们可用的放置槽位，附带观众数字和话题区域，品牌可以在浏览器中浏览和预订一个位置，无需两周回过头来进行电子邮件，只是同意一个价格。我需要出版商能够设置他们自己的费率和可用日期，品牌能够按观众大小或话题筛选，某种简单的预订确认，所以两边都知道交易被锁定，没有任何人需要追逐任何人。

corpus_topic: editorial content licensing and syndication rights platform
query_text: Build a web app for managing content licensing and syndication rights so that when a publication wants to republish one of our articles, the whole thing can happen through a browser portal instead of a chain of emails, PDF attachments, and confused follow-ups. I need a way for potential licensees to browse available content, submit a licensing request with details about their intended use and territory, and for us to approve or counter-propose a deal, with the final agreement terms stored somewhere both sides can actually find them later.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来管理内容授权和联合权利，所以当一个出版物想要重新发布我们的一篇文章时，整个事情可以通过浏览器门户进行，而不是一连串的电子邮件、PDF附件和困惑的跟进。我需要一个方式让潜在被许可人浏览可用内容，提交许可请求，有关他们的预期使用和领土的详情，以及对我们来说批准或反报价交易，最终协议条款存储在两边真的能找到它们的地方。

corpus_topic: author royalties and advance tracking dashboard
query_text: Make a royalty and book advance tracker web app for authors who are tired of opening spreadsheets and doing manual math every time a new statement arrives, so they can just log into a browser and see at a glance how much of their advance has earned out, what royalty payments have come in, and which titles are performing. I want a simple way to enter statement data by book title, a running total that shows earn-out progress, and a history of all payments received so there is one place to look instead of three different folders of PDFs.
query_text_zh: 做一个版税和书籍预付款追踪网络应用，给那些厌倦打开电子表格和每次新报表到达时做手动数学的作者，所以他们可以登录浏览器，一目了然地看到他们的预付款有多少已经赚出，什么版税支付已经进来，哪些标题表现。我想要一个简单的方式按书名输入报表数据，一个跑总数显示赚出进度，和所有收到的支付的历史，所以有一个地方看而不是三个不同的PDF文件夹。

corpus_topic: B2B media kit and advertising rate card site
query_text: A web app for a B2B media kit site where advertisers can look up our audience stats, download rate cards, and see what ad formats we offer, because right now every agency email starts with the same five questions I already answered in a PDF that no one can find. I need the site to work well in a desktop browser for media buyers who are comparing options, with our reach numbers and format specs laid out clearly by placement type, and a way for someone to request a custom quote or download the full kit without having to create an account first.
query_text_zh: 一个网络应用的B2B媒体包网站，广告商可以查找我们的观众统计、下载费率卡和看到我们提供什么广告格式，因为现在每个机构电子邮件都以相同的五个问题开始，我已经在一个PDF里回答过，没有人能找到。我需要网站在为比较选项的媒体购买者的桌面浏览器上工作良好，有我们的触及数字和格式规格按放置类型清晰布局，和一个方式让某人请求自定义报价或下载完整工具包，无需先创建账户。

corpus_topic: podcast network ad inventory self-serve marketplace
query_text: Build a self-serve ad booking web app for a podcast network where brands can browse open inventory across shows, see audience demographics and episode download numbers for each one, and reserve a spot directly in the browser without needing a sales call just to find out what is available. I want advertisers to be able to filter by show topic or audience size, pick a flight date, and get a booking confirmation, and I want the whole flow to be fast enough that someone comparison-shopping across networks can actually finish the job in one sitting.
query_text_zh: 为播客网络做一个自助广告预订网络应用，品牌可以浏览开放库存在所有节目上，看观众人口统计和每一个的剧集下载数字，并在浏览器中直接预订一个位置，无需销售电话只是找出什么可用。我想让广告商能够按节目话题或观众大小筛选，选择飞行日期，获得预订确认，我想让整个流足够快，某人比较网络的购物可以实际上在一个坐下完成工作。

corpus_topic: newsletter sponsorship matching platform for publishers
query_text: Build a sponsorship matching web app for newsletter publishers where they can list their audience details and available sponsor slots, and brands looking to advertise in newsletters can browse and reach out directly in the browser, because right now both sides are posting in random Slack groups and Discord servers and hoping someone sees it. I need publishers to be able to set a simple profile with their topic focus, subscriber count, and open dates, and brands to be able to filter by niche and contact a publisher to start a deal, all without needing an intermediary.
query_text_zh: 为通讯出版商做一个赞助匹配网络应用，他们可以列出他们的观众详情和可用赞助槽位，品牌想要在通讯中广告，可以在浏览器中浏览和直接到达，因为现在两边都在随机Slack群组和Discord服务器中发布并希望某人看到它。我需要出版商能够设置一个简单的简介，有他们的话题焦点、订户数和开放日期，品牌能够按利基筛选和接触出版商开始交易，全部无需一个中介。

corpus_topic: academic journal institutional license purchasing portal
query_text: Make a web app where university librarians or department heads can browse academic journal packages, see exactly what titles are included in each institutional license tier, and complete a purchase or renewal request all in the browser without having to call a sales rep just to get a quote. The whole thing is way too slow right now because there is no self-service option, so I need a clear breakdown of what each license covers, a way to filter journals by subject area, and a straightforward checkout or request form that works on a desktop browser without requiring a demo first.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，大学图书馆员或系主任可以浏览学术期刊套餐，清晰看到每个机构许可层级包括什么标题，并在浏览器中完成购买或续期请求，全部无需打电话销售代表只是获得报价。整个事情现在太慢因为没有自助选项，所以我需要每个许可覆盖什么的清晰细分，一个按主题区域筛选期刊的方式，和一个直接的检出或请求表格，在桌面浏览器上工作，无需首先要求演示。

corpus_topic: print-on-demand book publishing storefront
query_text: Create a web app for a print-on-demand book publishing storefront where I can upload a manuscript, pick a cover style, and set the price, then have it available for people to order copies online without me having to deal with any printing or shipping myself. The storefront should show each title with a preview of the cover and a quick summary, and buyers should be able to place an order and get a confirmation right in the browser.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个按需出版书籍的在线店铺网页，可以上传稿件、选择书皮风格、设定价格，然后让人们在网上订购，而我不用费力处理印刷和快递的事。店铺要展示每本书的名称和书皮预览，还要有简介，买家可以下单然后在浏览器里直接看到订单确认。

corpus_topic: corporate content reprint and permissions licensing portal
query_text: Create a web app that handles all the boring back-and-forth around corporate content reprint and permissions licensing, where a company can list the articles or assets they own, and someone who wants to reuse that content can fill out a quick request form, see the license terms and fee, and pay for approval all in one place without emailing anyone back and forth. The left side should show available content to license and the right side should show the request status so everything stays organized.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个能够处理企业内容转载和版权许可的网页应用，省去那些来回邮件确认的麻烦。公司可以在上面列出自己拥有的文章或资产，想要重新使用这些内容的人可以快速填表提出申请，看到许可条款和费用，然后直接付款获得批准，所有事情都在一个地方完成。左边显示可以许可的内容，右边显示申请的进度，这样一切都井井有条。

corpus_topic: white-label newsletter reseller platform for agencies
query_text: Make a web app that lets agencies run a white-label newsletter reseller business without juggling a dozen spreadsheets and email threads. Agencies should be able to sign up, brand the newsletter with their own name and logo, add their own list of subscribers, and then send out issues under their own look. There should also be a simple area to see how many emails went out and whether subscribers are opening them, all from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，让广告公司可以做白标新闻通讯转售业务，不用再维护一堆表格和邮件线程。广告公司可以注册账户、用自己的名字和标志给通讯刊物做品牌、添加自己的订阅者列表，然后按照自己的样式发送各期内容。还要有一个简单的区域显示发出了多少邮件、订阅者有没有打开，这些都可以在桌面浏览器里看到。

corpus_topic: book signing event registration site for fan readers
query_text: Make a website where fans can register for a book signing event, pick a time slot that works for them, and get a confirmation so they know their spot is saved. It's annoying when you have to email or call just to sign up for something like this, so the whole thing should be self-service in a browser. Let fans see the author info, the event details, and available spots, and have them fill in their name and contact info to lock in their registration.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网站，粉丝可以注册参加作者签售活动，选择适合他们的时间段，然后得到确认这样他们就知道自己的位置保留好了。本来要发邮件或打电话才能报名这种活动特别麻烦，所以这个网站应该完全自助的在浏览器里就能完成。粉丝应该能看到作者的信息、活动细节和还有多少空位，然后填入他们的名字和联系方式来确认报名。

corpus_topic: author meet-and-greet slot booking for literary festival attendees
query_text: Make a web app for booking author meet-and-greet slots at a literary festival, because right now it's a nightmare trying to figure out who's available and when. Attendees should be able to browse which authors are there, see open time slots on a simple calendar, and claim a spot with their name and email so there's no double-booking. The app should also send a quick reminder or at least show a confirmation so the attendee knows they're all set.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用来预约文学节作者见面会的时间段，因为现在搞清楚谁什么时候有空简直是噩梦。参加者可以浏览哪些作者会参展，看一个简单日历上的空余时间段，然后用名字和邮箱占个位置这样就不会有重复预约。应用还应该能发一个快速提醒或者至少显示确认信息，这样参加者就知道都搞定了。

corpus_topic: podcast guest pitch and appearance scheduling platform
query_text: Create a web app that takes all the hassle out of managing podcast guest pitches and scheduling appearances, because right now pitches come in from all over the place and it's hard to track who's been booked and who's still waiting. Podcasters should be able to review incoming guest pitches in a list on the left, click one to see the full pitch details on the right, and then confirm a recording date and time that gets added to the booking calendar, all from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来管理播客嘉宾的邀约和安排录制时间，因为现在邀约从四面八方来，很难追踪谁已经定了档谁还在等。播客制作者应该能在左边的列表里查看进来的邀约，点击某个看到右边的详细邀约信息，然后确认一个录制的日期和时间，这个信息就会加入预约日历，所有这些都能在桌面浏览器里完成。

corpus_topic: media press credentials application and pickup scheduling portal
query_text: Need a browser-based tool that handles the whole mess of applying for media press credentials and scheduling a pickup time, because chasing down forms and confirming by email eats up way too much time. Journalists should be able to fill in their outlet info and event they're covering, submit the application, then pick a time slot to collect their badge or credentials. The app should show the current application status and the scheduled pickup time clearly so nothing gets lost.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个基于浏览器的工具来处理申请媒体采访证和安排领取时间这整个烦人的过程，因为来来回回填表格和邮件确认太浪费时间了。记者应该能填入他们的媒体机构信息和要覆盖的活动，提交申请，然后选择一个时间段去领取证件。应用要清楚地显示当前的申请状态和预约的领取时间，这样不会有东西丢失。

corpus_topic: newsroom guided tour booking site for journalism students
query_text: Create a website for journalism students to book a guided tour of a real newsroom, because right now there's no easy way to know when tours are available or how to sign up. Students should be able to see open tour dates and times, pick a slot, enter their school and group size, and get a confirmation. The booking app should run in a desktop browser and also let the newsroom side see how many people are coming for each tour date.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网站，让新闻系学生可以预约参观真正的新闻编辑部，因为现在根本没办法知道什么时候可以参观或者怎么报名。学生应该能看到开放的参观日期和时间，选一个时间段，输入他们的学校和团队人数，然后得到确认。这个预约应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行，还要让新闻编辑部那边能看到每个参观日期会来多少人。

corpus_topic: editorial consultation appointment site for freelance writers
query_text: Make a web app that lets freelance writers book an editorial consultation appointment with an editor, because hunting down availability and going back and forth over email just to set up a 30-minute call is a total time drain. Writers should be able to see an editor's available times in a simple calendar view, pick a slot, and leave a short note about what they want feedback on. The confirmation should appear right in the browser so the writer knows the time is locked in.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用，让自由撰稿人可以预约和编辑的咨询时间，因为来回邮件找档期就为了约半小时的通话太费时间了。撰稿人应该能在一个简单的日历里看到编辑的可用时间，选一个时间段，留一个简短的便签说说他们想得到什么反馈。确认信息应该在浏览器里直接出现，这样撰稿人就知道时间已经定下来了。

corpus_topic: book launch RSVP and seat selection platform
query_text: Create a web app where people can RSVP for a book launch event and choose their seat ahead of time, because having to show up early just to grab a good chair is really inconvenient. The app should show a simple floor plan of the venue with seats labeled as available or taken, let the attendee click a seat to claim it, then fill in their name and email to confirm. The whole thing should work smoothly in a desktop browser so attendees can sort it out from their computer.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用让人们可以报名参加新书发布会的活动并提前选择座位，因为要早到才能抢个好座位真的特别不方便。应用应该显示一个简单的会场平面图，座位标明有没有人占，参加者点一个座位来选它，然后填入名字和邮箱来确认。整个过程应该在桌面浏览器里完美运行，这样参加者可以在自己的电脑上就搞定这些。

corpus_topic: advance press screening reservation site for film critics
query_text: Need a website where film critics can reserve a seat at an advance press screening without having to wait for someone to manually confirm their spot by email. Critics should be able to log in, see a list of upcoming screenings with dates and venues, pick one, choose a seat if there's a seating chart, and submit their reservation. The app should run in a browser and show the confirmation clearly so the critic can plan their schedule without the usual back-and-forth.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站，让影评人可以预留电影试映会的座位，而不用等某个人手工发邮件确认他们的位置。影评人应该能登录，看到即将放映的电影列表带上日期和地点，选一个，如果有座位图的话选择一个座位，然后提交预留。应用应该在浏览器里运行，清楚地显示确认信息这样影评人就能不用来回确认而计划好自己的日程了。

corpus_topic: radio talk show guest booking and briefing platform
query_text: Build a web app for managing radio talk show guest bookings and sending each guest their briefing notes ahead of the recording, because right now the producer is doing all of it manually over email and things keep slipping through the cracks. The app should let the producer add a guest, set the recording date and topic, and attach briefing notes that the guest can read in the browser. Guests should also be able to confirm their slot so both sides know everything is locked in.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用来管理电台谈话节目嘉宾的预约，还要能提前给每个嘉宾发送他们的简报，因为现在制作人在邮件里手工处理这一切，东西一直在丢失。应用应该让制作人可以添加嘉宾、设定录制日期和话题、附加嘉宾可以在浏览器里看的简报。嘉宾也应该能确认他们的时间段这样双方都知道一切都定好了。

corpus_topic: documentary preview screening ticket reservation site
query_text: Make a website where people can reserve a ticket to a documentary preview screening without the organizer having to manually track RSVPs in a spreadsheet. Visitors should be able to see a list of upcoming screenings, click one to see the description and available seats, enter their name and email to claim a spot, and get a confirmation number. The whole booking flow should work from a desktop browser and make it obvious how many seats are still open.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网站，让人们可以预留纪录片试映会的票，这样活动组织者就不用手工在电子表格里追踪回复了。访客应该能看到即将举行的试映列表，点一个看描述和有多少座位，输入名字和邮箱来占个位置，然后得到一个确认号。整个预约流程应该在桌面浏览器里完成，要清楚地显示还有多少座位是空着的。

corpus_topic: magazine cover photoshoot scheduling portal for featured talent
query_text: Create a web app for scheduling magazine cover photoshoots between the editorial team and the featured talent, because right now confirming a shoot date takes forever with everyone emailing back and forth. The talent or their rep should be able to log in, see the open shoot dates and location details, pick a time slot that works, and confirm it so the editorial calendar gets updated right away. Everything should run in a desktop browser so the team can check the schedule from their office computers.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来安排杂志封面拍摄的时间，在编辑团队和被拍者之间协调，因为现在确认一个拍摄日期要花很久，大家得来回邮件。被拍者或他们的代理应该能登录，看到开放的拍摄日期和地点信息，选一个合适的时间段，确认后这样编辑日历就能立刻更新。所有这些应该在桌面浏览器里运行，这样团队可以在办公室电脑上查看日程。

corpus_topic: manuscript review appointment booking site for aspiring authors
query_text: A web app for aspiring authors to book a manuscript review appointment with a professional editor, where the author can browse available reviewers, see their specialties and open time slots, and claim a spot with a short description of their manuscript. The app should work in a desktop browser and give the author a clear confirmation once the appointment is set, so they know exactly when to expect feedback and who will be reading their work.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，有抱负的作者可以预约一个专业编辑的稿件评阅，作者可以浏览可用的评阅人，看他们的专长和开放时间段，然后占个位置并留一个简短的稿件描述。应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行，给作者一个清楚的确认这样他们就准确知道什么时候会有反馈和谁会读他们的作品了。

corpus_topic: literary agent one-on-one meeting scheduler at book fairs
query_text: Make a web app that lets writers schedule a one-on-one meeting with a literary agent at a book fair, because right now figuring out who's available and grabbing a slot involves way too much running around or emailing. Writers should be able to see a list of agents attending the fair, view each agent's open meeting slots, claim a time, and add a short pitch note. The app should work from a desktop browser so writers can plan it all out before they even arrive at the event.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用让作家可以在书展上和文学经纪人预约一对一见面，因为现在搞清楚谁可用还要去抢位置涉及太多跑来跑去或邮件往来。作家应该能看到参展的经纪人列表，查看每个经纪人的开放见面时间段，占个时间，加上一个简短的宣传稿便签。应用应该能在桌面浏览器里运行这样作家甚至在去活动现场前就能计划好所有这些。

corpus_topic: interactive science explainer archive with concept quizzes
query_text: Make a web app that works as an interactive science explainer archive where each topic has a clear written explanation and a short concept quiz at the end so I can check whether I actually understood it. I want to be able to browse topics by subject area, mark the ones I've finished, and see my quiz scores saved so I know which areas I still need to review. The whole thing should run in a desktop browser and keep my progress organized across sessions.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用作为一个互动科学解释档案库，每个话题都有清楚的书面说明和最后一个简短的概念测验，这样我可以检查自己是否真的理解了。我想要能按学科浏览话题，标记已完成的，看到我的测验分数被保存下来这样我知道哪个领域还需要复习。整个应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行，在多个会话中保持我的进度井井有条。

corpus_topic: investigative journalism methodology learning portal
query_text: Build a web app that serves as a learning portal for investigative journalism methods, with lessons organized into clear topics like source verification, document research, and interview techniques. I want each lesson to have readable text and a short practice exercise, and I want to be able to track which lessons I've completed so I always know where I left off. The app should run in a browser for desktop so I can work through it properly on my computer with enough screen space to read and take notes.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用作为调查性新闻方法的学习门户，课程按话题整理得清清楚楚，比如消息来源验证、文件研究和采访技巧。我想要每节课有可读的文本和一个简短的实践练习，我想要能追踪我完成了哪些课程这样我总是知道我在哪儿停下的。应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行这样我可以在我的电脑上好好推进，有足够的屏幕空间来阅读和记笔记。

corpus_topic: annotated historical newspaper digitization and research platform
query_text: Need a web app that lets researchers browse a collection of digitized historical newspapers, read scanned pages with annotations that explain the context, and save notes on articles they find interesting. I want to be able to search by date range or keyword, see a list of results on the left and the full page with annotations on the right, and keep a personal reading list of articles I want to come back to. The app should be browser-based and comfortable to use on a desktop.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用让研究人员可以浏览一个数字化历史报纸的集合，读扫描的页面并有注释解释背景，还能保存他们发现的有意思的文章的笔记。我想要能按日期范围或关键词搜索，左边看结果列表，右边看完整的页面加注释，还想要保持一个个人阅读清单，记下我想再回顾的文章。应用应该是基于浏览器的，在桌面上使用很舒服。

corpus_topic: data journalism tutorial and project showcase hub
query_text: Make a web app that serves as a learning hub for data journalism, with a library of tutorials organized by skill level, plus a section where completed student projects are displayed so readers can see real examples of the techniques in action. I want to be able to work through a tutorial, check off steps as I go, and then browse the project gallery to see what others have made. The site should run in a desktop browser with a clear left-side list of tutorials and a main reading area on the right.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用作为数据新闻的学习中心，有一个按技能等级整理的教程库，加上一个区域展示已完成的学生项目这样读者能看到真实的技巧应用例子。我想要能推进一个教程，边走边勾掉步骤，然后浏览项目画廊看别人做了什么。网站应该在桌面浏览器里运行，左边是清晰的教程列表，右边是主要阅读区域。

corpus_topic: editorial writing craft masterclass and feedback site
query_text: Make a web app that teaches editorial writing craft through a series of masterclass lessons, where I can read each lesson, submit a short writing sample at the end, and get feedback from an instructor or reviewer. I want the lessons to be grouped by topic, like structure, voice, and editing, and I want to see my submitted work alongside any comments so I can track what I've improved on. The app should work in a desktop browser so there's enough room to read and write comfortably.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用通过一系列大师班课程来教编辑写作的手艺，我可以读每一课，最后提交一个简短的写作样本，然后从讲师或评阅人那里得到反馈。我想要课程按话题分组，像结构、风格和编辑这样的，我想要看到我提交的作品和任何评论这样我可以追踪自己改进了什么。应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行这样有足够空间来舒服地阅读和写作。

corpus_topic: fact-checking workflow guide and newsroom practice tool
query_text: A browser-based fact-checking practice tool for newsroom training, where users can work through a step-by-step guide to verifying a story, with each step clearly labeled and a place to record what sources you checked and what you found. The tool should include a set of practice claims to fact-check, a checklist of verification steps to follow, and a summary at the end showing which steps were completed. It should be designed for desktop use so it fits comfortably alongside other browser tabs during a real research session.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个基于浏览器的事实检查练习工具用于新闻编辑室培训，用户可以按步骤指南推进故事验证，每一步都清楚地标出，还有地方记录你检查了什么消息来源和发现了什么。工具应该包括一套事实检查的练习主张，一个要遵循的验证步骤核对表，还有最后显示哪些步骤完成了的总结。它应该是为桌面使用设计的这样在真实的研究会话中能舒服地和其他浏览器标签页并行使用。

corpus_topic: long-form narrative reading room with author annotations
query_text: Build a web app that works as a long-form narrative reading room where each piece has the author's own annotations showing up in the margins or alongside the text, explaining choices they made or giving extra context. I want to be able to read an article or essay, click on an annotation to expand it, and bookmark pieces I want to finish later. The app should be designed for desktop browsers so there's enough width to show the main text and the author notes side by side without crowding.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用作为一个长文章阅读室，每篇文章都有作者自己的注释显示在边栏或文本旁边，解释他们做的选择或给额外的背景。我想要能读一篇文章或随笔，点一个注释来展开它，还能收藏我想之后看完的文章。应用应该为桌面浏览器设计这样有足够的宽度在左右两边显示主文本和作者笔记而不显得拥挤。

corpus_topic: media literacy curriculum portal for classroom educators
query_text: Build a web app that gives classroom educators a complete media literacy curriculum portal, with lessons grouped by grade level, downloadable activity guides, and a place to track which units have been taught. I want to be able to browse the full curriculum by topic or grade, open a lesson to read the learning goals and suggested activities, and mark it as done once I've used it in class. The app should work in a desktop browser since teachers are usually planning on a computer, and a sidebar for navigation would keep things easy to find.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用给课堂教育工作者一个完整的媒体素养课程门户，课程按年级分组，有可下载的活动指南，还有地方追踪哪些单元已经被教了。我想要能按话题或年级浏览完整的课程，打开一课来读学习目标和建议活动，用完后标记为已完成。应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行因为老师通常在电脑上计划，一个侧栏导航会让找东西容易得多。

corpus_topic: photojournalism ethics and technique learning library
query_text: Make a web app that works as a learning library for photojournalism, covering both the technical side like camera settings and composition and the ethics side like consent and sensitive subjects. I want the topics organized into clear categories so I can go straight to what I need, read an article or watch an embedded video, and save the ones I want to review again. The app should run in a desktop browser with a topic list on one side and the content on the other so I can browse and read without losing my place.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用作为摄影新闻学的学习库，涵盖技术方面像相机设置和构图和伦理方面像同意和敏感题材。我想要话题整理成清晰的类别这样我可以直接去我需要的地方，读一篇文章或看一个嵌入的视频，保存那些我想再复习的。应用应该在桌面浏览器里运行，一边是话题列表，另一边是内容这样我可以浏览和阅读而不会丢失我的位置。

corpus_topic: economics concepts explainer series with curated reading lists
query_text: Make a web app for learning economics concepts, where each concept has its own explainer and a curated list of books and articles to read next, so I can work through topics one by one in a clear order, mark which ones I have finished, and see the reading list for each concept laid out neatly on the side without having to go hunting for related materials myself.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用来学习经济学概念，每个概念都有它自己的讲解和一个策展的下面可以读的书和文章的列表，这样我可以按清晰的顺序一个接一个地推进话题，标记哪些我已经完成，看每个概念的阅读清单整齐地排在一边而不用自己去找相关资料。

corpus_topic: climate reporting deep-dive explainer and resource portal
query_text: Build a browser-based tool for climate reporting that covers major topics like emissions, policy, and extreme weather, where each topic has a detailed explainer followed by a checked list of reliable resources such as data sources, key reports, and recommended reads, so I can go through each area methodically, check off what I have looked at, and always know what to read next.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个基于浏览器的工具用于气候报道，覆盖主要话题像排放、政策和极端天气，每个话题都有一个详细的讲解跟着一个核对清单列出可靠的资源像数据来源、关键报告和推荐读物，这样我可以按方法推进每个领域，勾掉我看过的，总是知道接下来读什么。

corpus_topic: podcast transcript library with structured study guides
query_text: Create a web app that stores podcast transcripts in a library and pairs each episode with a structured study guide, so I can open a transcript on one side, follow along with the key points and questions on the other side, mark episodes as studied, and keep a list of episodes I still need to work through, all in the desktop browser where there is enough room for both panes.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用把播客文字稿存在一个库里，每一集配上一个结构化的学习指南，这样我可以一边打开文字稿，一边照着关键点和问题推进，标记已学过的集数，保持一个我还需要推进的集数列表，所有这些都在桌面浏览器里有足够的空间给两个面板。

corpus_topic: documentary companion learning and discussion resource site
query_text: Need a web app that works as a companion resource for documentaries, where each film has its own learning guide with key topics, background reading, and a space for discussion notes, so my friends and I can look up a documentary we just watched, go through the listed resources together, and keep track of which ones we have already explored and which ones are still on the list.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用作为纪录片的伴侣资源，每部电影都有它自己的学习指南，有关键话题、背景阅读和一个讨论笔记的空间，这样我和我的朋友们可以查一部我们刚看的纪录片，一起推进列出的资源，追踪我们已经探索过的和还在清单上的。

corpus_topic: 读者俱乐部
query_text: Build a reader's club web app where members can pick a book each month, chat about what they thought, and recommend their next read to the group, and it would be great if people could post short reviews and vote on the next book together, since right now we are doing all of this through a group chat and it gets really messy to follow along on a desktop.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个读书会网页应用，成员可以每月选一本书，聊聊他们的想法，向小组推荐下一本读什么，人们可以发短书评还能一起投票选下一本书，因为现在我们都在群聊里做这些事，特别难跟上进度，我想在桌面上有个更清楚的地方。

corpus_topic: Collaborative fact-checking portal for news article readers
query_text: Create a web app where people can read a news article and then leave fact-check notes on specific claims, like flagging something as verified or questionable with a short reason, so readers can help each other figure out what is actually true, and anyone can browse all the community notes on that article in one place, kind of like a shared margin for the whole internet to write in.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用让人们可以读一篇新闻文章然后在具体的主张上留事实检查笔记，像标记某个东西为已验证或有问题并加一个简短的原因，这样读者可以互相帮助搞清楚什么才是真的，任何人都可以在一个地方浏览这篇文章上的所有社区笔记，有点像整个互联网的共享页边空白来写东西。

corpus_topic: Crowdsourced source tip board for investigative journalists
query_text: Create a web app that works like a shared tip board where ordinary people can post story leads and source suggestions for investigative journalists, so reporters can browse incoming tips sorted by topic, mark ones they are looking into, and the community can upvote tips they think are worth chasing, all running in the browser so it is easy to use from a desktop computer.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，工作得像一个共享提示板，普通人可以发布故事线索和调查性记者的消息来源建议，记者可以按话题浏览进来的提示，标记他们在追查的那些，社区可以给他们觉得值得追的提示点赞，所有这些都在浏览器里运行这样在桌面电脑上很容易使用。

corpus_topic: Monthly reading challenge leaderboard for magazine subscribers
query_text: Build a web app for a monthly reading challenge where magazine subscribers can log how many articles they read each month, see how they rank against other members on a leaderboard, and cheer each other on, so there is a little friendly competition going on and people feel motivated to actually open the issues they keep meaning to get to, all accessible from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用用于月度阅读挑战，杂志订阅者可以记录他们每月读了多少篇文章，看他们在排行榜上和其他成员的排名怎么样，还能互相加油，这样会有一点友好的竞争，人们会更有动力去打开他们一直想读的期刊，所有这些都可以从桌面浏览器访问。

corpus_topic: Licensed novel series fan fiction archive and rating site
query_text: A fan fiction archive site for a specific licensed novel series, running as a web app in the browser, where fans can post their own stories set in that world, rate and comment on each other's work, and browse by story length or rating, so the whole community has one tidy place to share writing instead of scattering it across random forums.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个特定授权小说系列的粉丝文库网站，在浏览器里作为网页应用运行，粉丝可以发布他们自己在那个世界背景下的故事，对彼此的作品评分和评论，按故事长度或评分浏览，这样整个社区可以有一个整洁的地方分享写作而不是散在随机的论坛里。

corpus_topic: Literary magazine subscriber article annotation and discussion platform
query_text: Make a web app for literary magazine subscribers where they can highlight passages in any article and leave their own notes or reactions right there in the text, then see what other subscribers have written in the same spot, so reading becomes more like a shared conversation rather than a solo activity, and you can browse the most discussed articles to see where the good debates are happening.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用给文学杂志的订阅者，他们可以在任何文章里高亮段落，在文本的那个地方留下自己的笔记或反应，然后看其他订阅者在同一个地方写了什么，这样阅读变成更像一个共享的谈话而不是一个孤独的活动，你可以浏览最多讨论的文章看看哪里有好的辩论在进行。

corpus_topic: Podcast episode community transcript crowdsourcing site
query_text: Need a web app where fans can help write out transcripts for podcast episodes together, so one person starts a chunk and someone else picks up where they left off, and when a transcript is done it gets published for everyone to read and search, since a lot of my favorite shows have no transcripts at all and it would be so useful to have them on desktop where I can actually type comfortably.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用让粉丝可以一起帮忙写播客集数的文字稿，一个人开始一个段落，下一个人从他们停的地方继续，文字稿完成后就被发布给大家读和搜索，因为我很多最喜欢的节目都没有文字稿，在桌面上有他们会很有用，我可以真正舒服地打字。

corpus_topic: Newsletter writer cross-promotion and audience sharing hub
query_text: Build a web app that helps newsletter writers find each other and team up on cross-promotions, so you can create a profile for your newsletter, browse others writing in a similar space, and send a simple request to swap shoutouts or do a joint feature, since right now finding good partners means posting in random communities and hoping someone relevant sees it, which takes forever.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用帮助新闻通讯作者互相找到彼此并在交叉推广上合作，这样你可以为你的通讯创建一个资料，浏览在相似领地写作的其他人，送一个简单的请求来互换推荐或做一个联合功能，因为现在找好伙伴意味着在随机社区发帖然后希望某个相关的人看到，太费时间了。

corpus_topic: Academic journal open peer review discussion board
query_text: Need a web app where researchers and readers can openly comment on academic journal papers, like leaving questions or pointing out concerns for the whole community to see, so peer review is not just something that happens behind closed doors before publication but something the broader audience can also take part in, and anyone reading the paper can follow the ongoing discussion right there on the same page.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用让研究人员和读者可以公开评论学术期刊论文，像留下问题或指出整个社区看得到的担忧，这样同行评审不是只有发表前的秘密过程，而是更广的受众也可以参与的东西，任何读论文的人可以跟着进行中的讨论就在同一个页面上。

corpus_topic: Local news citizen reporter onboarding and credential portal
query_text: Create a web app that walks everyday people through signing up as local news contributors, where they can set up a profile, learn what kinds of stories the outlet covers, submit a short writing sample to get a basic credential, and then get matched with a local editor, since right now there is no clear way for someone to just show up and start helping their neighborhood news site.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用引导普通人完成注册为本地新闻的投稿者，他们可以建立一个资料，学习媒体覆盖什么样的故事，提交一个简短的写作样本来获得基本的凭证，然后和一个本地编辑配对，因为现在没有清楚的办法让某个人只是出现并开始帮助他们的社区新闻网站。

corpus_topic: Serialized fiction reader voting and story direction platform
query_text: Make a web app for serialized fiction where readers can vote on what happens next in the story between chapters, so the author posts a couple of choices at the end of each installment and the community picks the direction, and readers can see how the votes are going in real time and leave a short comment explaining their choice, all of this working nicely on desktop with the story on one side and the voting area on the other.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用用于连载小说，读者可以对故事下一步发生什么投票，作者在每一部分的结尾发布几个选项，社区选择方向，读者可以看到投票进度的实时情况并留下一个简短的评论解释他们的选择，所有这些在桌面上工作得很好，一边是故事，另一边是投票区域。

corpus_topic: Magazine photo archive community caption and tagging site
query_text: Build a web app for a magazine photo archive where the community can write captions for old photos and add labels describing what is in each one, so the photos get properly described over time and anyone can search by a label to find related images, since old magazine archives are full of amazing pictures that are completely unsearchable because nobody ever wrote down what is in them.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用用于一个杂志照片档案库，社区可以给旧照片写说明和添加描述每个照片里有什么的标签，这样随着时间照片被适当地描述，任何人可以按标签搜索来找相关图像，因为旧杂志档案库里有这么多神奇的图片，因为没人写下里面是什么，它们完全搜不到。

corpus_topic: Science journalism study recommendation and source community
query_text: Build a web app where science enthusiasts can share and vote on good science journalism pieces, recommend background reading for understanding the topic better, and discuss whether the original article got the science right, so the community builds up a reliable collection of well-sourced science writing that anyone can browse by topic from a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用让科学爱好者可以分享和投票好的科学新闻作品，推荐背景阅读来更好地理解话题，讨论原始文章是否把科学搞对了，这样社区建立了一个可靠的精致的科学写作集合，任何人可以从桌面浏览器按话题浏览。

corpus_topic: Editorial calendar management tool for newsrooms
query_text: Make a web app editorial calendar for a newsroom where editors can see all the stories coming up for the month laid out by date, assign each story to a writer, and update the status as pieces move from pitch to draft to published, so the whole team always knows what is in the pipeline without having to send status emails back and forth all day from their desktop browsers.
query_text_zh: 我想做一个网页应用编辑日历用于新闻编辑室，编辑可以看到本月所有即将发表的故事按日期排列，给每个故事分配给一个作者，当故事从宣传变为草稿再到发表时更新状态，这样整个团队总是知道管道里有什么而不用整天发状态邮件在他们的桌面浏览器里。

corpus_topic: Headline A/B testing dashboard for online publishers
query_text: Make a web app where an online publisher can write two different headline versions for the same article, run them against each other to see which one gets more clicks, and then look at a simple results summary to pick the winner, because right now I am just guessing which headlines work and I would really like an easy tool in the browser that shows me the numbers without making things complicated.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用让在线发行者可以为同一篇文章写两个不同的标题版本，互相对比看哪个得到更多点击，然后看一个简单的结果总结来选择赢家，因为现在我只是在猜哪些标题有效，我真的想要一个浏览器里的简单工具，显示数字而不把事情搞复杂。

corpus_topic: Press release writing and distribution platform
query_text: Need a web app for writing and sending out press releases, where I can type out the release using a simple template, fill in the contact details and embargo date, and then send it to a saved list of journalists with one click, because right now I am copying the same text into individual emails one by one and it takes way too long every single time I have an announcement to make.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来写和发送新闻稿，我可以用简单的模板写出稿件，填入联系方式和禁发日期，然后用一个点击发送给一个保存的记者列表，因为现在我把同样的文本复制到个别邮件里一个一个地做，每次我有新闻要发布时都太费时间了。

corpus_topic: Journalist source contact database and CRM
query_text: Need a web app that works as a contacts manager for journalists, where I can save each source with their beat, organization, phone, and email, add notes about past conversations, and search by topic so I can quickly find the right person to call when a story breaks, since my current system is a giant spreadsheet that I can never find anything in when I am actually on deadline.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用作为记者的联系人管理器，我可以保存每个消息来源的他们的版块、机构、电话和邮箱，添加过去谈话的笔记，按话题搜索这样当故事爆料时我可以快速找到正确的人来打，因为我现在的系统是一个巨大的电子表格，当我真的在赶截止日期时我永远找不到任何东西。

corpus_topic: Media kit builder for digital news brands
query_text: A media kit builder tool for a digital news brand, running in the browser on desktop, where you fill in your audience numbers, coverage topics, and ad formats, and the tool puts it all together into a clean one-pager you can share with potential advertisers, because right now putting together a media kit means manually updating a document every time anything changes and it is a real pain.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个媒体资料包生成工具用于一个数字新闻品牌，在浏览器里桌面上运行，你填入你的受众数字、覆盖话题和广告格式，工具把这一切整合成一个简洁的一页纸你可以和潜在的广告商分享，因为现在编制一个媒体资料包意味着每次任何东西改变时手工更新一个文档，真的很令人烦恼。

corpus_topic: Fact-checking workflow and verification tool for editors
query_text: Build a browser-based tool for editors who need to fact-check articles before publishing, where you can paste in a piece of writing, flag each claim that needs verification, add a note with the source you used to check it, and mark it as confirmed or still pending, so the whole verification process is tracked in one place and nothing slips through because someone forgot to follow up on a tricky line.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个基于浏览器的工具用于需要在发表前事实检查文章的编辑，你可以粘贴一篇写作，标记每个需要验证的主张，加一个用来检查它的消息来源的笔记，标记为已确认或仍待确认，这样整个验证过程在一个地方被追踪，没有东西漏掉因为某个人忘了跟进一个棘手的句子。

corpus_topic: News wire feed monitoring and alert dashboard
query_text: A news wire monitoring app in the browser that pulls in live updates from multiple feeds and lets you set up keyword alerts so you get a highlighted notification the moment a story about your beat shows up, with all incoming items listed in real time on the left and the full text of whatever you click on loading on the right, so I can stop refreshing five different sites just to stay on top of breaking news.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个浏览器里的新闻通讯监测应用，从多个信息源拉进实时更新，让你设置关键词提醒这样当一个关于你的版块的故事出现时你会得到一个高亮的通知，所有进来的项目在左边实时列出，你点的任何东西的全文在右边加载，这样我可以停止刷新五个不同的网站只是为了跟上突破性新闻。

corpus_topic: Freelance byline portfolio tracker for journalists
query_text: Create a web app tracker for freelance journalists to log every article they publish, with fields for the outlet name, publication date, topic, and payment status, so they can see their full byline history in one list and quickly check which pieces have been paid and which are still outstanding, because keeping track of all of this in a notebook is just not working anymore when you are juggling multiple outlets at once.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用追踪工具用于自由记者来记录他们发表的每一篇文章，有信息栏用于刊物名称、发表日期、话题和付款状态，这样他们可以在一个列表里看到他们的完整署名历史，快速检查哪些文章已经付款，哪些还待结算，因为当你一次处理多个媒体时在笔记本里追踪所有这些就根本不工作了。

corpus_topic: Podcast transcript editing and publishing tool
query_text: Create a web app that takes raw podcast recordings and turns the spoken words into editable text so I can fix the awkward pauses and filler words before posting it anywhere, because right now I am copying and pasting stuff from three different places and it is a total mess, and I want to be able to clean up the transcript and then hit one button to publish it to my podcast feed without touching a single other tool.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，可以把播客录音转换成可编辑的文本，这样我可以修掉那些生硬的停顿和填充词，然后直接一键发布到我的播客频道，不用再在三个不同的地方复制粘贴东西，也不用碰其他任何工具。

corpus_topic: Newsletter audience analytics dashboard for media brands
query_text: Need a web app that shows me in one place how many people are actually opening my newsletter each week, which links they click, whether new readers are signing up or old ones are leaving, and a simple view of whether the paying subscriber count is going up or down, because right now I am hunting through four different spreadsheets to piece together the same basic numbers every Monday morning.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，能在一个地方看到我的通讯每周有多少人打开，他们点了哪些链接，是不是有新的订阅者或者老的退订了，以及付费用户数量是在增加还是减少，因为现在我得翻四个不同的电子表格，每个周一早上都要整理一遍这些基本数据。

corpus_topic: Story pitch submission tracker for editorial teams
query_text: Need a web app for tracking story pitches from writers so the whole editorial team stops losing submissions in email threads, where someone can submit a pitch with a short summary and the editors can leave notes and move it through stages like received, reviewing, approved, or rejected, and everyone on the team sees the same current status without having to ask in a group chat.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用来管理编辑部收到的故事投稿，这样我们就不用在邮件里丢投稿了，投稿者可以提交一个简短的摘要，编辑可以留评论，把投稿在已收到、审核中、已批准或已拒绝这些阶段之间移动，团队里每个人都能看到最新的状态，不用在群聊里问来问去。

corpus_topic: Paywall metering and subscriber conversion dashboard
query_text: Create a web app that shows me which articles on my site have a metered paywall stopping readers and how many of those readers actually end up subscribing, so I can tell whether the wall is set too tight or too loose, because right now I have no idea if readers are bouncing off the paywall angry or if they are converting fine and I am just guessing when I tweak the free article limit.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，能看我网站上哪些文章被付费墙拦住了，有多少被拦住的读者最后订阅了，这样我能判断付费墙的限制是太严还是太松，因为现在我完全不知道读者是气炸了退出还是转换得很好，我改免费文章限制的时候全是瞎猜。

corpus_topic: Breaking news push notification composer for publishers
query_text: Need a web app where I can write a short breaking news alert, pick which audience or topic segment gets it, preview exactly how it will look on someone's phone before sending, and then send it in one click, because right now writing a notification means logging into three different systems and I always forget a step and the alert goes out with a typo or to the wrong group.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，我可以写一条突发新闻通知，选择发给哪个用户或话题类别，在发送前预览一下在手机上看起来是什么样子，然后一键发送，因为现在写一条通知要登三个不同的系统，我总是漏掉某个步骤，导致通知发出去的时候要么有打字错误，要么发给了错误的人群。

corpus_topic: 建筑/古迹站
query_text: Create a website for a historical architecture and landmark destination that feels like flipping through a beautifully printed coffee table book in a browser, where each building gets its own full-screen photograph and a little written story beside it, the whole thing moves slowly and deliberately like it respects the age of the places it is showing, and visitors on desktop can browse by era or material so the site itself feels like a piece of considered design rather than a directory.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网站，看起来就像在浏览器里翻一本精美的建筑咖啡桌书，每个建筑都有全屏照片和旁边的故事介绍，整个体验慢而庄重，就像在尊重那些建筑的年纪，桌面访客可以按时代或建筑材料来浏览，网站本身看起来就像经过精心设计的艺术品，而不仅仅是一个目录。

corpus_topic: 宗教场所站
query_text: Create a website for a religious site or place of worship that carries a sense of quietness and reverence the moment someone opens it in their browser, where the photography is generous and unhurried, the written descriptions feel thoughtful rather than rushed, and someone visiting on a desktop computer can navigate by the different areas of the site or the history of the building without the whole thing feeling like a tourist brochure.
query_text_zh: 我需要建一个宗教场所的网站，打开的一瞬间就能感受到那种安静和虔诚的氛围，照片要够大够充分，文字描述要有思想性而不是匆匆了事，桌面访客可以按不同区域或建筑历史来导航，整个网站不应该像一个旅游宣传册。

corpus_topic: public library system digital collections showcase
query_text: A website for a public library's digital collections where the feeling is warm and a little scholarly at the same time, like a reading room you can walk through in your browser, with large previews of manuscripts and photographs and printed materials organized so a visitor on desktop can browse by subject or time period, and the whole site has the kind of quiet confidence that makes you want to linger rather than skim.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个公共图书馆数字馆藏的网站，感觉温暖又有点学术气质，就像在浏览器里漫步在一个阅览室里，手稿、照片和印刷品都用大尺寸预览，桌面访客可以按主题或时期来浏览，整个网站有那种宁静的自信，让你想逗留而不是快速扫一眼。

corpus_topic: national archive digital exhibit portal
query_text: A website for a national archive's digital exhibits that feels like stepping into a grand reading room through your desktop browser, where historical documents and photographs are displayed with real breathing room around them and a gentle sense of discovery, so someone browsing can move from one era or collection to the next and feel like they are exploring something curated with genuine care rather than just clicking through a filing system.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个国家档案馆数字展品的网站，就像通过桌面浏览器走进一个宏伟的阅读厅，历史文献和照片周围有充足的空间，有温柔的发现感，浏览的人可以在不同年代或馆藏之间移动，感觉像是在探索经过精心策划的东西，而不仅仅是在点击一个文件系统。

corpus_topic: performing arts center season and history showcase
query_text: Create a website for a performing arts center that shows off both the current season and the rich history of the venue, where the photography feels cinematic and the whole experience in a desktop browser has the atmosphere of a well-designed program booklet, with a way to browse past productions and read about the building itself so that visitors come away feeling like they have discovered something with real cultural weight.
query_text_zh: 我需要建一个表演艺术中心的网站，既展示当前的演出季，也展示场地的丰富历史，照片要有电影感，整个桌面浏览体验要像一本设计精良的节目册，能浏览以前的制作和了解建筑本身，访客离开时应该感觉自己发现了有真正文化分量的东西。

corpus_topic: city symphony orchestra official website
query_text: Build a website for a city symphony orchestra that feels serious and beautiful at the same time when opened in a desktop browser, where upcoming concerts and the orchestra's history are presented with the same care you would expect from a printed season brochure, the typography feels chosen rather than defaulted, and someone visiting can move from current performances to the ensemble's story and background without the site ever feeling rushed or cluttered.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个城市交响乐团的网站，在桌面浏览器里看起来既庄重又漂亮，即将上演的音乐会和乐团历史要用印刷季度册一样的用心来呈现，字体选择要刻意而不是默认的，访客可以在当前演出和乐团故事之间移动，网站从来不会显得仓促或杂乱。

corpus_topic: national park visitor information and heritage site
query_text: Create a website for a national park visitor information and heritage site that has the unhurried, wide-open feeling of the landscape itself when someone opens it in a desktop browser, where full-width landscape photographs do most of the storytelling and the written information about trails and history and ecology sits beside the imagery without competing with it, and the overall tone feels like a beautifully made guidebook rather than a government form.
query_text_zh: 我需要建一个国家公园游客信息和遗产网站，打开时有景观本身那样的从容、开放的感觉，全宽度的风景照片做了大部分的讲述工作，关于步道、历史和生态的文字信息坐在图像旁边而不是与之竞争，整个语气感觉像一本精心制作的导游手册，而不像政府表格。

corpus_topic: indigenous peoples cultural heritage documentation site
query_text: Build a website for documenting indigenous peoples' cultural heritage that carries genuine visual weight and respect, where the photography and oral histories and material culture are presented in a desktop browser with real care for how things are laid out and the pace at which a visitor encounters them, the color and texture of the design feel drawn from the culture being documented rather than from a generic template, and browsing it feels like an act of attention rather than a quick scroll.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个记录少数民族文化遗产的网站，兼具真正的视觉分量和尊重，照片、口头历史和物质文化在桌面浏览器中用心呈现，版面和访客遇见东西的节奏都经过精心设计，设计中的颜色和质感来自被记录的文化而不是通用模板，浏览这个网站感觉像是一种专注的行为，而不是快速滑动。

corpus_topic: UNESCO world heritage site official portal
