query_text: A website for a UNESCO world heritage site's official portal that opens in a desktop browser and immediately communicates grandeur through generous photography and unhurried pacing, where each section of the site feels like a chapter in a well-edited book about the place, visitors can explore the significance, the history, and the current conservation efforts without the page ever feeling crowded, and the whole visual language says this place has been here for centuries and the site was designed to match.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个联合国教科文组织世界遗产地的官方网站，在桌面浏览器中打开就能通过宽裕的照片和从容的节奏立刻传达宏伟感，网站的每个部分都像一本关于这个地方的精编好的书的一个章节，访客可以探索它的意义、历史和当前的保护工作，页面从不显得拥挤，整个视觉语言说明这个地方已经存在几个世纪，网站被设计得匹配这一点。

corpus_topic: literary foundation and writers house website
query_text: Build a website for a literary foundation and writers house that has the feel of a beloved independent bookshop translated into a browser experience, where the typography is warm and the photography of the building and the writers who passed through it is generous and unhurried, someone on a desktop can browse the foundation's history and current residency programs and reading events, and the whole site has a personality that feels shaped by people who care about literature rather than people who care about website metrics.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个文学基金会和作家故居的网站，有独立书店被翻译成浏览器体验的感觉，字体温暖，建筑和曾经在这里的作家们的照片既宽裕又从容，桌面访客可以浏览基金会的历史、当前的驻地项目和阅读活动，整个网站有那种由真正关心文学的人而不是关心网站指标的人塑造的个性。

corpus_topic: national film archive and cinematheque showcase
query_text: Make a website for a national film archive and cinematheque that has the moody, considered feeling of a retrospective program booklet opened in a desktop browser, where film stills and poster art are given real space to breathe and the history of the collection is told with the kind of editorial voice you expect from a serious arts institution, and visitors can browse by director or decade or genre and feel like they are moving through a place that genuinely loves cinema.

corpus_topic: Cultural center venue rental reservation portal

query_text: Need a performing arts season ticket purchase website that makes it easy to see the full season schedule on desktop, compare what each ticket package covers, pick your seats or package tier, and pay without having to wade through a clunky old ticketing system that times out every five minutes and loses your cart.

corpus_topic: Nonprofit charity auction bidding platform
query_text: Make a nonprofit charity auction bidding web app that actually works without confusion, because every time our organization tries to run an auction we end up with people not knowing what they bid on or whether they won. corpus_topic: Government permit fee payment and processing portal
query_text: Build a web app for paying government permit fees and tracking where your application is in the process, because right now I have to call the office just to find out if they got my paperwork. corpus_topic: Cultural festival vendor booth reservation site
query_text: Make a website for reserving vendor booths at a cultural festival so people stop emailing back and forth forever trying to figure out what spots are still available. corpus_topic: Art workshop and masterclass registration portal
query_text: A page in the browser for signing up for art workshops and masterclasses where you can see all the upcoming sessions in one place, filter by type like painting or sculpture, pick a date that works for you, and just register and pay without being sent to three different sites. I always end up missing workshops because the registration process is buried somewhere or closes before I find it, so having everything in one browser-based spot would remove that whole hassle.

corpus_topic: Museum corporate event and private hire booking site

corpus_topic: Public library fine payment and account top-up portal

corpus_topic: museum timed-entry ticket booking portal

query_text_zh: 做一个在图书馆预订自习室的网站，这样就不用走到馆里才发现所有的房间都被占了，实在浪费时间。我想在浏览器里打开网站，看到一个房间网格显示容量和今天及本周哪些时间段有空，点击我想要的房间，输入图书馆卡号，确认预订，不用打电话给前台或等人手动批准。

corpus_topic: film archive screening room reservation portal

query_text_zh: 做一个电影档案馆私人放映室预订的网络门户，这样研究人员和电影爱好者就不用反复邮件往来才能去看某一个特定的版本。在网站上你选择日期，选择时间段，说明你想看哪部电影或哪个系列，提交预订，得到一个确认号。应该在普通的桌面浏览器上用，不用特殊软件，并且清楚地显示哪些时间段已经被占了。

corpus_topic: historic site photography permit booking platform

The whole thing should live in a browser and take maybe five minutes to complete.
query_text_zh: 做一个在历史遗迹申请拍摄许可证和付款的网站，因为现在的流程需要打印表格、邮寄然后祈祷它在你的拍摄日期前到达，简直荒唐。我想在电脑上打开网站，填入拍摄的细节，选择许可证类型，在线支付，然后得到一张数字许可证可以在手机上展示。整个过程应该在浏览器里进行，大概五分钟左右就完成。

I just want to remove the friction of booking something that should be simple.
query_text_zh: 做一个遗产建筑保护导览预订系统，这样历史爱好者就能报名而不用费力去翻那个又慢又有坏链接的政府网站。在浏览器里打开网站，看到即将举办的导览日程和每个地点的描述，选择日期和时间，输入来访人数，支付确认，收到邮件摘要。我就是想把原本应该很简单的预订流程中的那些繁琐部分都去掉。

query_text_zh: 做一个学校团体参观科学博物馆的预订网站，因为现在老师们得填纸质表格然后传真，特别浪费时间。网站应该让老师在桌面浏览器上登录，选择参观日期，输入学生数和年级，选择他们想参加的任何项目或展览，提交预订，得到确认然后转发给学校办公室，不用额外的步骤。

query_text_zh: 做一个食物银行志愿者班次报名网站，这样协调员就不用整个上午都在给大家发短信来填补日程空缺了。在网站上你能看到下周的班次及还剩多少个名额，点击你想要的班次，用你的名字和联系方式确认，在班次前会收到提醒。应该在普通的桌面浏览器上用，不用下载任何应用程序，也不用复杂的账户注册。

corpus_topic: community legal aid consultation booking site
query_text: Make a website for booking a free legal aid consultation with a community organization so people who need help can actually get an appointment without playing phone tag for a week. Nothing complicated, just a clean booking flow that works on a desktop computer.
query_text_zh: 做一个社区法律援助咨询预约的网站，这样需要帮助的人就能实际上预到约而不用花一周时间来回打电话确认。在浏览器里你能看到服务涵盖什么类型的法律问题，从一个简单的日历里选择可用的时间段，输入你的名字和简短的问题描述，提交，得到确认。不用太复杂，只要一个顺畅的预订流程在桌面电脑上用就行。

corpus_topic: animal shelter pet adoption meet-and-greet scheduler

On the site you browse available animals with a photo and short description, pick the one you want to meet, choose a date and time slot, enter your contact info, and confirm. The whole thing should work in a desktop browser and send you a reminder the day before.
query_text_zh: 做一个动物收容所相亲会预约的网站，这样想领养宠物的人能真正地与他们喜欢的宠物有一个合适的接触时间，而不是就来碰运气发现人太多。在网站上你浏览可用的动物，有照片和简短介绍，选择你想要见的那只，选择日期和时间段，输入你的联系方式，确认。整个过程应该在桌面浏览器上用，而且会在前一天给你发提醒。

It should also let me see which courses I have already signed up for in one view, and send a reminder before each session starts. A clean browser-based site that works well on a full desktop screen.
query_text_zh: 做一个列出所有开放课程的网站，这样我就能一个地方看到全部的课程和报名，不用在多个页面间搜寻。我想按科目浏览，看到每个课程的日程和时长，查看有没有空位，直接报名。它还应该让我在一个视图里看到我已经报了哪些课程，并在每个课程开始前给我发提醒。一个顺畅的基于浏览器的网站，在宽屏幕上效果很好。

corpus_topic: Civic transparency learning portal for local government
query_text: Create a web portal for civic transparency where regular people can learn how local government decisions are made, what public budgets are spent on, and how to get involved. query_text_zh: 做一个市政透明度网站，让普通人能了解地方政府如何做决策、公共预算花在哪里以及怎样参与其中。我想网站按话题如规划或开支来组织，能读到平实的解释，看到相关的会议记录或投票结果，弄清怎样才能提交意见或参加会议。应该是一个适配桌面浏览器的正式网站，有清晰的侧边栏和话题间的方便导航。

corpus_topic: Public library digital reading and skills hub
query_text: Build a web hub for a public library where people can find digital reading materials, sign up for online skills classes, and track what they are currently working through, all in one browser-based place. Should work well on a desktop browser with a proper layout rather than a tiny mobile view.
query_text_zh: 做一个公立图书馆的网络中心，让人们能找到数字阅读材料、报名在线技能课程、在一个浏览器网站里追踪他们在进行的学习，所有的事都在一个地方。我想要有一个阅读版块能搜索书籍、一个技能版块有计算机基础或求职申请之类的课程、一个可以给条目加书签的方式、以及一个简单的视图显示我正在读什么。应该在桌面浏览器上用着很顺利，而不是一个很小的移动视图。

query_text: Build a web app that lets me search the public library catalog, see what books are available at my branch, and request items from other libraries without having to call anyone or fill out a paper form. I want to log in, find what I need, put in a loan request, and get a confirmation, all from my desktop browser without any back-and-forth phone calls.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，让我能搜索公共图书馆目录、看我所在分馆有什么书，以及向其他图书馆要求借阅资料，都不用打电话或填纸质表格。我想登录、找到需要的东西、提交借阅请求、看到确认信息，这一切都在台式浏览器上完成，不用来回打电话。

corpus_topic: Volunteer opportunity matching platform for nonprofit organizations
query_text: Need a web app that matches me with volunteer opportunities at local nonprofits based on what I actually have time for and what kind of work I want to do, so I can stop scrolling through unrelated listings and wasting time on organizations that are not a good fit. It should show me options, let me express interest, and let the organization know I am available, all in one place on a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，能根据我实际有的空闲时间和想做的工作类型，给我推荐本地非营利组织的志愿者机会，这样我就不用不停地滚动无关的列表，浪费时间在不适合自己的组织上。它应该给我展示选项、让我表达兴趣、通知组织我有空参加，所有这些都在台式浏览器上的一个地方完成。

corpus_topic: Open government spending transparency and budget visualization dashboard
query_text: Make a web app that shows me how the government is actually spending public money in plain language and simple charts I can understand without needing to be an accountant. I want to look up a budget category, see where the money went, and compare it to other years, all in a browser on my desktop without downloading any spreadsheets or reading confusing PDFs.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，用浅白的语言和简单的图表给我展示政府实际在怎样花公共资金，我不用成为会计就能理解。我想查找某个预算项目、看钱花到哪里去了、对比其他年份的数据，所有这些都在台式浏览器上完成，不用下载任何电子表格或读复杂的PDF文件。

corpus_topic: Historical document OCR and public transcription crowdsourcing site
query_text: Build a browser-based tool where I can help transcribe old handwritten documents that have already been scanned, so volunteers like me can type out what we see and submit corrections for archivists to review. It should show me a document image on one side and a text box on the other so I can just work through it on my desktop without any complicated sign-up process or software to install.
query_text_zh: 做一个基于浏览器的工具，让我帮助转录那些已经扫描过的旧手写文档，像我这样的志愿者可以输入我看到的内容，提交给档案管理员审阅。它应该在一侧显示文档图像，另一侧显示文本框，这样我就能在台式浏览器上直接操作，不用经过复杂的注册过程或安装什么软件。

corpus_topic: Community arts funding directory and eligibility checker
query_text: Build a web app that helps artists and community groups find funding opportunities they actually qualify for, because right now you have to know the right people or spend hours searching random websites to figure out if any grants even apply to your project. I want to enter some basic details about my project and immediately see a list of funding sources that match, all in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，帮助艺术家和社区组织找到他们真正符合条件的资金机会，因为现在你要么得认识对的人，要么得花几小时在随机网站上搜索，才能搞清楚有哪些补助真的适用于你的项目。我想输入关于我项目的一些基本信息，立即看到符合条件的资金来源清单，所有这些都在台式浏览器上完成。

corpus_topic: Public records request submission and fulfillment tracking tool
query_text: Need a web app that lets me submit a public records request online and then actually track where it is in the process so I am not just sending an email into the void and wondering if anyone received it. It should show me a timeline of where my request stands, send me updates, and let me respond if they need more info, all accessible from a desktop browser without any phone calls required.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，能让我在网上提交公开记录请求，然后真的能追踪它在流程中的位置，这样我就不是在发送一封邮件到虚空中，不知道有没有人收到。它应该给我显示我的请求进展的时间轴、发送更新信息、让我在需要更多信息时能回复，所有这些都能从台式浏览器访问，不用打任何电话。

corpus_topic: Museum collection inventory and online loans management system
query_text: Create a web app for museums to keep track of their physical collection and manage loan requests when other institutions want to borrow items, because right now everything gets handled over email and nobody can tell at a glance what is out on loan versus what is in storage. The app should show the full inventory, let staff log loan agreements, and show current statuses for all items.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，让博物馆能追踪他们的物理收藏品，管理其他机构借用物品的请求，因为现在所有事情都是通过邮件处理的，没人能一眼看出哪些东西是在外借状态，哪些是在存储中。这个应用应该显示完整的库存清单、让员工记录借贷协议、显示所有物品的当前状态。

corpus_topic: Multilingual civic information translation and localization tool
query_text: Need a web app that takes official civic information like meeting notices or public health guidelines and produces clean translations in multiple languages so people in my community who do not read English well can actually understand what the government is telling them. I want to paste in a document, pick the target language, and get a readable translation right there in my desktop browser without any downloading.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，能把官方民众信息比如会议通知或公共卫生指南翻译成多种语言，这样社区中不太会英文的人能真正理解政府要告诉他们什么。我想粘贴一份文件、选择目标语言、在台式浏览器上立即得到可读的翻译，不用下载任何东西。

corpus_topic: 技术 Portfolio
query_text: Need a web app that works as a personal portfolio site where I can show off the little tools and projects I have built, with a clean layout that looks good on a desktop browser, and lets visitors see screenshots, read a short description of each thing, and maybe click through to try it live. I want something I can point people to instead of just sending them a bunch of random links.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用作为个人作品集网站，能展示我做过的那些小工具和项目，有个整洁的布局在台式浏览器上看起来很不错，让访问者能看截图、读每个项目的简短描述、也许能点击直接试用。我想要一个地方能指给别人，而不是只能发一堆随机的链接。

corpus_topic: 个人技术品牌
query_text: A personal brand site for a tinkerer type who wants to show the world what they are into and what they have made, with a home page that feels like a creative workspace rather than a boring resume. It should run in a desktop browser and have a short intro, a section for current projects, and a way for people to get in touch, all feeling like one cohesive thing rather than separate pages bolted together.
query_text_zh: 做一个个人品牌网站，给那种想向世界展示自己兴趣和创作的工匠型人物，有个首页看起来像个创意工作区而不是无聊的简历。它应该在台式浏览器上运行，有简短的自我介绍、一个展示当前项目的版块、还有个让人能联系你的方式，这一切看起来像是一个整体的东西，而不是一堆分散的页面拼在一起。

corpus_topic: Interactive developer résumé with live code playground
query_text: Make a web app that works as an interactive resume for someone who likes to tinker with code, where visitors can read about my background on one side and actually run little code examples right there in the same browser window without having to open anything else. I want it to feel alive and fun rather than just another flat list of job titles on a website.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用作为交互式简历，给喜欢钻研代码的人，访问者能在一侧读关于我的背景，在同样的浏览器窗口直接运行小代码例子，不用打开其他任何东西。我希望它看起来生动有趣，而不是只是另一个无趣的工作头衔列表。

corpus_topic: Engineering team culture and expertise showcase page
query_text: Need a web app that acts as a showcase for an engineering team, showing who is on the team, what everyone is good at, and what kinds of problems the group enjoys solving together, so that potential new teammates or collaborators can get a real feel for the culture before reaching out. It should look friendly and honest rather than like a corporate recruiting page, and work well in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用作为工程团队的展示，展示谁在团队里、每个人擅长什么、团队喜欢一起解决什么样的问题，这样潜在的新队友或合作者在联系之前能真实感受到团队文化。它应该看起来友好诚实，而不是像一个企业招聘页面，在台式浏览器上显示效果也要很好。

corpus_topic: Open-source contributor stats and leaderboard site
query_text: Need a web app that shows stats and rankings for people who contribute to open-source projects, so the community can see who has been putting in the most effort and in which areas. It should have a scoreboard showing top contributors, let you click into someone to see their contribution history, and feel motivating to look at when you open it in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用，展示为开源项目做贡献的人的统计数据和排名，这样社区能看到谁投入最多精力，在哪些领域做的。它应该有个显示顶级贡献者的计分板，能点击进某个人的页面看他们的贡献历史，在台式浏览器上打开时看起来很激励人心。

corpus_topic: Personal engineering blog with deep-dive case studies
query_text: Make a personal blog site for someone who likes to go really deep on technical topics, where each post can include lots of detail and walkthrough sections so readers can actually follow along with what happened on a project from start to finish. It should look clean in a desktop browser, be easy to read for long articles, and let me organize posts so people can find related ones easily.
query_text_zh: 做一个个人博客网站，给喜欢深入研究技术话题的人，每篇文章都能包含很多细节和讲解部分，这样读者能跟着从项目开始到结束的整个过程。它应该在台式浏览器上显示得整洁，长文章也容易阅读，让我能组织文章这样人们能容易地找到相关的内容。

corpus_topic: API showcase with live interactive endpoint explorer
query_text: Create a website where someone can browse all the endpoints of an API, read what each one does in plain terms, and actually try sending a request right there in the browser to see what comes back, without having to copy anything into a separate tool. It should be easy to explore even if you are just starting out and curious, and work well on a desktop browser with a clear layout.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站，让人能浏览API的所有端点，用浅白的语言读每个端点是做什么的，在浏览器里直接试着发送请求来看返回什么，不用复制东西到单独的工具里。即使你是刚开始学的人，也应该容易探索，在台式浏览器上运行也要有清晰的布局。

corpus_topic: Developer conference talk archive and video portfolio
query_text: A website that archives recorded talks from tech conferences and acts as a video portfolio for speakers, so visitors can browse by topic, find a talk, read a summary, and watch it right there in the browser without being sent somewhere else. It should work well on desktop with a clean layout that makes it easy to discover talks you did not know you wanted to watch.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站，存档技术会议的录制讲座，作为演讲者的视频作品集，访问者能按话题浏览、找到讲座、读总结、直接在浏览器里观看，不用被发到别的地方去。它应该在台式浏览器上运行良好，有整洁的布局，让人容易发现他们之前不知道想看的讲座。

corpus_topic: Tech stack visualization site for engineering teams
query_text: Need a website that shows what technologies an engineering team uses in a visual way, so people can see at a glance what the team's setup looks like and how different tools connect to each other, rather than reading a boring list. It should be browsable on a desktop browser, let you click on a tool to learn more about how the team uses it, and feel like a living map rather than a static document.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站，用可视化的方式展示工程团队使用的技术，这样人们能一眼看出团队的架构是什么样的、不同的工具怎样彼此连接，而不是读一个无聊的列表。它应该能在台式浏览器上浏览，让你能点击某个工具了解团队怎样使用它，看起来像是一张活的地图而不是静态文档。

corpus_topic: Hackathon project gallery with judges scores display
query_text: A web app for showcasing projects from a hackathon, where each project has its own entry with a description, the team behind it, and the scores or feedback it received from judges, so participants and visitors can browse everything in one place and see how projects were evaluated. It should look organized and work well on a desktop browser so people can easily explore all the entries.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来展示黑客马拉松的项目，每个项目都有自己的条目，包括描述、团队信息和从评委那里得到的分数或反馈，这样参赛者和访问者能在一个地方浏览所有东西，看到项目是怎样被评估的。它应该看起来井井有条，在台式浏览器上运行也要很好，这样人们能容易地探索所有条目。

corpus_topic: Generative code art gallery and creative coding showcase
query_text: Need a web gallery where people can browse and enjoy little art pieces that were made by code, like animations or patterns that a program generates, since right now these things get buried in GitHub repos and nobody actually sees them. It should load up in a desktop browser, let you click on a piece to see it run live, and show some info about how it was made without being too technical.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络画廊，让人能浏览和欣赏由代码生成的小艺术作品，比如动画或图案，因为现在这些东西都埋在GitHub仓库里，没人真正看得到。它应该在台式浏览器里加载，让你点击某个作品看它活动运行，显示一些关于它怎样做出来的信息，但不用太技术性。

corpus_topic: Developer tool product landing page with feature demos
query_text: Make a product landing page for a small developer tool that actually shows the tool in action so visitors can see what it does before they decide to try it, rather than just reading bullet points of features. It should work great in a desktop browser, have a clear main message at the top, walk through a couple of key things the tool does with live or animated examples, and make it easy to get started.
query_text_zh: 做一个小开发工具的产品登陆页，真正展示这个工具在运行中的样子，这样访问者能看到它能做什么，然后决定是否尝试，而不是只看功能的要点列表。它应该在台式浏览器上效果很好、顶部有清晰的主信息、通过一两个关键功能的演练用实时或动画的例子展示，让人容易开始使用。

corpus_topic: Side-project showcase site with live previews
query_text: Create a personal website for showing off side projects, where each project has a live preview that visitors can actually interact with right there on the page in their desktop browser without clicking away to a separate site. I want to be able to add new projects easily and have them show up in a nice browsable layout so the whole thing feels like a working playground, not just a list of screenshots.
query_text_zh: 做一个个人网站来展示副业项目，每个项目都有个实时预览，访问者能直接在页面上台式浏览器里与之交互，不用点击跳到单独的网站。我想能容易地加入新项目，让它们在整洁的可浏览布局中显示，这样整个东西看起来像个活的运动场，而不只是一个截图列表。

corpus_topic: Changelog
query_text: Make a web app that acts as a public changelog for a project, where I can log what changed in each version, add a date and a short description for each update, and let visitors browse through the history in their desktop browser so they always know what is new. It should be simple to update and feel readable rather than like looking at a raw commit log.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用作为项目的公开变更日志，我能记录每个版本的变化，为每个更新加上日期和简短描述，让访问者在台式浏览器里浏览历史记录，这样他们总是知道什么是新的。它应该很简单就能更新，看起来容易阅读，而不像看原始的提交日志。

corpus_topic: 技术周刊
query_text: Need a web app for putting together a weekly tech newsletter, where I can collect links and short notes throughout the week, arrange them into sections, and then publish the whole thing as a clean readable page that subscribers can browse in their desktop browser. It should make it easy to build up an issue gradually rather than having to write everything at once right before sending.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用来组织每周科技通讯，我能在整个星期收集链接和简短笔记、把它们整理成不同的部分，然后发布整个东西作为整洁可读的页面，订阅者能在台式浏览器里浏览。它应该让我能逐渐组建一期刊物，而不是要在最后一秒钟一次写完所有内容再发送。

corpus_topic: engineering team handbook and onboarding knowledge portal
query_text: Build a web app that works as an internal handbook and onboarding guide for an engineering team, where new people can find answers to common questions, read about how the team works, and get up to speed without having to bother someone every five minutes. It should be easy to update when things change, organized so you can find things quickly, and work well in a desktop browser for everyone on the team.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用作为工程团队的内部手册和入职指南，新人能找到常见问题的答案、读关于团队如何运作的资料、快速上手而不用每五分钟就去烦某个人。它应该很容易在事情改变时更新、组织得好找东西、在台式浏览器上对团队里的每个人都运行良好。

corpus_topic: architecture decision records browser for software teams
query_text: Build a web app for software teams to browse and keep track of all their architecture decision records, where you can search through past decisions by keyword or topic, see who made each call and when, and click into any record to read the full reasoning behind it, so nobody has to dig through old meeting notes or random docs to remember why the team went with a certain approach.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，让软件团队能浏览和追踪他们所有的架构决策记录，能通过关键字或话题搜索过往决策、看谁做的决定和什么时候做的、点进任何记录读完整的推理过程，这样没人用挖出老的会议记录或散布的文档就能记起团队为什么要采用某种方法。

corpus_topic: production incident post-mortem archive and reading site
query_text: Need a browser-based archive where the whole team can store and read through post-mortems from past production incidents, with each one showing what went wrong, what the timeline looked like, and what was done to fix it, plus a way to filter by date or affected area so you can actually learn from old incidents instead of repeating the same mistakes over again.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个基于浏览器的存档，整个团队能在里面存储和阅读以前生产事故的事后总结，每个总结都显示哪里出问题了、时间轴是什么样的、做了什么来修复，加上能按日期或受影响区域过滤的方式，这样你能从老事故学到东西，而不是重复犯同样的错误。

corpus_topic: step-by-step developer tutorial and walkthrough article hub
query_text: Create a website that works as a hub for step-by-step developer tutorials and walkthrough articles, where each tutorial is broken into numbered steps you can follow along with, has a topic label so readers can filter by what they want to learn, and shows an estimated reading time upfront so people know what they are getting into before they start.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站作为循序渐进的开发者教程和讲解文章的枢纽，每个教程都分成有编号的步骤你能跟着做，有话题标签让读者能按想学的东西过滤、一开始就显示预计阅读时间这样人们知道在开始前要花多久。

corpus_topic: API reference documentation reading portal for developers
query_text: Make a web app that works like a reading portal for API reference documentation, where the left side has a list of all the endpoints or topics you can click through, the right side shows the full details for whatever you selected, and there is a search bar at the top so you can jump straight to what you need without scrolling through everything.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用像API参考文档的阅读门户，左边有个你能点击浏览的所有端点或话题的列表、右边显示你选中的东西的完整细节、顶部有个搜索框这样你能直接跳到需要的东西，不用滚动通过所有内容。

corpus_topic: tech conference talk notes and speaker summary archive
query_text: Build a web app for keeping notes and summaries from tech conference talks, where each talk gets its own entry with the speaker name, the event it came from, and the main takeaways written out, and you can browse everything by conference or speaker so it is easy to go back and find that one talk you half-remember from a few months ago.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来记录和总结科技会议讲座的笔记，每个讲座都有自己的条目写上演讲者名字、讲座来自的活动、记录好的主要收获，能按会议或演讲者浏览所有东西这样容易回头找那个几个月前半记得的讲座。

corpus_topic: programming language specification annotated browser and reader
query_text: Build a browser-based reader for programming language specifications where you can load up the full spec text, add your own notes or highlights to specific sections, and jump between sections using a table of contents on the side, so when you are trying to understand a tricky language rule you can read it alongside your own annotations instead of losing your place every time.
query_text_zh: 做一个基于浏览器的编程语言规范阅读器，能加载完整的规范文本、在特定部分加上你自己的笔记或高亮、用侧边栏的目录在部分间跳转，这样当你试着理解某个复杂的语言规则时，能在读规范的同时看你自己的注释，而不是每次都要遗忘你的位置。

corpus_topic: security advisory and CVE digest site for developers
query_text: Need a website that collects and presents security advisories and known vulnerability notices in a readable format for developers, showing each one with a plain-language summary, the severity level, and which software versions are affected, plus a way to filter by category or date so you can keep up with what is relevant to the stuff you are actually working on.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网站，搜集和展示安全公告和已知漏洞通知，用容易理解的格式给开发者展示，每个都有简明的总结、严重程度等级、哪些软件版本受影响的信息，加上能按分类或日期过滤的方式，这样你能跟上与你实际在做的东西相关的内容。

corpus_topic: engineering scaling case study publication for startups
query_text: Create a web app that publishes engineering scaling case studies aimed at startups, where each case study walks through how a real company grew their system from small to large, the problems they ran into along the way, and how they solved them, with a sidebar that lets you filter by company size or the kind of scaling challenge so you can find stories that match what your team is dealing with.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用，发布面向初创公司的工程规模扩大案例研究，每个案例研究讲述一个真实公司怎样从小规模增长到大规模、途中遇到的问题和怎样解决的，侧边栏让你能按公司规模或规模扩大挑战的类型过滤，这样能找到与你的团队正在处理的情况相符的故事。

corpus_topic: developer podcast episode transcript and show notes library
query_text: Create a website that acts as a library for developer podcast episodes, where each episode has the full transcript you can read through plus the show notes and any links mentioned, and you can search by guest name or topic to find specific conversations, so it is way easier to reference something a guest said without having to scrub through the actual audio again.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站作为开发者播客集的库，每个集都有完整的文字稿你能读、加上节目说明和提到的任何链接，能按嘉宾名字或话题搜索找特定的对话，这样引用某位嘉宾说的话时容易得多，不用再回到音频里找。

corpus_topic: software system design pattern encyclopedia for engineers
query_text: Need a browser-based encyclopedia for software system design patterns aimed at engineers, where each pattern gets its own entry with a plain-language explanation of what problem it solves, a simple diagram showing how it works, and a list of related patterns you might also want to look at, so you can quickly look something up and actually understand it without wading through a textbook.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个基于浏览器的软件系统设计模式百科，针对工程师，每个模式都有自己的条目，有用浅白语言解释它解决什么问题、展示它怎样运作的简单图表、列出相关的你可能也想看的模式，这样你能快速查找某个东西并真正理解它，不用啃厚重教科书。

corpus_topic: Dev Conference
query_text: A website for a dev conference where visitors can see the full schedule laid out by day and time, browse speaker bios, and sign up for the event, with a spot near the top that highlights the keynote speakers so first-time visitors immediately know who the big names are, all working nicely in a desktop browser for easy planning.
query_text_zh: 做一个开发者会议的网站，访问者能看到按日期和时间排列的完整日程、浏览演讲者介绍、报名参加活动，顶部有个地方突出显示主讲嘉宾这样第一次来的访问者立即知道谁是大牛，所有这些在台式浏览器上看起来很好利于规划。

corpus_topic: API-first SaaS product marketing launch page
query_text: Build a website to launch an API-first software product, where the main area explains what the product does and why developers would want it, there is a simple code snippet showing how easy it is to get started, and visitors can click a button to sign up or grab their API key, all designed to run in a desktop browser so teams can share the link and show it off properly.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站来推出一个以API为中心的软件产品，主要区域解释产品做什么、开发者为什么想要它、有个简单的代码片段显示开始有多容易、访问者能点个按钮注册或获得他们的API密钥，所有这些设计为在台式浏览器上运行这样团队能分享链接并正式展示。

corpus_topic: Developer SDK showcase with live code sandbox
query_text: Build a web app that showcases a developer SDK and lets visitors actually try it out in the browser without setting anything up, where the left side explains what the SDK does and lists its main features, and the right side has a live code area where you can type in a quick example and see the result run right there on the spot.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来展示开发者SDK，让访问者能在浏览器里真的试它而不用设置任何东西，左边解释SDK是做什么的、列出主要特性，右边有个实时代码区域能输入快速例子并看结果立即在那儿运行。

corpus_topic: Open-source project sponsor and backer spotlight
query_text: A web app that puts the spotlight on all the sponsors and financial backers of an open-source project, showing each one with their logo, a short note about why they support the project, and how long they have been backing it, along with a clear spot where new sponsors can find out how to get involved, all looking clean and easy to read in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来聚焦开源项目的所有赞助商和财务支持者，显示每个的商标、他们为什么支持项目的简短说明、支持多久了，加上一个清晰的地方让新赞助商看怎样参与，所有这些在台式浏览器上看起来整洁容易读。

corpus_topic: Tech startup engineering culture and hiring site
query_text: Create a website for a tech startup that wants to show off its engineering team culture and attract people to apply for jobs, with a section that describes how the team works day to day, a grid of open positions people can browse, and short profiles of a few current engineers so candidates get a real sense of who they would be working with, all viewable in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个科技初创公司的网站，想展示工程团队文化、吸引人来应聘工作，有个部分描述团队每天怎样工作、一个网格显示人们能浏览的开放职位、几个现有工程师的简短简介这样候选人能真实感受在谁身边工作，所有这些能在台式浏览器里看。

corpus_topic: Cloud infrastructure tool pricing comparison landing

query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来比较不同云基础设施工具间的定价，这样团队能并排看成本而不用分别去翻每个供应商网站，有个表格显示每个工具在每个价格层包含什么、还有个方式过滤下来只看你的团队真正关心的特性，所有这些在台式浏览器上工作让规划会议时容易分享。

corpus_topic: Developer beta waitlist and early-access signup site
query_text: Build a website where developers can sign up for early access to a new tool still in beta, with a short section explaining what the product does and what testers will get to try, a form to drop in your email and a quick note about your use case, and a counter showing how many people have already joined the waitlist, all running cleanly in a desktop browser.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站让开发者能报名尝鲜一个还在测试中的新工具，有个简短部分解释产品是做什么的、测试者会得到尝试什么、一个表格让你填入邮箱和关于你用例的简短说明、一个计数器显示已经加入等待名单的人数，所有这些在台式浏览器上整洁地运行。

corpus_topic: Programming language framework community adoption showcase

query_text_zh: 做一个网站展示有多少开发者和团队采用了某个特定的编程框架，配有真实的使用数字、在生产环境中使用它的人的简短引言、用这个框架做的著名项目列表，这样在台式浏览器里浏览的访问者能快速感受这个框架的流行程度和信任度。

corpus_topic: DevRel ambassador program recruitment landing page

query_text_zh: 做一个网站让开发者能了解并申请社区大使角色，解释项目涉及什么、大使真正做什么、配有几个现有大使的简介这样申请者知道什么样的人合适，最后以一个提交你的兴趣的表格结束，所有这些设计为在台式浏览器上看起来很好便于在开发者社区分享。

corpus_topic: Technical certification course and exam marketing site
query_text: A website for a technical certification program where people can browse the available courses and exams, see what each one covers and how long it takes to prepare, and register for the one they want, with a section that highlights success stories from people who have already passed so visitors feel confident it is worth their time, all laid out nicely for desktop browsers.
query_text_zh: 做一个技术认证项目的网站，人们能浏览可用的课程和考试、看每个涉及什么和花多少时间准备、注册他们想要的那个，有个部分突出已经通过的人的成功故事这样访问者觉得值得花时间，所有这些对台式浏览器排列得很好。

corpus_topic: Engineering blog with integrated product call-to-action
query_text: Build a website that works as an engineering blog where the team publishes technical articles, and at the end of each post there is a natural prompt pointing readers toward the product being built, so people who just read something useful can easily take the next step and try it out, all running in a desktop browser so the team can share posts with the wider developer community.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站作为工程博客，团队在这里发布技术文章，每篇文章的结尾有个自然的提示引导读者去试正在建造的产品，这样刚读完有用内容的人能容易地迈出下一步并尝试它，所有这些在台式浏览器上运行这样团队能在更广泛的开发者社区分享文章。

corpus_topic: Open-source maintainer grant program application site
query_text: Need a web app that serves as a grant application site for open-source project maintainers, where they can read about what the program offers, check if their project qualifies, and fill out an application form with details about their work and how they would use the funding, all accessible in a desktop browser so maintainers can take their time filling it out properly.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网络应用作为开源项目维护者的补助申请网站，他们能读关于项目提供什么、检查他们的项目是否符合条件、填一个申请表写上关于他们工作的细节和怎样使用资金，所有这些在台式浏览器里访问这样维护者能花时间好好填完。

corpus_topic: Developer productivity benchmark results showcase page
query_text: A website that shows off developer productivity benchmark results, with charts comparing how much faster teams get things done using a particular tool, some context explaining how the tests were run so the numbers actually mean something, and a section where real teams share their own results, all viewable in a desktop browser so sales and engineering folks can reference it during calls.
query_text_zh: 做一个网站展示开发者生产力基准测试结果，有些图表比较使用某个工具的团队能快多少完成工作、解释测试怎样运行的一些背景这样数字真正有意义、一个部分真实团队分享他们自己的结果，所有这些在台式浏览器里可看这样销售和工程的人能在通话中引用。

corpus_topic: API marketplace with usage-based billing dashboard
query_text: An API marketplace web app where I can browse available APIs in one place and always see exactly how much I have spent and how many calls I have made this month, because right now I keep getting surprise charges and have no idea which API is eating my budget, so I want a clear breakdown by API with running totals and maybe an alert when I am getting close to a limit.
query_text_zh: 做一个API市场网络应用，我能在一个地方浏览可用的API，总能看到这个月我花了多少钱和打了多少次调用，因为现在我总是收到惊人的账单、完全不知道哪个API在吃我的预算，所以我想要按API清楚分解加上运行总数，也许在我接近某个限制时有个警告。

corpus_topic: open-source enterprise license sales and management portal
query_text: Make a web app that handles selling and managing enterprise licenses for an open-source project, where companies can pick a plan, pay, and get their license key all in one place, and the admin side lets me see which organizations have active licenses and when they expire, so I stop having to track all of this in spreadsheets and chase people down when renewals are due.
query_text_zh: 做一个网络应用来处理销售和管理开源项目的企业许可证，公司能选择一个计划、付款、在一个地方得到许可证密钥，管理面能让我看哪些组织有活跃许可证和什么时候过期，这样我就不用再在电子表格里追踪所有事、不用在续期期间再追着人。

corpus_topic: developer tool SaaS pricing and plan comparison page
query_text: Build a web app that lays out all the pricing tiers for developer SaaS tools in one place so I can actually compare what each plan includes, because right now I have to open five tabs and scroll through each site individually just to figure out which plan has the feature I need. I want a side-by-side table that lists features per plan, shows the monthly and yearly price, and lets me check off which ones I care about so the irrelevant rows collapse.
query_text_zh: 我需要建一个网页应用，把所有开发者SaaS工具的定价层级汇总在一个地方，这样我就不用分别打开五个网站去对比每个计划的功能了。我想要一个并排的表格，列出每个计划的功能、月价和年价，还能让我勾选关心的功能，这样不相关的行就会收起来。

corpus_topic: technical consulting firm client project portal

query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，让技术咨询公司的每个客户都有自己的空间来查看项目进展，了解哪些任务已完成或在进行中，还能来回上传文件，不用全靠邮件沟通。我希望在桌面浏览器上能让客户登录，看到项目概览，查看带有状态的里程碑列表，可以在每一项上留言，不用翻长长的邮件。

corpus_topic: software vendor partner program enrollment site

query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来处理软件供应商注册加入合作伙伴计划的整个流程，现在注册流程散乱在各种邮件和PDF里，没人知道自己进行到哪一步了。我想要一个简单的注册工具，公司可以填入信息、选择合作伙伴等级、上传必要的文件，然后清楚地看到申请在审核流程中的进度。

I want a list of challenges on the left, a text area in the middle where I can write and run my answer, and a results area that tells me if I passed or what went wrong. Each challenge should show how many other people have completed it so I have a sense of whether it is supposed to be hard or easy.
query_text_zh: 我要一个基于浏览器的编程挑战应用，挑战按难度分组，这样初学者可以从简单的开始慢慢往上。我想要左边一个挑战列表，中间一个文本区让我写答案和运行，右边一个结果区告诉我是否通过或哪里出错了。每个挑战应该显示有多少其他人完成过，这样我就能感觉出它是应该简单还是应该难。

corpus_topic: System design interview prep site with annotated diagrams
query_text: Make a web app for system design interview prep that includes written guides and labeled diagrams so I can study each topic properly. I want a list of design topics on the side, a reading area with a clear explanation, and diagrams that have labels I can click to get more detail on each part. There should also be a way to take notes on each topic right in the app so I can jot down things I want to remember for the actual interview.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来准备系统设计面试，包括文字指南和标注的图表，这样我可以好好学习每个主题。我想要侧边一个设计主题列表，一个阅读区有清晰的解释，图表上有标签我可以点击以获得每一部分的更多细节。还应该有办法在应用里直接做每个主题的笔记，这样我可以记下想为实际面试记住的东西。

corpus_topic: Open-source onboarding hub for first-time contributors
query_text: Need a web app that helps someone who has never contributed to open source before figure out where to start, with a list of beginner-friendly projects and a step-by-step guide for making a first contribution. I want to be able to filter projects by programming language, see a short description of each one, and follow a checklist of steps like forking the repo and submitting a pull request so I know exactly what to do next and nothing falls through the cracks.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用来帮助从未对开源有贡献过的人找出从哪里开始，包括一列对初学者友好的项目和一个逐步指南来做第一次贡献。我想要能按编程语言筛选项目，看到每一个的简短描述，还能按照一个清单做步骤比如fork仓库和提交pull request，这样我就知道接下来该做什么，没有什么会遗漏。

corpus_topic: Tech conference talk archive with full transcript search
query_text: Make a web app that stores tech conference talks and lets me search through the full text of their transcripts so I can find the specific part of a talk that mentioned something I half-remember. I want a search bar at the top, a results list that shows the talk title and a snippet of the matching transcript text, and when I click a result it takes me to the full transcript with the matching words highlighted so I can read the context right away.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用来存储技术大会的演讲，让我能搜索他们的完整文字记录，这样我可以找到演讲中我半记得的那个特定部分。我想要顶部有个搜索栏，结果列表显示演讲标题和匹配的记录文本片段，当我点一个结果时它会带我到完整记录，匹配的词会高亮，这样我可以立即读到上下文。

corpus_topic: Developer learning roadmap builder and progress tracker
query_text: Build a web app where I can lay out a learning roadmap for myself as a developer, add topics and resources in the order I plan to tackle them, and check things off as I go. I want to be able to create multiple roadmaps for different goals, add a note or link to a resource under each topic, and see a running count of how many items I have finished versus how many are left so I can tell how far along I am on each roadmap.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，让我可以为自己作为开发者规划一个学习路线图，按我计划解决的顺序添加主题和资源，然后随着进度勾选。我想要能创建多个不同目标的路线图，在每个主题下添加笔记或资源链接，看到一个我完成的项目数对剩余项目数的运行计数，这样我可以看出自己在每个路线图上的进度。

corpus_topic: Algorithm step-through visualizer for CS fundamentals
query_text: Build a web app that walks through how common computer science algorithms work step by step, with a visual showing what is happening at each stage so I can actually follow the logic. I want to be able to pick an algorithm from a list, enter some sample data to run it on, then step forward and backward through the process one move at a time, with a panel alongside that explains in plain words what just happened at each step.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用来逐步演示常见计算机科学算法如何工作，并在每个阶段配有可视化显示发生了什么，这样我真的能跟上逻辑。我想要能从列表中选一个算法，输入一些示例数据来运行它，然后一次一步地前进和后退，旁边有一个面板用普通话解释每一步刚刚发生了什么。

corpus_topic: SQL practice sandbox with curated real-world datasets
query_text: Need a web app that gives me a place to practice writing SQL queries against real-looking data sets so I can build up my skills without setting up any software on my computer. I want a list of available data sets to choose from, a query box where I can type my SQL and run it right in the browser, a results table that shows what came back, and a set of practice questions for each data set that hint at what kind of query to try.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，给我一个地方来练习对真实样子的数据集写SQL查询，这样我可以建立我的技能而不用在我的电脑上安装任何软件。我想要有一列可选的数据集，一个查询框让我可以在浏览器里直接输入SQL并运行它，一个结果表显示返回的内容，以及每个数据集的一套练习问题，暗示应该尝试什么样的查询。

corpus_topic: Git branching and merge conflict interactive simulator
query_text: Create a web app that lets me practice Git branching and working through merge conflicts by simulating the whole thing right in the browser, so I can make mistakes without messing up a real project. I want to create branches, make pretend commits on each one, try to merge them, and then see what a conflict looks like and practice resolving it step by step, with a visual tree showing how the branches relate to each other.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，让我能在浏览器里模拟整个过程来练习Git分支和处理合并冲突，这样我可以犯错而不会搞坏一个真实项目。我想要创建分支，在每一个上做假装的提交，尝试合并它们，然后看合并冲突是什么样的，逐步练习解决它，用一个可视化树显示分支之间的关系。

corpus_topic: Regex pattern builder with live test and plain-English explanation
query_text: Create a web app where I can type a pattern for matching text and immediately see which parts of my sample text it matches, plus get a plain-English breakdown of what each piece of the pattern actually means. I want a text box for the pattern on one side, a text box for my sample on the other, live highlighting of matches as I type, and a list below that explains each part of the pattern in everyday language so I can learn as I go.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，让我可以输入一个文本匹配模式，立即看到我的示例文本的哪些部分匹配它，还能得到一份用普通英语的模式分解说明。我想要一边有个模式文本框，另一边有我的示例文本框，当我打字时实时突显匹配，下面有一个列表用日常语言解释模式的每一部分，这样我可以边学边做。

corpus_topic: Cloud certification study guide and practice exam site
query_text: Build a web app that helps me study for a cloud certification by giving me reading material organized by exam topic and a set of practice questions I can run through to test myself. I want the topics listed in the order they usually appear on the exam, a reading section for each one, a practice quiz with multiple-choice questions at the end of each topic, and a summary at the end showing which topics I got right and which ones I should review again.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用来帮助我学习云认证，提供按考试主题组织的阅读材料和一套我可以用来自我测试的练习问题。我想要主题按它们通常在考试中出现的顺序列出，每一个都有一个阅读部分，每个主题末尾有一个带多选问题的练习小测验，最后有一个总结显示我答对了哪些主题、哪些应该再复习。

corpus_topic: Software design patterns catalog with runnable code examples
query_text: Create a web app that is basically a reference guide for common software design patterns, where each entry shows a plain description of the pattern and a small code example I can actually run in the browser to see it in action. I want the patterns organized into groups like creational, structural, and behavioral, a search bar so I can find a specific one quickly, and a side-by-side layout with the explanation on one side and the runnable code on the other.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，基本上是常见软件设计模式的参考指南，每个条目都显示一个用简单语言的模式描述和一个我可以在浏览器里实际运行的小代码例子来看它的实际效果。我想要模式组织成创建型、结构型和行为型之类的组，有一个搜索栏这样我可以快速找到特定的一个，还有一个并排布局，一边是解释另一边是可运行的代码。

corpus_topic: Discord 入口
query_text: A little landing hub app for a Discord community, the kind you would open in a browser on your desktop, where visitors can see a quick description of what the server is about, browse the main channels or topics it covers, and click a big friendly invite link to join. I want to add a short welcome message, list a few community highlights or rules, and maybe show how many members are currently online so it feels like a real active place worth joining.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个小登陆页应用，专门为Discord社区打造，你会在桌面浏览器里打开它，访客可以看到服务器的快速描述，浏览它涵盖的主要频道或主题，还能点一个大友好的邀请链接来加入。我想要添加一条简短的欢迎信息，列出一些社区亮点或规则，也许显示当前有多少成员在线，这样它感觉像是一个真正活跃、值得加入的地方。

corpus_topic: 开源社区
query_text: Create a web app for browsing and joining open-source communities where you can search for projects by topic, see how active each one is, and find beginner-friendly ones to contribute to, with a sidebar that keeps your bookmarked communities handy so you can jump back to them whenever you open the browser and want to pick up where you left off.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用来浏览和加入开源社区，可以按主题搜索项目，看每一个有多活跃，找对初学者友好的来贡献，还有一个侧边栏让你轻松获得已加书签的社区，这样无论何时你打开浏览器都可以快速跳回它们，继续你停下的地方。

corpus_topic: developer code snippet sharing and voting site
query_text: A site where developers can share little code snippets they're proud of and other people can upvote or comment on them, so the best ones rise to the top, and you can browse by language or topic in a browser tab and save favorites to revisit later, kind of like a low-key community hall for sharing those small tricks you figured out that took you way too long.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网站，开发者可以分享他们自豪的小代码片段，其他人可以为它们投票或评论，这样最好的片段会上升到顶部，你可以按语言或主题在浏览器标签页里浏览，保存最爱的以后回顾，有点像一个轻松的社区大厅，分享那些你花了太长时间才想出来的小技巧。

corpus_topic: open-source project showcase and discovery gallery
query_text: Make a web app that works like a gallery where people can post their open-source side projects and others can browse, discover, and give a shoutout to the ones they like, with filters for category and popularity so it's easy to find something interesting to explore or fork when you're sitting at your desk looking for inspiration.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，像个画廊一样，人们可以发布他们的开源副业项目，其他人可以浏览、发现，并为他们喜欢的点个赞，可以按类别和热度筛选，这样坐在桌子前找灵感的时候就很容易找到有意思的东西来探索或fork。

corpus_topic: hackathon team formation and project tracking platform
query_text: Need a web app for hackathon participants where you can post that you're looking for teammates, describe what you're building and what kind of help you need, and then once your team is set you can track who's doing what and how the project is progressing, all in one place so everyone stays on the same page through the crunch time.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用给黑客马拉松参与者，可以发布你正在找队友，描述你在建什么以及你需要什么样的帮助，然后团队确定后可以追踪谁在做什么以及项目进展，全部在一个地方这样大家在冲刺时都能保持同步。

corpus_topic: technical RFC proposal discussion and voting board
query_text: Need a web app where a team can post technical proposal write-ups, have everyone read through them and leave comments, and then vote on whether to move forward, kind of like a lightweight way to make group decisions about how to do things without digging through long email threads, and you can see the full history of past proposals and how they turned out.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，让团队可以发布技术提案文章，每个人都读一遍并留言，然后投票决定是否继续，有点像一个轻量级的方式来对如何做事做出团队决定，不用翻长邮件线索，还能看到过去提案的完整历史以及它们最后怎样了。

corpus_topic: open-source bounty and micro-grant listing board
query_text: Build a web app that lists open-source tasks with small rewards or grants attached, so contributors can browse what needs doing, see how much each task is worth, and claim the ones they want to work on, and project maintainers can post new bounties and mark them complete when someone delivers, keeping everything organized on one page in the browser.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，列出附带奖励或资金的开源任务，这样贡献者可以浏览需要做的事情，看每个任务值多少钱，认领他们想做的，项目维护者可以发布新的赏金并在有人交付时标记为完成，在浏览器的一个页面上保持一切有序。

corpus_topic: developer tools directory with community star ratings
query_text: Build a web app that works like a directory of useful tools for developers where the community can submit new ones and rate the ones they've tried, so when you're looking for something to help with a specific task you can browse by category and sort by how many stars something has to quickly find what other people actually recommend.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，像是开发者有用工具的目录，社区可以提交新的并对他们用过的打星级，所以当你在找能帮助某个特定任务的东西时，你可以按类别浏览并按星数排序，快速找到其他人真正推荐的东西。

corpus_topic: annotated code review examples learning community
query_text: Make a web app where people can share real code examples with detailed notes explaining what's good or bad about each part, so others can learn from seeing actual code and the reasoning behind feedback, and you can browse examples by language or skill level when you have time at your desk to work through something and actually understand why certain patterns are better.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，人们可以分享带有详细笔记的真实代码例子，解释每一部分的好或坏之处，这样其他人可以通过看真实代码和反馈背后的原因来学习，你可以按语言或技能级别浏览例子，当你坐在桌前有时间时可以过一遍东西并真正理解为什么某些模式更好。

corpus_topic: developer mentorship pairing and progress tracking site
query_text: A browser-based app where someone who wants to learn can get matched with a more experienced person willing to mentor them, and once paired they both have a shared space to log goals, check off milestones, and leave notes after each session, so the whole mentorship has a clear thread you can look back on instead of scattered messages.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个基于浏览器的应用，想要学习的人可以被配对给愿意指导他们的更有经验的人，配对后他们都有一个共享的空间来记录目标、勾选里程碑、在每次会话后留笔记，这样整个指导关系有一个清晰的线索你可以回头查看，而不是散乱的信息。

corpus_topic: tech conference talk archive with community annotations
query_text: Make a web app that collects recorded tech conference talks and lets the community leave timestamped notes and highlights on each one, so you can watch a talk and see what points other people flagged as important, or add your own thoughts, and browse by topic or year to find talks worth watching when you're sitting at your computer with an hour to learn something new.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，收集录制好的技术大会演讲，让社区在每一个上留带时间戳的笔记和亮点标记，所以你可以看一个演讲并看到其他人标记为重要的要点，或添加你自己的想法，按主题或年份浏览来找值得看的演讲，当你坐在电脑前有一小时来学点新东西的时候。

corpus_topic: competitive programming leaderboard and contest hub
query_text: A web app built around competitive programming contests where you can see upcoming competitions, join them, and track how everyone is doing on a live standings board as problems get solved, and after each contest you can browse a breakdown of who solved what and how fast, so the whole community has a shared place to follow the action in the browser.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用围绕竞争性编程竞赛，你可以看到即将举行的竞赛，加入它们，当问题被解决时在一个实时排名板上追踪每个人的表现，在每场竞赛后你可以浏览谁解决了什么的分解和解决有多快，这样整个社区都有一个共享的地方在浏览器里跟踪动作。

corpus_topic: developer side-project launch and feedback board
query_text: A web app where you can post a little side project you just shipped and ask people to try it and leave honest feedback, and others can browse recent launches, upvote the ones they find clever, and drop comments with suggestions, kind of like a small friendly corner of the internet where tinkerers show each other what they've been making and actually get useful responses.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，你可以发布你刚完成的小副业项目并要求人们试用它、留诚实的反馈，其他人可以浏览最近的发布、为他们觉得聪慧的投票、留下带有建议的评论，有点像互联网的一个小友好角落，手工艺人彼此展示他们一直在做什么并真正得到有用的回应。

corpus_topic: 资源聚合站
query_text: Build a web app that pulls together links to useful resources on a topic so you always have one place to go instead of hunting through bookmarks, where anyone can submit a new link and the community can vote things up or down, with categories on the side so you can narrow down to exactly the kind of resource you need when you're sitting at your desk trying to learn something new.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，把关于某个主题的有用资源链接汇总在一起，这样你总是有一个地方去而不用在书签里翻找，任何人都可以提交一个新链接，社区可以投票赞成或反对，侧边有分类这样当你坐在桌前想学点新东西时可以缩小到你需要的确切类型的资源。

corpus_topic: Directory 站
query_text: A web app that works like a big organized list of tools and resources, where each entry has a short description and a link, and you can search or filter by type to quickly find what you're looking for, and people can suggest new entries, so it stays current and useful as a go-to reference you can open in the browser whenever you need to find the right thing for a job.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，像一个大的有组织的工具和资源列表，每个条目都有简短的描述和链接，你可以搜索或按类型筛选来快速找到你在找的，人们可以建议新的条目，这样当工作变化时它保持时事和有用，成为一个你可以在浏览器里随时打开来找合适的东西的可靠参考。

corpus_topic: API endpoint tester and mock server playground
query_text: Create a web app where you can type in a web address and pick the kind of request you want to make, then hit send and see exactly what comes back, so you can figure out why something isn't working without having to set anything up, and also have a way to define a fake server that returns whatever you tell it to so you can test your front end even when the real back end isn't ready.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，可以输入一个网址，选择想要的请求类型，然后发送并看到确切的返回内容，这样我可以搞清楚为什么什么不工作而不用设置任何东西，还有一种方式定义一个假服务器，它返回你告诉它的任何东西，这样即使真实后端还没准备好你也可以测试前端。

corpus_topic: Regex pattern builder with live match explorer
query_text: Build a web app where you can type in a pattern for matching text and immediately see which parts of a sample string it catches, highlighted right there in the browser, and you can tweak the pattern and watch the matches update in real time so you can actually understand what you wrote and why it works or doesn't before you use it anywhere.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用，可以输入一个文本匹配模式，立即看到示例字符串的哪些部分被抓住，在浏览器里直接高亮显示，我可以微调模式并看到匹配实时更新，这样在任何地方使用它之前我可以真正理解你写了什么以及为什么它工作或不工作。

corpus_topic: JSON schema validator and pretty-printer tool
query_text: Make a browser tool where you can paste in some data and it checks whether the structure matches a set of rules you define, then shows you exactly which parts pass and which fail with a clear message, and also has a button to clean up the formatting so the whole thing looks neat and easy to read when you copy it somewhere else.
query_text_zh: 我要一个浏览器工具，可以粘贴一些数据，它检查结构是否符合你定义的一组规则，然后准确显示哪些部分通过哪些失败，并附带清晰的消息，还有一个按钮来清理格式这样整个东西看起来整洁易读，当你复制到其他地方时。

corpus_topic: Cron expression generator with plain-English explainer
query_text: A web app where you type in one of those weird schedules with numbers and asterisks that computers use for timed tasks, and it immediately tells you in plain words what it means, like every Monday at 9am, and also shows the next few times it would run so you can make sure it's actually set up the way you meant without having to look up what each part means.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，输入一个那些奇怪的带数字和星号的计算机用来安排定时任务的时间表，它立即用普通话告诉你这意味着什么，比如每周一早上九点，还显示接下来几次它会运行，这样你可以确保它确实按照你的意思设置，不用查什么每一部分的意思。

corpus_topic: Git commit message linter and formatter
query_text: A browser tool where you paste in your commit message and it checks whether it follows the format your team agreed on, and if something looks off it tells you what to fix and why, so you can clean it up before you actually commit, and there's also a helper that lets you fill in the type and description in separate fields and it writes the final message for you.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个浏览器工具，粘贴你的提交信息，它检查是否遵循你的团队同意的格式，如果什么看起来不对它告诉你需要修复什么以及为什么，这样你可以在实际提交前清理它，还有一个辅助程序让你在单独的字段里填类型和描述，它会给你写最终的信息。

corpus_topic: SQL query formatter and step-by-step explainer
query_text: A web tool where you paste in a messy database query and it reformats it to be readable with proper spacing and indentation, and then walks you through what each part is doing in plain language so you can actually follow the logic, which is great when you're handed someone else's query and need to figure out what it does before you change anything.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页工具，粘贴一个混乱的数据库查询，它会用适当的空格和缩进重新格式化为可读的，然后用普通语言逐步讲解每一部分在做什么，这样你可以真正跟上逻辑，当你被递给别人的查询并需要在改任何东西前搞清楚它做什么时特别好。

corpus_topic: Open-source license chooser and side-by-side comparator
query_text: Build a web app that helps you pick a license for an open-source project by asking a few plain questions about what you want to allow, then suggests the best match and shows you a side-by-side view comparing the top options so you can see the real differences in permissions and restrictions before deciding, all in the browser without having to read long legal documents.
query_text_zh: 我要一个网页应用来帮助你为开源项目选择许可证，通过问几个关于你想允许什么的简单问题，然后建议最佳匹配，显示前几个选项的并排比较，这样你可以在决定前看到许可和限制中的真实区别，全部在浏览器里，不用读长的法律文件。

corpus_topic: HTTP status code reference and live tester
query_text: Make a browser reference tool for HTTP status codes where you can look up any code and get a plain-English explanation of what it means and when it shows up, and also lets you type in a web address to actually send a request and see what code the server sends back, so you can check the real behavior without having to set anything up.
query_text_zh: 我要一个HTTP状态代码的浏览器参考工具，可以查找任何代码并得到一个用普通英语的解释，说明它意味着什么以及什么时候出现，还让你输入一个网址来实际发送一个请求并看到服务器发回什么代码，这样你可以检查真实行为而不用设置任何东西。

corpus_topic: Environment variable manager and dotenv file generator
query_text: A web app where you can enter all the settings and secret values a project needs to run and it keeps them organized by environment like local or testing or live, and when you're ready you can download a properly formatted config file to drop into your project, so you always have the right values in the right place without hunting through old notes or copy-pasting from random files.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个网页应用，可以输入一个项目运行需要的所有设置和秘密值，它按本地或测试或实时之类的环境来组织它们，当你准备好时可以下载一个格式恰当的配置文件来放入你的项目，这样你总是在正确的地方有正确的值，不用翻找老笔记或从随机文件复制粘贴。

corpus_topic: Webhook inspector and inbound request logger
query_text: Need a web app that gives you a web address you can point any service at, and whenever something sends a message to that address it shows up instantly in the browser with all the details so you can see exactly what was sent and in what format, which makes it so much easier to figure out if a connection is working right without having to dig through server logs.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个网页应用，给你一个网址可以指向任何服务，无论什么时候什么东西向这个网址发送消息它就立即显示在浏览器里，附带所有细节，这样你可以看到确切发送了什么以及什么格式，这样要搞清楚一个连接是否工作正常容易得多，不用翻挖服务器日志。

corpus_topic: Base64 and encoding converter for developers
query_text: Create a browser tool for converting text and data between different encoded formats, where you paste something in on one side and pick the format you want on the other side and it shows the result immediately, so you can quickly turn a blob of encoded characters back into readable text or the other way around without needing to remember any commands or install anything.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个浏览器工具来在不同的编码格式之间转换文本和数据，粘贴什么在一边，在另一边选择你想要的格式，它立即显示结果，这样你可以快速把一坨编码的字符转回可读的文本或反过来，不用记住任何命令或安装任何东西。
